options.t: 我认为对确实因信息不通、非故意违规的，应普及法律并酌情减责，惩罚要讲过错程度。
options.t_en: I believe that the law should be popularized and the liability should be reduced as appropriate if the violation is really due to lack of information or unintentional violation, and the punishment should be described as the degree of fault.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A small shopkeeper was fined for not understanding the new rules and accidentally violating them. When he was fined, he shouted, "I really didn't know this existed." Law enforcers and the public disagree on "whether the law can be reduced".

scene: 一位被控轻罪但无前科的人，因凑不出保释金被一直关着等审判，而有钱的同案犯早已出来。大家质疑：保释到底是在保自由还是在卖自由。

options.t: 我支持对大多数非暴力被告实行普遍保释候审，没定罪前不该先剥夺自由。
options.t_en: I support universal bail on remand for most non-violent defendants, who should not be deprived of their liberty before conviction.

options.t: 我认为保释得严格审查逃跑风险，不能轻易放，否则人跑了案子就黄了。
options.t_en: I think that bail must be strictly reviewed for the risk of escape, and it cannot be released easily, otherwise the case will be yellow if the person runs away.

options.t: 我倾向按每个人的逃跑风险和危害程度个案决定，而不是统一口径。
options.t_en: I prefer to decide on a case-by-case basis based on each person's risk of flight and the level of harm, rather than a unified gauge.

options.t: 我看不惯有钱就能保、没钱就蹲着的现象，这把司法变成了明码标价的生意。
options.t_en: I am not accustomed to the phenomenon of having money to protect and squatting without money, which has turned justice into a clearly priced business.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: A person charged with a misdemeanor but without a previous conviction has been kept in jail awaiting trial because he could not come up with bail, and a rich co-defendant has already come out. People questioned whether bail was preserving liberty or selling it.

scene: 一起备受关注的案子开庭，旁听席坐满了人，但很多人进不去。要不要把庭审搬到镜头前，让全民都能看，引发讨论。

options.t: 我认为重大案件应直播庭审，阳光是最好的防腐剂，公众监督能倒逼公正。
options.t_en: I believe that major cases should be heard live, sunshine is the best preservative, and public supervision can force justice.

options.t: 我主张涉及隐私、未成年人的案件不公开，保护当事人比满足围观更重要。
options.t_en: I advocate that cases involving privacy, minors are not public, and it is more important to protect the parties than to meet the onlookers.

options.t: 我支持把生效判决书上网公开，既接受监督又不打扰庭审现场。
options.t_en: I support the publication of the effective judgment on the Internet, both under supervision and without disturbing the scene of the trial.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A high-profile case opened, and the gallery was full, but many people could not get in. Whether to move the trial to the front of the camera so that the whole people can see it and trigger discussion.

scene: 一所公立学校每周一集会时，有老师提议加一段统一祷告。信教家长欢迎，无信仰家长反对，校方左右为难。

options.t: 我认为公立学校应保持世俗中立，不组织任何宗教仪式，确保所有孩子都不被强加信仰。
options.t_en: I believe that public schools should be secular neutral and not organize any religious ceremonies to ensure that all children are not imposed on the faith.

options.t: 我赞成仪式设为自愿参加，信的家庭可去、不信的不强求，彼此互不勉强。
options.t_en: I agree that the ceremony is set up to participate voluntarily, the family of the letter can go, unbelievers do not force each other, do not force each other.

options.t: 我倾向沿用本地多数人的传统做法，既然大多数人习惯，顺着走也天经地义。
options.t_en: I tend to follow the traditional practice of the local majority, and since most people are used to it, it is natural to walk along.

options.t: 我认为学校里任何宗教仪式都不该有，连“可选”都可能给不参加的孩子压力。
options.t_en: I don't think there should be any religious rituals in schools, and even "optional" can put pressure on children who don't attend.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: When a public school rallies every Monday, a teacher proposes to add a unified prayer. Religious parents are welcome, non-believing parents object, and the school is in a dilemma.

scene: 一个宗教团体靠捐赠建了宏伟的会所，却和周边商铺一样都不交税。财政紧张时，有人问：信仰该不该也承担税赋。

options.t: 我认为宗教团体从事信仰活动本就非营利，免税是传统也合情理，不该和生意一样收税。
options.t_en: I think that religious groups engaged in faith activities are inherently non-profit, and tax exemption is both traditional and reasonable, and should not be taxed like business.

options.t: 我主张宗教团体只要有经营收入，就和别的组织一样照章纳税，公平比特殊待遇重要。
options.t_en: I believe that as long as religious groups have business income, they will pay taxes in accordance with the rules like other organizations, and fairness is more important than special treatment.

options.t: 我支持只对真正用于慈善救助的部分免税，经营性收入该税的还是要税。
options.t_en: I support tax exemptions for only the portion that is actually used for charitable relief, and taxation for operating income is still required.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: A religious group built a magnificent clubhouse by donation, but it did not pay taxes like the surrounding shops. When the financial situation is tight, some people ask: should faith also bear taxes?

scene: 一位戴头巾的女性去政务大厅办事，窗口人员对“公务场合能否佩戴宗教标识”拿不准，其他办事群众也投来目光。

options.t: 我认为在公共场合戴什么宗教标识是个人的自由，只要不妨碍他人，旁人无权干涉。
options.t_en: I believe that wearing religious symbols in public is a personal freedom, as long as it does not interfere with others, others do not have the right to interfere.

options.t: 我主张在代表公权力的公务岗位上有着装中性要求，宗教标识在那种场合宜收起，以保证中立。
options.t_en: I advocate the requirement of dressing neutrally in public office representing public authority, and religious symbols should be put away on such occasions to ensure neutrality.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A woman wearing a headscarf went to the government affairs hall to work. The window staff was uncertain about whether they could wear religious signs on official occasions, and other business people also cast their eyes.

scene: 一所由宗教团体办的学校申请纳入公共教育体系拿补贴，纳税人有人愿意、有人觉得“用我的税养别人的信仰”不划算。

options.t: 我认为公共财政不该资助宗教学校，纳税人的钱不应流向特定信仰。
options.t_en: I don't think public finances should fund religious schools, and taxpayers' money shouldn't go to specific faiths.

options.t: 我支持只要达到教育标准就平等给资助，信仰背景不该成为被排除的理由。
options.t_en: I support equal funding as long as educational standards are met, and religious background should not be a reason for exclusion.

options.t: 我倾向只补贴其中的数学、语文等世俗课程，宗教部分由团体自筹。
options.t_en: I tend to subsidize only secular courses such as mathematics and language, and the religious part is self-funded by the group.

options.t: 我觉得读宗教学校是家庭的选择，费用该家长自己承担，不沾公帑。
options.t_en: I feel that going to a religious school is the choice of the family, and the cost is borne by the parent, not the public.

options.t: 我主张给符合条件的基础教育部分适当补贴，但宗教教学那块不补。
options.t_en: I advocate an appropriate subsidy for the eligible elementary education part, but the religious teaching part does not supplement it.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A school run by a religious group applied for inclusion in the public education system to receive subsidies. Some taxpayers were willing and some felt that "using my tax to support others' beliefs" was not cost-effective.

scene: 一位信奉某宗教的员工，其安息日恰逢公司大促最忙的一天，主管希望他顶上，他则请求调休。排班表卡在了信仰和业绩之间。

options.t: 我支持给他调休、把班排到别的日子，尊重信仰不该以丢工作为代价。
options.t_en: I support giving him a break and scheduling his shift to another day, and respecting his faith should not be at the expense of losing his job.

options.t: 我认为既然拿这份工资，关键节点得上，信仰安排可以错开、不能凌驾工作。
options.t_en: I think that since taking this salary, the key nodes can be achieved, the faith arrangement can be staggered and cannot override the work.

options.t: 我倾向主管和员工坐下来协商，找到双方都能接受的排班，不必非黑即白。
options.t_en: I prefer that supervisors and employees sit down and negotiate to find a mutually acceptable schedule that doesn't have to be black and white.

options.t: 我觉得规章就是规章，拒绝关键日上班就该按违纪处理，否则团队没法带。
options.t_en: I think the rules are the rules. If you refuse to go to work on a critical day, you should deal with it according to the discipline, otherwise the team will not be able to bring it.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: An employee of a certain religion whose Sabbath coincided with the busiest day in the company, and his supervisor wanted him to top it, he asked for a rest. The schedule is stuck between beliefs and performance.

scene: 公司年假表上只列了主流节日的假，信仰少数宗教的员工提出也想在自己的节日休息，HR一时不知该放几家。

options.t: 我支持把多个宗教的节日都纳入休假，多元社会里尊重不该只给多数人。
options.t_en: I support the inclusion of festivals of multiple religions in holidays, and respect should not be given only to the majority in a pluralistic society.

options.t: 我认为只放大多数人都过的节日最实际，小众节日让员工用年假自己调剂。
options.t_en: I think that it is most practical to only allow most people to spend holidays, and niche holidays allow employees to adjust their annual leave.

options.t: 我倾向给一笔带薪假额度，员工自己选在哪天休，信仰日还是生日由个人定。
options.t_en: I tend to give a paid leave quota, where the employee chooses to take a day off, and the day of belief or birthday is determined by the individual.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The company's annual leave list only lists the holidays of mainstream holidays. Employees who believe in minority religions have proposed that they also want to rest on their own holidays. HR does not know how many holidays should be put on for a while.

scene: 一群人成立了新的信仰团体，想正式登记、租场地活动，管理部门面对“放不放开、怎么审”的难题。

options.t: 我认为只要不违法，新团体登记应是自由的权利，信仰多元本就该被容纳。
options.t_en: I believe that as long as there is no violation of the law, the registration of new groups should be a right to freedom, and religious pluralism should be accommodated.

options.t: 我主张严格审查新团体，防止打着信仰旗号行骗害人的邪教钻进来。
options.t_en: I advocate strict censorship of new groups to prevent cults who cheat people under the banner of faith from entering.

options.t: 我倾向不强制登记，只要活动不扰民不违法，聚不聚、登不登记由他们自己。
options.t_en: I prefer not to compulsorily register, as long as the activity does not disturb the people and is not against the law, it is up to them to gather and not register.

options.t: 我支持设一套合规审查标准，通过就给身份，透明可比随意否决更公平。
options.t_en: I support the establishment of a set of compliance review criteria. By giving status, transparency can be fairer than arbitrary rejection.

options.t: 我认为宗教团体数量也该有个度，无限增加会带来管理和社会摩擦，需适度限制。
options.t_en: I think the number of religious groups should also have a certain degree, and an infinite increase will bring management and social friction, which needs to be moderately limited.

options.t: 我对新宗教多一个少一个并不关心，只要别影响到我正常生活就行。
options.t_en: I do not care about one more or one less of the new religion, as long as it does not affect my normal life.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A group of people set up a new faith group. They wanted to officially register and rent the venue. The management department faced the difficult problem of "letting go and how to judge".

scene: 一对年轻人谈婚论嫁，双方家庭信仰不同，一方父母不太乐意，劝孩子“还是找同信仰的稳妥”。小两口在坚持自己和顾及长辈间犯难。

options.t: 我认为和谁结婚是个人的自由，信仰不同不是障碍，长辈不该替孩子做这种决定。
options.t_en: I believe that marrying someone is a personal freedom, different beliefs are not an obstacle, and elders should not make such decisions for their children.

options.t: 我觉得父母出于关切劝一劝可以理解，信仰差异确实会带来生活习惯的摩擦，提醒不算越界。
options.t_en: I think it is understandable that parents persuade each other out of concern. Differences in beliefs do bring friction to life habits. Reminders are not out of bounds.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A pair of young people talk about marriage, the two families have different beliefs, and one parent is not happy to advise the child to "find the same faith safely". Little two people are struggling to stick to themselves and take care of their elders.

scene: 灾区募捐，宗教团体想牵头做物资发放，也有人担心“带信仰的慈善”会不会变相传教。慈善到底该谁来牵头，有了分歧。

options.t: 我支持宗教团体多做公益，信众有热情也有资源，帮人总是好事。
options.t_en: I support religious groups to do more public welfare, believers have enthusiasm and resources, and helping others is always a good thing.

options.t: 我认为救灾济困该由政府统筹主导，更公平也更少夹带，宗教团体可配合。
options.t_en: I think disaster relief should be coordinated and led by the government, more fair and less entangled, and religious groups can cooperate.

options.t: 我倾向宗教慈善由团体自己办、自己筹款自己发，不沾公权力最清净。
options.t_en: I prefer religious charity to be run by the group itself, self-funded and self-generated, and the cleanest in terms of public power.

options.t: 我主张用税收减免来激励宗教和世俗慈善都多做，撬动更多社会资源。
options.t_en: I advocate using tax breaks to incentivize religious and secular charity to do more and leverage more social resources.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: In disaster areas, religious groups want to take the lead in the distribution of materials, and some people worry that "charity with faith" will not be preached in disguise. There was disagreement about who should lead the charity.

scene: 一位作者在文章里尖锐调侃了某种信仰，信徒觉得受辱要追责，作者说这是表达自由。冒犯信仰的话，该不该碰法律红线。

options.t: 我认为调侃信仰不应成为犯罪，思想言论的自由空间里，冒犯本身不是罪。
options.t_en: I believe that making fun of faith should not be a crime, and in the free space of thought and speech, offending itself is not a crime.

options.t: 我主张对明显出于仇恨、意在煽动歧视的言论设限，纯粹表达和恶意攻击要分开。
options.t_en: I advocate restricting speech that is clearly motivated by hatred and intended to incite discrimination, and separating pure expression from malicious attacks.

options.t: 我对这类争论不掺和，爱信的自己信，爱说的自己说，离我远点就行。
options.t_en: I am not involved in such arguments, I love and believe in myself, I love to say, just stay away from me.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: In the article, an author sharply teases a certain faith, and believers feel insulted to be held accountable, which the author says is freedom of expression. If you offend the faith, you should not touch the red line of the law.

scene: 你租的公寓明年续约，房东说要涨三成，理由是周边都在涨。你工资没动，搬家又麻烦，整栋租客都在发愁。

options.t: 我认为政府该对涨幅设上限，不能让房东想涨多少涨多少，租客的基本居住得保住。
options.t_en: I think the government should set a ceiling on the increase, which can not make the landlord want to increase as much as possible, and the tenant's basic residence can be maintained.

options.t: 我觉得租金是供需决定的，房东愿租、租客愿租就行，限价只会让房源更少。
options.t_en: I think the rent is determined by supply and demand, the landlord is willing to rent, the tenant is willing to rent, and the price limit will only make the listing less.

options.t: 我支持用补贴帮低收入租客扛住涨租，而不是直接压房东的价格。
options.t_en: I support subsidies to help low-income tenants cope with rent increases, rather than directly depressing landlord prices.

options.t: 我认为根本办法是多建保障房和出租房，供给上去了租金自然稳。
options.t_en: I think the basic method is to build more affordable housing and rental housing, and the supply has increased and the rent has naturally stabilized.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The apartment you rented was renewed next year, and the landlord said it would increase by 30%, because the surrounding area was rising. Your salary has not moved, moving is troublesome, and the entire tenant is worried.

scene: 一个新区规划一出，外地投资客连夜排队买房，本地刚需家庭却越来越买不起。要不要给买房设门槛，争论升温。

options.t: 我支持限购，把房子留给真正要住的人，不能让投机客炒高所有人的居住成本。
options.t_en: I support the purchase restriction, leaving the house to the people who really want to live, and not letting speculators speculate on the high cost of living for all.

options.t: 我认为买卖是市场行为，限来限去反而扭曲价格，愿买愿卖自由就好。
options.t_en: I think that buying and selling is a market behavior. Limitations and restrictions distort prices instead. It is good to be willing to buy and sell freely.

options.t: 我主张对买了不住、空着的房子征税，用持有成本逼出存量，比限购更精准。
options.t_en: I advocate a tax on houses that can't be bought and are empty, and use the cost of ownership to force stocks out, which is more accurate than limiting purchases.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: As soon as a new district was planned, foreign investment customers lined up overnight to buy a house, but local families just needed it, but they were increasingly unable to afford it. Whether to set a threshold for buying a house and heat up the debate.

scene: 一对年轻夫妻攒不够全款，但又有居住刚需，政府推出“你出一部分、政府持一部分”的共有产权房。有人觉得是雪中送炭，有人觉得多此一举。

options.t: 我认为共有产权房该推广，让买不起全套的人先有安稳的家，居住权比产权完整更重要。
options.t_en: I think that common property houses should be promoted, so that people who cannot afford a complete set can have a stable home first, and the right of residence is more important than the integrity of property rights.

options.t: 我觉得市场能解决的没必要政府插手，真有需求自有商品房和租赁去匹配。
options.t_en: I think there is no need for the government to intervene in what the market can solve. There is a real need for private commercial housing and leasing to match.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A young couple does not save enough money, but they just need to live, and the government has launched a "part of you, the government holds part" of the common property rights housing. Some people think it's charcoal in the snow, and some people think it's too much.

scene: 一片城中村要改造，原住户怕被迁到远郊、小生意做不成，开发商算的是地块价值和利润。推土机前，各方的盘算都不一样。

options.t: 我主张改造后原住户优先回迁原地，不能让人为城市升级付出被边缘化的代价。
options.t_en: I advocate that the original residents after the transformation should give priority to returning to the original place, and should not make people pay the price of marginalization for urban upgrading.

options.t: 我认为整体开发提质、引入商业配套能带动片区价值，长远看对大家都有利。
options.t_en: I believe that the overall development and quality improvement and the introduction of commercial support can drive the value of the film area, which is beneficial to everyone in the long run.

options.t: 我支持在改造中保留一定比例低价出租房，给低收入群体留一口气的空间。
options.t_en: I support keeping a percentage of low-cost rentals in remodeling to give room for low-income groups.

options.t: 我倾向交给市场做商业开发，效率最高，政府别事事包办。
options.t_en: I tend to leave it to the market for commercial development, which is the most efficient, and the government does other things.

options.t: 我认为改造方案该让居民投票共决，涉及人家生计的事不能少数人拍板。
options.t_en: I think that the renovation plan should be voted on by the residents, and matters involving people's livelihoods can not be decided by a few people.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A village in the city needs to be transformed. The original residents are afraid of being moved to the outskirts and small businesses can not be done. The developer calculates the value and profit of the plot. Before the bulldozer, the calculations of all parties were different.

scene: 地铁口常睡着几位无家可归的人，路人绕道走，居民投诉影响环境，社工则说他们无处可去。怎么对待这些人，社区分成两派。

options.t: 我认为政府应建收容所，给人一个能洗漱睡觉的地方，比在街头熬着强。
options.t_en: I think that the government should build shelters to give people a place to wash and sleep, rather than struggling in the streets.

options.t: 我主张禁止在公共区域露宿、定期清场，维护市容和他人的通行环境。
options.t_en: I advocate the prohibition of open sleeping in public areas, regular clearance, and the maintenance of the city's appearance and the passage of others.

options.t: 我支持提供低价甚至免费的公共租赁住房，从源头给无家者一个去处。
options.t_en: I support the provision of low-cost or even free public rental housing, giving the homeless a place to go from the source.

options.t: 我觉得露宿多半是个人选择与责任，公共资源不该无限兜底，自己得站起来。
options.t_en: I think that rough sleeping is mostly a personal choice and responsibility. Public resources should not be infinite, and you have to stand up.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The subway entrance often sleeps a few homeless people, passers-by take detours, residents complain about affecting the environment, and social workers say they have nowhere to go. How these people are treated, the community is divided into two factions.

scene: 一片老城区要重新规划，居民对“楼下能不能开咖啡馆、楼上住人”争执不下：有人要烟火气，有人要清静。

options.t: 我赞成居住和商业混合，楼下买菜吃饭、楼上睡觉，街区才有活力也方便。
options.t_en: I am in favor of mixing living and business, buying food downstairs, sleeping upstairs, the neighborhood is vibrant and convenient.

options.t: 我认为居住区就该纯住、把商业隔到别处，图的就是安静不被打扰。
options.t_en: I think that the residential area should be purely lived in, and the business should be separated elsewhere, and the picture is quiet and undisturbed.

options.t: 我倾向一切按城市规划来定，专业部门划好的用途大家照着执行最省争议。
options.t_en: I prefer that everything is determined according to the city plan, and the purpose of the professional department is planned according to the implementation of the most provincial controversy.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: An old town needs to be re-planned. Residents can't help but argue about whether they can open a cafe downstairs or live upstairs. Some people want fireworks and others want quiet.

scene: 市里有一笔交通预算，是修更多公交地铁、还是拓宽马路、还是画自行车道，市民意见五花八门，通勤族和开车族各执一词。

options.t: 我支持把钱砸在公交和地铁上，载的人多、排放少，惠及的是大多数通勤者。
options.t_en: I support spending money on buses and subways, carrying more people and emitting less, benefiting most commuters.

options.t: 我认为多修路、保畅通最实在，开车的人也是纳税人，路堵了谁都烦。
options.t_en: I think it is most practical to build more roads and keep them unimpeded. The people who drive are also taxpayers. Everyone is annoyed when the roads are blocked.

options.t: 我倾向多画安全自行车道，短途通勤更健康也减碳，城市该给骑行者空间。
options.t_en: I tend to draw more safe bike lanes, short commutes are healthier and less carbon-intensive, and cities should give cyclists space.

options.t: 我觉得交通服务交给市场运营、谁用谁付费最高效，政府别大包大揽。
options.t_en: I think that transportation services are left to the operation of the market, who pays who is the most efficient, and the government is not in a hurry.

options.t: 我主张把线路往郊区辐射，带动新城发展、疏解中心压力。
options.t_en: I advocate radiating the line to the suburbs to drive the development of the new city and relieve the central pressure.

options.t: 我认为投哪条线该看实际客流量数据，钱花在最多人用的地方。
options.t_en: I think which line to put in should look at the actual passenger flow data, and the place where the money is used the most.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: There is a transportation budget in the city. Whether it is to build more bus subways, widen roads, or paint bicycle lanes, the opinions of the public are varied, and commuters and drivers are persistent.

scene: 小区里好几套房子被改成日租民宿，旅客进进出出、半夜喧哗，常住居民不胜其扰，物业却说业主有权处置自己的房。

options.t: 我支持限制住宅区做短租，保住“住”的性质，别让民宿把小区变成旅馆。
options.t_en: I support restricting short-term rentals in residential areas and preserving the nature of "living", and not letting homestays turn neighborhoods into hotels.

options.t: 我认为房子是业主的，租给谁、做不做民宿自己定，邻居不便忍一忍就好。
options.t_en: I think that the house is the owner, who to rent to, do not do the homestay by their own decision, the neighbors are inconvenient to put up with it.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Several houses in the neighborhood have been converted into daily rentals. Travelers enter and exit, and there is a loud noise in the middle of the night. Regular residents are disturbed, but the property says that the owner has the right to dispose of his own house.

scene: 一个没电梯的老楼要装电梯，高层老人盼了多年，低层住户却担心采光、噪音和房价。分摊方案的每一笔账都牵动邻里神经。

options.t: 我认为装电梯全楼受益、费用大家平摊最公平，低层也享受了房产增值。
options.t_en: I think that installing the elevator benefited the whole building, the cost was evenly shared, and the lower floors also enjoyed the added value of the property.

options.t: 我支持让高层多出资、低层免征，谁用得多谁多出，大家才服气。
options.t_en: I support letting the high level invest more and the low level exempt from levy, who uses more and who spends more, everyone will be convinced.

options.t: 我主张政府补贴一部分，减轻居民负担，毕竟便利老人是公共好事。
options.t_en: I advocate partial government subsidies to reduce the burden on residents. After all, it is a public good to facilitate the elderly.

options.t: 我认为低层住户的反对权该被尊重，不能靠多数票硬压少数人的合理顾虑。
options.t_en: I believe that the right of low-level residents to oppose should be respected, and the legitimate concerns of the minority cannot be suppressed by the majority vote.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: An old building without an elevator is to install an elevator. The high-rise elderly have been looking forward to it for many years, but the low-rise residents are worried about lighting, noise and house prices. Neighborhood nerves are involved in every account of the apportionment plan.

scene: 一片滨江地块要开发，方案在公示，但普通市民看不懂图纸，有人想提意见却不知从哪开口。规划到底谁说了算，引发了讨论。

options.t: 我主张重大规划开公众听证，让住在这的人有发言权，而不只是看公示。
options.t_en: I advocate major planning for public hearings, so that people living here have a say, not just publicity.

options.t: 我认为城市是专业活，交给规划专家定最科学，外行参与容易情绪化。
options.t_en: I think the city is a professional job, leave it to the planning experts to determine the most scientific, and the layman's participation is easy to be emotional.

options.t: 我倾向由政府统筹拍板，效率高、能平衡各方，也便于执行落地。
options.t_en: I prefer to be coordinated by the government, which is efficient, balanced, and easy to implement.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A plot of riverside land needs to be developed, and the plan is publicized, but ordinary citizens can't read the drawings. Some people want to make comments, but they don't know where to start. Who is in charge of the planning, which triggered the discussion.

scene: 超市货架上有含转基因原料的食品，价格更便宜，但包装上没写清楚。消费者想知情权，厂商说“安全就不必标”。

options.t: 我认为含转基因就必须强制标出来，安不安全另说，消费者起码该有选择的权利。
options.t_en: I think that if it contains GMOs, it must be mandatory to mark it, and it is unsafe. In addition, consumers should at least have the right to choose.

options.t: 我主张标注时附上科学界的主流结论，既告知又避免无谓恐慌。
options.t_en: I advocate labeling with the mainstream conclusions of the scientific community, both informing and avoiding unnecessary panic.

options.t: 我觉得既然权威评估是安全的，就没必要专门标，标了反而让人瞎担心。
options.t_en: I think that since the authoritative evaluation is safe, there is no need for special marking, and the marking makes people blindly worried.

options.t: 我支持由企业自愿决定标不标，市场会奖励愿意透明的好企业。
options.t_en: I support companies to voluntarily decide not to bid, and the market will reward good companies that are willing to be transparent.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Supermarket shelves with food containing GMO ingredients are cheaper, but the packaging is not clearly written. Consumers want the right to know, and manufacturers say "safety does not have to be labeled".

scene: 标着“有机”的菜比普通菜贵一倍，低收入家庭想给孩子吃好却心疼钱，也有人怀疑“有机”是不是只是营销。

options.t: 我认为该补贴有机农业、把价格打下来，让健康食物不只是有钱人的特权。
options.t_en: I think it's time to subsidize organic farming, put down prices, and make healthy food more than the privilege of the rich.

options.t: 我觉得有机贵是因为成本高，市场定价就好，愿买的人自然买。
options.t_en: I think organic is expensive because of the high cost, the market price is good, people who want to buy naturally buy.

options.t: 我主张狠狠打掉假有机，把“有机”二字管严，别让消费者花冤枉钱。
options.t_en: I advocate vigorously eliminating fake organic, strictly controlling the word "organic", and not letting consumers waste money.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Dishes marked "organic" are twice as expensive as regular dishes, low-income families want to give their children good food but love money, and some people wonder if "organic" is just marketing.

scene: 一家大型养殖场用密集笼养把肉价压得很低，动物保护者拍到拥挤的画面，食客则在便宜和良心间纠结。

options.t: 我认为工厂化养殖效率高、供应稳、价格低，养活这么多人离不开它。
options.t_en: I think factory farming has high efficiency, stable supply and low prices, and it is inseparable from feeding so many people.

options.t: 我支持给养殖设动物福利底线，不能为了便宜把活物逼到没尊严，适度限一限。
options.t_en: I support setting a bottom line for animal welfare for breeding, and living animals cannot be forced to lack dignity for the sake of cheapness, and the limit is moderate.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A large farm used dense cages to keep meat prices low, animal protectors filmed the crowds, and diners struggled between cheapness and conscience.

scene: 一笔农业补贴要发，是给精耕细作的小农户、还是给规模化大农场、还是给生态种植户，各方都在游说，方向怎么定牵动整个产业链。

options.t: 我支持补贴小农户，保住千家万户的生计和乡村的人气，不能让大资本通吃。
options.t_en: I support subsidizing small farmers, preserving the livelihoods of thousands of families and the popularity of the countryside, and not allowing big capital to be eaten up.

options.t: 我认为补贴该流向规模化、高效率的主体，农业要强就得讲产出。
options.t_en: I think that subsidies should flow to large-scale and efficient subjects, and if agriculture is to be strong, it must talk about output.

options.t: 我主张把补贴倾斜给生态种植，护土护水，这笔钱花在可持续上。
options.t_en: I advocate that subsidies be tilted to ecological planting, soil conservation and water conservation, and that the money be spent on sustainability.

options.t: 我倾向按产量发补贴，多产多补，简单也激励生产。
options.t_en: I tend to subsidize according to production volume, which is more productive and supplementary, and it is simple and also stimulates production.

options.t: 我觉得农业也该逐步退出补贴、走向市场，靠保护长不出竞争力。
options.t_en: I think that agriculture should also gradually withdraw from subsidies and go to the market, and rely on protection to remain competitive.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: An agricultural subsidy should be issued to small farmers who are intensive farmers, large-scale farms, or ecological farmers. All parties are lobbying, and how to determine the direction affects the entire industrial chain.

scene: 一款新食品添加剂申请上市，审批尺度松紧成了焦点：松了企业欢迎、消费者担心，严了安全但拖慢创新。

options.t: 我主张添加剂审批从严，入口的东西宁可慢一点、也别拿健康赌方便。
options.t_en: I advocate strict approval of additives, the entrance of things would rather slow down, but also do not take health gambling convenience.

options.t: 我支持参考国际通行标准，别自搞一套把企业卡死，也方便贸易。
options.t_en: I support referring to the international standards, do not do a set of stuck companies, but also facilitate trade.

options.t: 我认为企业该为自己的产品安全负责，监管给框架、企业担主责。
options.t_en: I believe that companies should be responsible for their own product safety, and supervision is the responsibility of the framework and the company.

options.t: 我要求所有添加剂明明白白标在包装上，让消费者看得懂、能避开。
options.t_en: I require all additives to be clearly labeled on the packaging so that consumers can understand and avoid them.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: A new food additive application was put on the market, and the approval scale became the focus: loosening the welcome of enterprises, consumers' concerns, and tightening safety but slowing innovation.

scene: 学校食堂招标，供应商问要不要优先用本地农场的菜，本地派说减碳扶农，外地派说性价比高。采购单怎么写有了分歧。

options.t: 我支持优先采购本地食材，运得近、碳排少，也帮了周边农户。
options.t_en: I support preferential sourcing of local ingredients, close proximity, low carbon emissions, and helping nearby farmers.

options.t: 我认为食堂该看性价比，哪便宜哪好就买哪，纳税人的钱要花值。
options.t_en: I think the canteen should look at the price/performance ratio, buy wherever it is cheap, and the taxpayer's money will be worth it.

options.t: 我倾向本地和外地均衡着来，既照顾减碳也不牺牲成本，两头都顾。
options.t_en: I tend to balance local and foreign, taking care of carbon reduction without sacrificing costs, both sides.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: In the bidding for the school canteen, the supplier asked whether to prioritize the use of local farm dishes, the local pie said to reduce carbon and support agriculture, and the foreign pie said that it was cost-effective. How the purchase order was written is different.

scene: 公司食堂想多推素食日，环保者叫好，无肉不欢的同事皱眉，行政在“倡导”和“强制”之间拿捏。

options.t: 我支持用政策鼓励大家多吃素，畜牧业碳排高，这是个人人都可做的环保。
options.t_en: I support the use of policies to encourage everyone to be vegetarian, and livestock has high carbon emissions, which is something that individuals can do for the environment.

options.t: 我认为吃素吃肉是个人自由，公家不该掺和别人的饭碗。
options.t_en: I think that eating vegetarian meat is a personal freedom, and the public should not mix with other people's jobs.

options.t: 我主张食堂多设几个素菜窗口，给想吃的人方便，但不强求谁吃。
options.t_en: I advocate setting up a few more vegetarian windows in the canteen, which is convenient for those who want to eat, but I do not force anyone to eat.

options.t: 我支持补贴植物肉，把替代蛋白价格打下来，让环保选择不那么贵。
options.t_en: I support subsidizing vegetable meat and lowering the price of alternative proteins to make eco-friendly options less expensive.

options.t: 我反对任何形式的强制素食，倡导可以，逼人就过界了。
options.t_en: I am opposed to any form of mandatory vegetarianism, advocating that you can, forcing people to cross the line.

options.t: 我对吃素还是吃肉没执念，食堂有啥我吃啥。
options.t_en: I am not obsessed with vegetarianism or eating meat, what is in the canteen I eat.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The company's canteen wants to push vegetarian food days more, environmentalists shout good, meatless colleagues frown, and the administration squeezes between "advocacy" and "compulsion".

scene: 本国主食有一部分靠进口，国际一波动国内就紧张。有人要保自给，有人说全球买更便宜。饭碗该攥多紧，吵了起来。

options.t: 我主张关键口粮必须自己种，饭碗攥自己手里才不怕别人卡脖子。
options.t_en: I advocate that the key rations must be cultivated by themselves, and I am not afraid of others getting stuck in my own hands.

options.t: 我认为全球买更便宜高效，把贸易当供应链就好，不必样样自己产。
options.t_en: I think that global buying is cheaper and more efficient, and trade is just a supply chain, so you don't have to produce it yourself.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Part of the domestic staple food is imported, and international fluctuations and domestic tensions. Some want to be self-sufficient, others say the world is cheaper to buy. How tightly should the rice bowl be clenched and quarreled.

scene: 种粮大户一年到头挣得不如进城打工多，年轻人全往外跑，村里只剩老人。怎么让种地的人富起来，成了难题。

options.t: 我支持国家提价、保底收购粮食，让农民种地有底气的收入。
options.t_en: I support the state to raise prices and ensure the purchase of grain, so that farmers can have a solid income from farming.

options.t: 我认为根本是让农民去非农岗位挣钱，死守一亩三分地富不起来。
options.t_en: I think it is fundamentally to let farmers go to non-agricultural jobs to earn money, and it is impossible to get rich by sticking to one mu of land.

options.t: 我主张给农业补贴再加政策性保险，灾年不返贫、平时有托底。
options.t_en: I advocate adding policy-based insurance to agricultural subsidies, so that the year of disaster does not return to poverty and there is usually support.

options.t: 我倾向推动土地流转、规模经营，把成本摊薄、效益提上去。
options.t_en: I tend to promote land circulation and scale management, and raise cost dilution and benefits.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: Large grain-growing households do not earn as much as working in the city year-round. Young people are all running out, and only the elderly are left in the village. How to make the cultivators rich became a problem.

scene: 婚宴散场，整盘整盘的菜被倒掉，有人心疼有人觉得“排场就得这样”。光盘行动喊了多年，餐桌上的浪费却还在。

options.t: 我支持立法对严重食物浪费开罚，规矩立起来，浪费才会收敛。
options.t_en: I support legislation to impose penalties for serious food waste, and the rules will be up and the waste will be converged.

options.t: 我认为主要靠倡导和教育，润物细无声比罚款更长远。
options.t_en: I think mainly through advocacy and education, the moisturizing silence is longer than the fine.

options.t: 我倾向用市场调节，剩菜打折、按份计价，价格自然会让人少点。
options.t_en: I prefer to use the market to adjust, leftovers are discounted and priced per share, and the price will naturally make people less.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: After the wedding banquet, the whole plate of dishes was poured out, and some people were distressed. Some people felt that "the arrangement should be like this". After years of shouting about Operation CD-ROM, the waste at the dinner table was still there.

scene: 一条假消息在群里疯传，害得一家公司股价跳水，平台说“我们只是通道”，监管说“该管”，读者则一脸懵。假新闻这球该踢给谁。

options.t: 我认为平台对假新闻该担责、主动删，既然你靠流量赚钱，就得对内容负责。
options.t_en: I think the platform should take responsibility for fake news and take the initiative to delete it. Since you make money from traffic, you must be responsible for the content.

options.t: 我支持独立的第三方事实核查，不依附平台也不依附政府，由它来证伪。
options.t_en: I support independent third-party fact-checking, which does not depend on the platform or the government to falsify.

options.t: 我觉得提高读者媒介素养、自己分辨最实在，管来管去不如让人人会看。
options.t_en: I think that improving the reader's media literacy and self-identification is the most real, and it is better to let everyone see it.

options.t: 我主张由政府出面权威辟谣，公信力在那，能最快止血。
options.t_en: I advocate that the government come forward to authoritatively dispel the rumors. The credibility is there, and it can stop the bleeding as soon as possible.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: A fake news spread wildly in the crowd, causing a company's stock price to plunge, the platform said "we are just a channel", the supervision said "the pipe", and the reader was bewildered. Who should the ball be kicked to in the Fake News.

scene: 一家全国性媒体要改制，是收归公有、还是私营化、还是混合，争论背后是“话语权该握在谁手里”。

options.t: 我支持公营但保持多元编辑独立，让媒体既不被资本绑架也不被权力指挥。
options.t_en: I support the public sector but maintain pluralistic editorial independence, so that the media is neither kidnapped by capital nor directed by power.

options.t: 我认为媒体私营、自由竞争最好，市场会淘汰不靠谱的，也最不容易一家独大。
options.t_en: I think that private media and free competition are the best, and the market will eliminate the unreliable ones, and it is also the least easy for a family to be alone.

options.t: 我倾向公有私营混合，各有侧重、互相补充，比单一结构更稳。
options.t_en: I tend to mix public and private, each with its own focus, complementary to each other, and more stable than a single structure.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: A national media should be restructured, whether it should be publicly owned, privatized, or mixed. Behind the debate is "who should hold the right to speak".

scene: 一位记者掌握了一起弊案的内幕，线索人要求保密，但司法机关为破案想逼记者交出名字。保不保线人，成了新闻自由的试金石。

options.t: 我认为记者的消息源必须受保护，否则再没人敢爆料，监督就死了。
options.t_en: I think that journalists' sources must be protected, otherwise no one will dare to break the news, and supervision will die.

options.t: 我主张若线索涉及严重犯罪，司法机关在法定程序下可以查，保密不是包庇犯罪的盾牌。
options.t_en: I advocate that if the clues involve serious crimes, the judicial organs can investigate them under the statutory procedures, and confidentiality is not a shield to cover crimes.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A journalist has uncovered details of a corruption case. The informant requests confidentiality, but the judicial authorities, eager to solve the case, try to force the journalist to reveal his name. The question of whether or not to protect the informant becomes a litmus test for press freedom.

scene: 你发现新闻App越推越合你口味，慢慢别的立场几乎看不见了。有人警觉“信息茧房”，有人觉得“我乐意看喜欢的”。

options.t: 我选择关掉算法、改用订阅，自己挑媒体和话题，把主动权拿回来。
options.t_en: I chose to turn off the algorithm, switch to subscriptions, pick my own media and topics, and take back the initiative.

options.t: 我支持平台在推送里强制混入不同立场，故意打破茧房、让人看见对立面。
options.t_en: I support the platform to force different positions in the push, deliberately breaking the cocoon room and making people see the opposite.

options.t: 我要求算法对用户透明、可手动调节权重，让我决定想被推什么。
options.t_en: I ask the algorithm to be transparent to the user, manually adjust the weights, and let me decide what I want to be pushed.

options.t: 我觉得推送省心就好，刷着顺就完了，茧房不茧房无所谓。
options.t_en: I think pushing is fine, brushing is the end, Cocoon House does not matter.

options.t: 我主张监管出手防止算法把人关进茧房，这关乎整个社会的认知健康。
options.t_en: I advocate supervision to prevent the algorithm from locking people into the cocoon room, which is related to the cognitive health of the whole society.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: You find that the news app pushes more and more to your taste, and slowly other positions are almost invisible. Some people are alert to the "information cocoon house", and some people feel that "I would like to see what I like".

scene: 一家公共电台靠收年费运转，有人觉得该全民交、有人觉得凭什么强制、还有人说干脆市场化。

options.t: 我认为公共广播该收强制视听费，像基础设施一样人人分摊，才保得住质量。
options.t_en: I think that public broadcasting should be mandatory audio-visual fees, like infrastructure, shared by everyone, in order to maintain quality.

options.t: 我支持靠听众自愿捐赠维持，不愿交的人不该被强收。
options.t_en: I support voluntary donations from listeners, and those who do not want to pay should not be forcibly collected.

options.t: 我主张由财政拨款，公共广播是公共服务，用税收养理所应当。
options.t_en: I advocate the allocation of funds by the government. Public broadcasting is a public service, and the use of taxation is a matter of course.

options.t: 我认为公共广播也可以走商业化、自己造血，少伸手要钱。
options.t_en: I think public broadcasting can also be commercialized, make your own blood, and ask for money with less hands.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A public radio station runs on an annual fee. Some people think that it should be paid by the whole people, some people think that it is mandatory, and some people say that it is simply market-oriented.

scene: 同一件事，两家媒体写出截然相反的稿子，读者骂“你们都不客观”。媒体到底该中立还是放飞自我，吵个不停。

options.t: 我认为媒体就该中立客观，把事实摆清、评论分开，别夹带立场。
options.t_en: I think the media should be neutral and objective, clear up the facts, separate the comments, and do not take a stand.

options.t: 我支持立场多元并存，读者自己挑合胃口的，市场会自然平衡。
options.t_en: I support the coexistence of multiple positions, and the market will naturally balance if readers pick their own appetites.

options.t: 我倾向把选择权交给读者，媒体各有角度无所谓，你不爱看换一家。
options.t_en: I tend to leave the choice to the reader. It doesn't matter if the media has different perspectives. You don't like to change houses.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: In the same matter, the two media wrote the opposite manuscript, and the readers yelled that "you are not objective". Whether the media should be neutral or self-releasing and keep arguing.

scene: 一位明星的私生活被狗仔跟拍，报道点击爆棚，编辑说“读者爱看”，律师说“侵犯隐私”。公众人物的私事，媒体能挖多深。

options.t: 我主张对公众人物的纯私生活报道应设限，名气大也不等于隐私清零。
options.t_en: I advocate that reports on the purely private life of public figures should be limited, and fame does not mean privacy clearance.

options.t: 我认为媒体对公众人物有更宽的报道空间，关注度本身就是新闻价值。
options.t_en: I think the media has a wider coverage space for public figures, and attention is itself a newsworthy value.

options.t: 我支持“与公共利益有关”的私事可报、无关的别碰，划清这条线。
options.t_en: I support "public interest related" personal matters can be reported, irrelevant, do not touch, draw this line.

options.t: 我认为私人生活应被严格保护，媒体不该拿别人的家事当流量。
options.t_en: I believe that private life should be strictly protected, and the media should not take other people's housework as traffic.

options.t: 说实话这种八卦我爱看，点击我也贡献了，有人看就有人写。
options.t_en: To tell you the truth, I love to watch this kind of gossip. I also contributed by clicking on it, and if someone reads it, someone writes it.

options.t: 我倾向靠行业自律，媒体自己把好分寸，比外部硬管更可持续。
options.t_en: I tend to rely on the self-discipline of the industry, and the media puts it in a good position to be more sustainable than the external hard tube.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A celebrity's private life was followed by a paparazzi, the report clicked on the shed, the editor said "readers love to see", and the lawyer said "invasion of privacy". How deeply the media can dig into the private affairs of public figures.

scene: 一个段子号把真实新闻改得面目全非来搞笑，有人笑到转发，有人气得说“这是在误导人”。讽刺和误导的边界在哪。

options.t: 我认为讽刺恶搞该受表达自由保护，幽默和批评本就是社会的疫苗。
options.t_en: I think satire should be protected by freedom of expression, and humor and criticism are the vaccines of society.

options.t: 我主张对容易让人信以为真的恶搞设限，搞笑不能踩过误导的线。
options.t_en: I advocate setting limits on spoofing that is easy to believe, and funny people can't step on misleading lines.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: A segment number changed the real news into something more than funny. Some people laughed and forwarded it, and some people were so angry that they said, "This is misleading people." Where are the boundaries of irony and misinformation?

scene: 山区的孩子靠手机流量查资料、城里的孩子用千兆宽带，同一张试卷背后是信息条件的落差。怎么补这道沟。

options.t: 我支持政府出钱把网络和信息设备普及到薄弱地区，知识获取不能看家境。
options.t_en: I support the government to pay for the spread of network and information equipment to weak areas, and the acquisition of knowledge can not be seen at home.

options.t: 我觉得这类服务市场提供就行，发达地区先享受、再慢慢扩散。
options.t_en: I think that this kind of service market can be provided, and developed regions enjoy it first and then slowly spread.

options.t: 我主张建免费公共图书馆和上网点，给没条件的人一个落脚点。
options.t_en: I advocate building free public libraries and Internet access to give people without conditions a foothold.

options.t: 我看好公益项目进山区，捐设备、教用法，补上市场不愿去的盲区。
options.t_en: I am optimistic about public welfare projects entering the mountainous areas, donating equipment, teaching usage, and making up for the blind spots that the market is unwilling to go to.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: Children in mountainous areas rely on mobile phone traffic to check data, and children in the city use gigabit broadband. Behind the same test paper is the gap in information conditions. How to fill this ditch.

scene: 一家媒体发错了一篇稿，读者要求更正，编辑部内部对“该不该强制更正、由谁裁”有分歧。

options.t: 我认为媒体发错就必须强制更正，错了不认比错本身更伤信任。
options.t_en: I think that if the media makes a mistake, it must be forced to correct it. Wrong denial hurts trust more than wrong itself.

options.t: 我倾向让媒体自己决定更不更正，外部强逼反而容易变成工具。
options.t_en: I tend to let the media decide for themselves to be more uncorrected, and external coercion is easy to turn into a tool.

options.t: 我支持由独立第三方仲裁纠错争议，既给读者出口、也不让媒体被随意指使。
options.t_en: I support the arbitration of error correction disputes by an independent third party, both for export to the reader and without the media being arbitrarily directed.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A media outlet sent a wrong manuscript, and readers asked for corrections. There was a disagreement within the editorial department about whether to force corrections and who should make them.

scene: 市里一笔治安预算，是多加巡逻警车、还是投到青少年中心和就业帮扶上，议员和居民吵得凶：一边要眼前的平安，一边要治本。

options.t: 我支持多招警察、加巡逻，犯罪高发区最缺的就是看得见的警力。
options.t_en: I support more police and patrols. What is most lacking in crime-prone areas is visible police.

options.t: 我认为把钱投到社会服务、从源头减少犯罪，比事后抓人更划算。
options.t_en: I think it is more cost-effective to put money into social services and reduce crime from the source than to arrest people afterwards.

options.t: 我主张两边平衡着投，当下的安全和长远的根因都不能偏废。
options.t_en: I advocate balanced casting on both sides, and the current security and long-term root causes can not be neglected.

options.t: 我倾向削减警察、增强社区自治和调解力量，靠邻里互助比靠警棍更可持续。
options.t_en: I tend to reduce the police, increase community autonomy and mediation, and rely on neighborhood support is more sustainable than a baton.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A public security budget in the city, whether it is more patrol police cars, or invested in youth centers and employment assistance, parliamentarians and residents are fiercely noisy: while the immediate peace, while treating the root cause.

scene: 一位刚入狱的犯人，监狱该拿他怎么办——是让他吃苦赎罪、还是教他手艺重返社会，狱政理念之争由来已久。

options.t: 我认为监狱的目的应是改造、帮人洗心革面重返社会，否则出来还是祸害。
options.t_en: I think the purpose of prisons should be to reform and reform people's hearts and minds and reintegrate into society, otherwise it will be a disaster to come out.

options.t: 我主张犯过错就该受罚、付出代价，惩罚本身就有正当性。
options.t_en: I advocate that if you make a mistake, you should be punished and pay the price, and the punishment itself is justified.

options.t: 我认为监狱首要是把危险的人隔开、保护社会，其他都是次要的。
options.t_en: I think prisons are primarily about separating dangerous people and protecting society, and everything else is secondary.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: What should a prisoner who has just been incarcerated do with him - whether to make him suffer and atone for his sins, or to teach him how to rejoin society, the battle over the concept of prison administration has been going on for a long time.

scene: 一名十六岁少年参与了严重暴力案件，是按成人追究、还是走少审特护，法庭和社会都在权衡：罚还是救。

options.t: 我认为手段残忍、危害大的未成年人也该按成人追究，年龄不该是免罪金牌。
options.t_en: I think that minors who are cruel and harmful should also be prosecuted by adults, and age should not be a gold medal for impunity.

options.t: 我主张未成年人走专门少审、以教育和保护为主，孩子的大脑和责任能力都未长成。
options.t_en: I advocate that minors go through special low-level trials and focus on education and protection, and that the child's brain and responsibility are not developed.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A 16-year-old boy was involved in a serious case of violence. Whether he was prosecuted as an adult or was given special protection under trial, the court and society were weighing: punishment or salvation.

scene: 一种软性毒品在邻国合法化后，本地关于“要不要放开”的争论被点燃：医疗派说能减害，保守派说会泛滥。

options.t: 我支持把这类物质纳入医疗监管、按医嘱使用，减害比一味禁更有效。
options.t_en: I support the inclusion of such substances in medical supervision and use according to medical instructions, and it is more effective to reduce harm than to ban them.

options.t: 我认为毒品就该全面禁止，任何松动都会让更多人坠入成瘾。
options.t_en: I think that drugs should be completely banned, and any loosening will cause more people to fall into addiction.

options.t: 我倾向把成年人纯粹自用非罪化，国家管贩卖、不管个人身体选择。
options.t_en: I tend to decriminalize purely self-use by adults, with the state regulating trafficking regardless of individual physical choices.

options.t: 我主张对涉毒一律严刑，用最强威慑守住底线。
options.t_en: I advocate harsh punishment for all drug-related incidents, and defending the bottom line with the strongest deterrence.

options.t: 说实话我反对任何形式的放开，毒品带来的家庭破碎我看太多了。
options.t_en: To be honest, I'm against any kind of letting go, and the family breakdown brought about by drugs is too much for me to watch.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: After a soft drug was legalized in neighboring countries, the local debate over whether to let go was ignited: medical schools said it would reduce harm, and conservatives said it would flood.

scene: 小区治安变差，几位居民自发组了巡逻队、还打算配装备，物业欢迎，警察却担心“民间武装”出问题。

options.t: 我支持居民自发巡逻互助，邻里看着邻里，安全感和人情都回来了。
options.t_en: I support residents to patrol and help each other spontaneously, and the neighborhood looks at the neighborhood, and the sense of security and friendship has returned.

options.t: 我认为治安该交给专业警察，业余巡逻既不规范也容易出乱子。
options.t_en: I think that public security should be left to professional police, and amateur patrols are both irregular and prone to disorder.

options.t: 我主张民间巡逻可以存在，但权力要受限、并向警方备案接受监督。
options.t_en: I advocate that civilian patrols can exist, but have limited power and be supervised by the police.

options.t: 我反对居民私自配装备组队，民间持械巡逻太容易走火，风险大于收益。
options.t_en: I am opposed to residents illegally deploying equipment to form teams. Civilian armed patrols are too easy to get away with, and the risks are greater than the benefits.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The security in the community deteriorated. Several residents spontaneously set up patrols and planned to equip them. The property welcomed them, but the police were worried about the problem of "civilian armed forces".

scene: 一个人第三次因同类轻罪被抓，法官在“是不是该加重”和“他是不是有难处”之间纠结。累犯该怎么对待。

options.t: 我主张对屡教不改的累犯递进加重，不痛不痒的处罚只会养出老油条。
options.t_en: I advocate the gradual aggravation of repeat offenders who repeatedly teach and do not change. Punishment that is not painful and itchy will only raise old oil bars.

options.t: 我认为得看他为什么反复犯，是生计所迫还是恶意，不能一刀切加重。
options.t_en: I think it depends on why he repeatedly committed crimes, whether it was forced by livelihood or malicious, and it can't be aggravated one-size-fits-all.

options.t: 我倾向依旧以改造为主，累犯往往更弱势，拉一把比压一压更能断根。
options.t_en: I still tend to focus on transformation, recidivism is often more vulnerable, pulling a more than pressing a root can be broken.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A person was arrested for a third time for a misdemeanor of the same kind, and the judge struggled between "whether it should be aggravated" and "whether he had difficulties". What to do with recidivism.

scene: 一条商业街要装人脸摄像头防扒手，商家叫好，路人担心“走到哪被看到哪”。安全与隐私的天平怎么摆。

options.t: 我支持在公共区域全面布控，犯罪怕被拍，安全感来自看得见的天眼。
options.t_en: I support comprehensive control in public areas. Crime is afraid of being photographed, and the sense of security comes from the visible heavenly eyes.

options.t: 我主张只在重点时段、重点区域装，既防罪也不把人全罩进镜头。
options.t_en: I advocate installing it only in key time periods and key areas, neither preventing crimes nor covering people in the camera.

options.t: 我倾向少装、把自由留给人，被全天候盯着的社会让人窒息。
options.t_en: I tend to dress less, leave freedom to others, and suffocate in a society that is stared at around the clock.

options.t: 我支持由社区自愿决定在自家范围装不装，自下而上、不靠强制。
options.t_en: I support the community's voluntary decision not to dress up at home, from the bottom up, and without coercion.

options.t: 我认为摄像可用，但要定规矩、限留存，在安全和人权间找平衡点。
options.t_en: I believe that cameras are available, but there are rules, limits, and a balance between safety and human rights.

options.t: 我对装不装摄像头没啥感觉，只要别拍进我家就行。
options.t_en: I don't feel like installing a camera, as long as I don't shoot into my house.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A commercial street should be equipped with face camera pickpockets, and the merchants shouted, and passers-by were worried about "where to go and where to be seen". What's the balance of security and privacy?

scene: 一位因小额盗窃被定罪的母亲，要不要送进监狱成了难题：收监孩子没人管，不收又怕没威慑。

options.t: 我支持对轻罪用社区服务、缓刑等非监禁方式，关进去反而毁了家庭、也费公帑。
options.t_en: I support the use of non-custodial methods such as community service and probation for misdemeanors. Instead, imprisonment destroys the family and also costs the public money.

options.t: 我主张轻罪也收监，才能形成威慑，否则违法成本太低人人敢试。
options.t_en: I advocate that misdemeanors are also imprisoned in order to form a deterrent, otherwise the cost of violating the law is too low. Everyone dares to try.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: A mother convicted of petty theft, whether to go to jail has become a difficult problem: incarcerated children are left unattended, not confiscated and afraid of no deterrence.

scene: 一位被抢劫的店主，损失不小，凶手没钱赔。钱该由谁出、怎么补上受害者的窟窿，各方看法不一。

options.t: 我认为国家应先垫付赔偿给受害者，再去向罪犯追偿，不能让好人自己扛。
options.t_en: I think the state should pay compensation to the victims first, and then go to the criminals to recover it, and can't let the good people carry it on their own.

options.t: 我主张赔偿主体就是罪犯，自己作的孽自己还，公家不该兜底。
options.t_en: I advocate that the subject of compensation is a criminal, and the sins he has committed should be repaid by himself, and the public should not go behind the scenes.

options.t: 我支持用犯罪保险来覆盖，事前投保、事后理赔，市场化的解法。
options.t_en: I support the use of crime insurance to cover, pre-insurance, after-the-fact claims, and market-oriented solutions.

options.t: 我倾向用社会救助基金补一部分，靠社会互助接住受害的人。
options.t_en: I prefer to use the social assistance fund to supplement some of the victims, and rely on social mutual assistance to catch the victims.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: A shopkeeper who was robbed, the loss was not small, and the murderer had no money to pay for it. There were differing views on who should pay and how to make up for the victims' holes.

scene: 两个犯同罪的被告，一个请得起顶级律师、一个靠指派律师，判决结果差了一截。法律面前，钱是不是悄悄分了三六九等。

options.t: 我认为量刑必须有统一标准、不因财富而漂移，公平是司法的底线。
options.t_en: I believe that sentencing must have a uniform standard and not be drifted by wealth, and fairness is the bottom line of justice.

options.t: 我觉得请好律师本来就是优势，财富带来的影响在所难免，现实如此。
options.t_en: I think that hiring a good lawyer is an advantage, and the impact of wealth is inevitable. This is the reality.

options.t: 我主张把量刑逻辑公开透明，让偏差能被看见和纠正，比假装不存在强。
options.t_en: I advocate making the sentencing logic open and transparent so that deviations can be seen and corrected, which is better than pretending that they do not exist.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Two defendants who committed the same crime, one who could afford a top lawyer and one who relied on an assigned lawyer, had a poor verdict. Before the law, was the money quietly divided into 369 grades?

scene: 本国经济也不宽裕，政府却打算拿出一笔钱援建邻国的基础设施。有人说是软实力投资，有人问“自家事都没办好”。

options.t: 我支持多对外援助，帮别人也是攒国际信誉和影响力，长远有利。
options.t_en: I support more foreign aid. Helping others is also saving international credibility and influence, which is beneficial in the long run.

options.t: 我认为钱该先花在国内民生，自家百姓还没顾好就往外撒不合理。
options.t_en: I think that money should be spent on the people's livelihood at home first, and it is unreasonable to sprinkle it outside before the people themselves take care of it.

options.t: 我倾向做互利的合作援助，既帮人也能换来对等的经贸好处。
options.t_en: I tend to do mutually beneficial cooperation and assistance, both helping people and exchanging reciprocal economic and trade benefits.

options.t: 我主张少援助、把资源留给本国，对外大方不如对内务实。
options.t_en: I advocate less aid, leaving resources to the country, foreign generosity is not as pragmatic as at home.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: The domestic economy is also poor, but the government intends to spend a sum of money to build infrastructure in neighboring countries. Some people say that it is a soft power investment, and some people ask, "My own affairs are not well done."

scene: 一项新国际条约对本国某些行业不利，签字还是不签字，国内争论：守约讲信用，还是主权优先。

options.t: 我认为签了的条约就该守，国际信用比一时的行业得失重要。
options.t_en: I think that the signed treaty should be respected, and international credit is more important than the profits and losses of the industry for a while.

options.t: 我主张本国主权优先，条约若伤根本利益就不该被它绑住。
options.t_en: I advocate that the sovereignty of the country takes precedence, and if the treaty hurts the fundamental interests, it should not be tied by it.

options.t: 我倾向看条约对本国有利就守、不利就灵活，国家利益是第一标尺。
options.t_en: I tend to be flexible when treaties are beneficial or unfavorable to my country, and national interests are the first criterion.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: A new international treaty is unfavorable to some industries in the country. Whether to sign or not to sign it. Domestic disputes: whether to abide by the contract is credible, or sovereignty is preferred.

scene: 几个国家邀本国加入一个新的多边联盟，支持者说抱团更有话语权，顾虑者说会失了自主。

options.t: 我支持积极参与多边联盟，单打独斗不如抱团，议程才有份。
options.t_en: I support active participation in multilateral alliances. It is better to fight alone than to hold a group, and the agenda will have a part.

options.t: 我主张保持独立、不被联盟绑住手脚，自主决策最要紧。
options.t_en: I advocate maintaining independence, not being tied down by the alliance, and autonomous decision-making is the most important.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Several countries invited their countries to join a new multilateral alliance, with supporters saying they would have more say in the group and worries that they would lose autonomy.

scene: 一国陷入动荡，联合国呼吁成员国出兵维和，本国议会对“出不出兵”吵翻天：人道与风险拉扯。

options.t: 我认为该参与维和，稳定局势、止住流血是国际责任。
options.t_en: I believe that it is an international responsibility to participate in peacekeeping to stabilize the situation and stop the bloodshed.

options.t: 我主张不干涉他国内政，出兵容易陷进去、也违背不干涉原则。
options.t_en: I advocate non-interference in the internal affairs of other countries. Sending troops is easy to fall into and violates the principle of non-interference.

options.t: 我倾向在明确授权、限期、不涉一方的条件下参与，谨慎兜底。
options.t_en: I tend to participate with clear authorization, deadlines, and no one involved, and be cautious.

options.t: 我支持只出人道主义援助、不派作战兵力，救人可以、打仗不行。
options.t_en: I support only humanitarian aid and do not send combat troops. You can save people or fight wars.

options.t: 我认为干脆不出兵，战乱的深坑别蹚，保住自家子弟兵要紧。
options.t_en: I think that it is important to not send troops at all, to avoid the deep pits of war, and to keep our own children and soldiers.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: A country is in turmoil, the United Nations calls on member states to send troops to peacekeeping, and their parliaments are clamoring for "no troops": humanitarianism and risk pulling.

scene: 一国行为引发公愤，盟友呼吁一起制裁，本国在“跟不跟、怎么制裁”上权衡：施压有效，但经贸也受伤。

options.t: 我支持多边联合制裁，人多力量大、才逼得动对方。
options.t_en: I support multilateral joint sanctions. It takes a lot of people to force each other to move.

options.t: 我主张不单边搞制裁，容易伤己也缺合法性，要跟多边走。
options.t_en: I advocate not unilaterally engaging in sanctions, but easily injuring oneself and lacking legitimacy. We should follow the multilateral approach.

options.t: 我倾向慎用制裁、保住本国经贸利益，别为出气赔了里子。
options.t_en: I tend to use sanctions cautiously to protect my country's economic and trade interests, and don't lose money for the sake of venting.

options.t: 我认为制裁要开人道豁免，不能让普通百姓为政权行为买单。
options.t_en: I believe that sanctions should be humanitarian exemptions, and ordinary people should not be allowed to pay for the regime's actions.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The behavior of a country triggered public outrage, allies called for sanctions together, and the country weighed on "not following and how to sanction": pressure was effective, but economic and trade were also hurt.

scene: 政府打算拨一笔钱做对外文化展演，有人说是软名片，有人觉得钱该省下来办事。

options.t: 我支持大力推文化交流，让外界懂我们、也减少误解，价值长远。
options.t_en: I support vigorously promoting cultural exchanges, so that the outside world can understand us, reduce misunderstandings, and have long-term value.

options.t: 我认为适度搞就好，过犹不及，钱得花在刀刃上。
options.t_en: I think it's good to do it in moderation, it's too late, and the money needs to be spent on the blade.

options.t: 我倾向让文化交流靠市场驱动，有需求自然有人做，不必财政硬推。
options.t_en: I tend to let cultural exchanges be driven by the market, and people naturally do it when there is a demand, without having to push hard financially.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The government intends to allocate a sum of money for foreign cultural exhibitions. Some people say that it is a soft business card, and some people think that money should be saved for business.

scene: 一项全球环保计划要各国分摊资金，富国说该多出、穷国说本国优先、还有人喊自愿。账单怎么分，吵成一团。

options.t: 我认为富国该多担，能力大的多出力，全球议题不能搞平均主义。
options.t_en: I believe that rich countries should shoulder more, have more capacity and contribute more, and global issues cannot be egalitarian.

options.t: 我主张按各国实际能力分摊，公平也科学，谁扛得住谁多扛。
options.t_en: I advocate sharing according to the actual capacity of each country, fair and scientific, who can bear who can bear who can bear how much.

options.t: 我倾向各国均等分摊，国家不论大小、一视同仁。
options.t_en: I prefer to share equally among countries, no matter how big or small, without discrimination.

options.t: 我支持自愿承担，强扭的瓜不甜，愿意出多少由各自主张。
options.t_en: I support voluntary commitment. Strong melons are not sweet. How much they are willing to give is up to each other.

options.t: 我认为本国利益优先，全球的事往后排，先顾自家人。
options.t_en: I believe that the interests of the country take precedence, the global affairs are in the back row, and I take care of my family first.

options.t: 我主张用市场机制解决，碳交易之类让价格去分配，比摊派灵活。
options.t_en: I advocate using market mechanisms, such as carbon trading, to allow prices to be allocated, which is more flexible than apportionment.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A global environmental plan requires countries to share the funding, rich countries say it should be more, poor countries say it is their priority, and some people call for voluntarism. How to divide the bill, a quarrel.

scene: 国际法庭就一起海洋争端作出裁决，对本国不利，政府内部在“服不服从”上分歧：遵守显弱，拒绝伤法统。

options.t: 我认为既然入了公约就该服从裁决，守规则才有国际秩序的信任。
options.t_en: I believe that since we have entered the Convention, we should obey the ruling, and there is trust in the international order to abide by the rules.

options.t: 我主张涉及核心主权的事可豁免，法庭的管辖权不该无限延伸。
options.t_en: I advocate that matters involving core sovereignty can be exempted, and the jurisdiction of the court should not be extended indefinitely.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The International Tribunal ruled on a maritime dispute, to the detriment of the country, and there were differences within the government on "obedience and disobedience": compliance was weak, and the law was rejected.

scene: 高校想扩大招收外国留学生、也送本国学生出去，有人看到的是理解桥梁，有人担心规模和安全。

options.t: 我支持扩招留学生，年轻人互相读懂对方，是长久的理解投资。
options.t_en: I support the expansion of international students. Young people read each other and understand each other, which is a long-term investment in understanding.

options.t: 我主张控制规模、把好安全关，敞太开容易出问题。
options.t_en: I advocate controlling the scale and turning off the safety. Opening up too much is prone to problems.

options.t: 我认为按能力择优就好，不论来源，质量第一。
options.t_en: I think it is good to be merit-based, regardless of source, quality first.

options.t: 我支持用公费做互换项目，让普通家庭的孩子也有走出去的机会。
options.t_en: I support the use of public funds for exchange projects, so that children from ordinary families have the opportunity to go out.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: Colleges and universities want to expand the recruitment of foreign students and also send foreign students out. Some people see bridges of understanding, and some worry about scale and safety.

scene: 一家跨国公司在多国运营、在最低税地注册，各国都想管又都管不住。监管权该归谁，成了难题。

options.t: 我认为该国际协同监管，企业全球跑、规则也得全球跟，不然就钻空子。
options.t_en: I think that the international coordinated supervision, the enterprise global running, the rules also have to be global, or drill in the gap.

options.t: 我主张本国管好境内的事就行，国际协同太慢也易被绑架。
options.t_en: I advocate that countries take good care of their own territory, and international cooperation is too slow and easy to be kidnapped.

options.t: 我倾向让企业自律、定行业准则，外部管太多会扼杀活力。
options.t_en: I tend to let companies self-discipline and set industry norms. Too many external pipes will stifle vitality.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A multinational company operating in multiple countries, registered in the lowest tax place, countries want to control and can not control. Who should have the power of supervision has become a difficult question.

scene: 养老金池子快见底，决策者在“提高缴费、划国资、转个人账户、延退”之间反复权衡，每动一项都牵动一代人。

options.t: 我支持适当提高缴费率，池子要续上、当代人得共同扛。
options.t_en: I support an appropriate increase in the contribution rate, the pool should be continued, and the contemporary people must carry it together.

options.t: 我主张把部分国资收益划进养老池，这是上一代积累、本就该反哺。
options.t_en: I advocate that some of the state-owned capital gains be allocated to the pension pool, which is the accumulation of the previous generation and should be reversed.

options.t: 我倾向更多转入个人账户、自己存自己用，权责清晰。
options.t_en: I tend to transfer more to personal accounts, save for myself, and have clear responsibilities.

options.t: 我认为延迟退休能减负又多缴，是一举两得的现实解。
options.t_en: I think that delayed retirement can reduce the burden and overpay, which is a realistic understanding of one-two gains.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: The pension pool is about to run out, and policymakers have repeatedly weighed between "increasing contributions, transferring state assets, transferring personal accounts, and retreating", each of which affects a generation.

scene: 经济下行，失业的人变多，失业金发高还是发低吵开了：高了保生活却怕人不找工作，低了逼就业却让人熬不住。

options.t: 我认为失业金该够人基本体面生活，落难时社会得托住底。
options.t_en: I think that unemployment benefits should be enough for people to live a basic and decent life, and society must hold the bottom when it falls.

options.t: 我主张失业金低一点，保留找工作的动力，太高反而养懒。
options.t_en: I advocate lower unemployment benefits, retain the motivation to look for work, too high but lazy.

options.t: 我支持按原薪资一定比例发，收入高时多缴、失业时多补，更公平。
options.t_en: I support paying a certain proportion of the original salary, overpaying when the income is high, and supplementing when unemployed, which is more equitable.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The economy is down, the number of unemployed people has increased, and the number of unemployed blondes is still low and noisy: they are afraid of not looking for work when their life is high and they are afraid of not looking for work when their employment is low, but they can't keep up.

scene: 一位重度残障者每月开销远超常人，家庭不堪重负，补贴该给多少、是不是该普惠，引发讨论。

options.t: 我认为残障补贴该充足且普惠，身体不便不是个人的错，社会得兜住。
options.t_en: I think that the disability allowance should be sufficient and inclusive, and the inconvenience is not the fault of the individual, and the society has to hold back.

options.t: 我主张给基本保障就行，资源有限、不能无上限，也得讲可持续。
options.t_en: I advocate basic security, limited resources, not unlimited, but also sustainable.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A severely disabled person's monthly expenses are far more than normal, and his family is overwhelmed. How much subsidy should be given and whether it should be included triggered discussion.

scene: 社保基金是收归全国统筹、还是留给地方、还是以个人账户为主，各地收支不均，模式之争背后是“钱怎么统”。

options.t: 我支持全国统筹，富省帮穷省、pool风险，制度才稳。
options.t_en: I support the overall planning of the whole country. Rich provinces help poor provinces and pool risks, and the system is only stable.

options.t: 我主张留给地方自管，各地情况不同，自己最清楚自己。
options.t_en: I advocate leaving it to the local self-management. The situation is different in different places, and I know myself best.

options.t: 我倾向以个人账户为主，自己缴自己用、产权在自己手里。
options.t_en: I tend to focus on personal accounts, and pay for my own use and property rights in my own hands.

options.t: 我认为统筹加个人账户的混合最稳，互济和激励都顾到。
options.t_en: I think the mix of co-ordination plus personal accounts is the most stable, with mutual aid and incentives in mind.

options.t: 我支持在基本盘之外用商业保险补充，多层次才扛得住。
options.t_en: I support supplementing with commercial insurance outside the basic market, which can be handled on multiple levels.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Whether the social security fund is integrated into the country, left to the local area, or dominated by personal accounts, the income and expenditure are uneven everywhere. Behind the dispute over the model is "how to unify the money".

scene: 一片贫困山区要脱贫，是直接发钱、还是上产业、还是教技能、还是兜底低保，四种路子各有拥趸。

options.t: 我支持直接发现金给穷人，他们最知道自己缺什么，尊严也在选择权里。
options.t_en: I support the direct discovery of gold to the poor, who know best what they lack and whose dignity is in their choices.

options.t: 我认为上产业、造血式扶贫最持久，给人饭碗比给钱管用。
options.t_en: I think that the upper industry and hematopoietic poverty alleviation are the most lasting, and it is more useful to give people jobs than money.

options.t: 我主张投教育、教技能，把人自己的能力建起来，断穷根。
options.t_en: I advocate investing in education, teaching skills, raising people's own abilities, and eliminating the roots of poverty.

options.t: 我支持对最弱的一层直接兜底低保，保命的钱不能省。
options.t_en: I support the direct protection of the weakest layer, and the money for life preservation cannot be saved.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: If a poor mountainous area needs to be lifted out of poverty, whether it is to directly send money, go to industry, teach skills, or have a low guarantee, there are fans in each of the four ways.

scene: 政府想给有孩子的家庭发钱减负，是普发、按收入发、还是折成服务发，方案之争关乎公平和效率。

options.t: 我支持儿童津贴普发，养孩子是社会共同的事，不分贫富都该帮。
options.t_en: I support the universal payment of child allowances. Raising children is a common thing in society, and everyone should help regardless of whether they are rich or poor.

options.t: 我主张按家庭收入发，钱花在真正困难的孩子身上才值。
options.t_en: I advocate paying according to family income, and spending money on really difficult children is worth it.

options.t: 我认为不发现金、改提供托育教育等服务，更防挪用也更对症。
options.t_en: I think that it is better to prevent misappropriation and be more symptomatic if no gold is found and services such as childcare and education are provided instead.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The government wants to give families with children money to reduce their burdens, whether it is universal, according to income, or converted into service. The dispute over the program is about fairness and efficiency.

scene: 企业喊社保费太重、员工怕待遇降，缴费率降不降、怎么降，各方拉锯：企业活下去和百姓晚年都得顾。

options.t: 我认为该降费率给企业减负，企业活了、就业和税基才保得住。
options.t_en: I think that the reduction rate reduces the burden on the enterprise, and the enterprise is alive, and the employment and tax base can be maintained.

options.t: 我主张费率稳住、先保住大家将来的待遇，降了眼前苦了老后。
options.t_en: I advocate that the rate should be stabilized and that everyone's future treatment should be preserved first, which reduces the current suffering of the elderly.

options.t: 我支持按收入分档、富人高费率穷人低，调节式更公平。
options.t_en: I support income stratification, higher rates for the rich, lower rates for the poor, and fairer regulation.

options.t: 我倾向统一比例，简单透明、人人一个标准最不惹争议。
options.t_en: I prefer unified proportions, simple and transparent, and one standard for everyone is the least controversial.

options.t: 我认为该给个人灵活自选档位，愿意多缴多拿自己定。
options.t_en: I think it is time to give individuals the flexibility to choose their own gear, and be willing to pay more and decide for themselves.

options.t: 我对费率高低没啥偏好，只要别悄悄挪用我的钱就行。
options.t_en: I don't have a preference for high or low rates, as long as I don't quietly misappropriate my money.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: Enterprises shouted that the social insurance premiums were too heavy, employees feared that the treatment would be reduced, the payment rate would not drop, how to drop, and all parties saw that the enterprise would survive and the people would have to take care of it in their old age.

scene: 低保名单里被发现有开豪车却领补助的，是严查还是宽进，社区在“防骗保”和“别漏掉真穷人”间为难。

options.t: 我支持严格、动态地核查，骗保的清出去、池子才留给该帮的人。
options.t_en: I support strict and dynamic verification, and it is only for the people of the gang that the cheating insurance is cleared out and the pool is left.

options.t: 我主张宽进保底，宁可多覆盖也别漏掉真困难的，错一点比漏一个代价小。
options.t_en: I advocate wide access to guarantee, preferring to cover more than miss. It is really difficult to miss, and the cost of missing a little is less than the cost of missing one.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: In the low insurance list, it was found that there was a luxury car driving but receiving subsidies. Whether it was strict inspection or broad access, the community was embarrassed between "anti-fraud insurance" and "don't miss the real poor".

scene: 基本养老不够花，政府想鼓励大家买商业养老险，是税优引、还是公为主、还是自己买、还是强制第二支柱，路子不一。

options.t: 我支持用税收优惠鼓励买商业养老险，撬动个人给自己存。
options.t_en: I support the use of tax incentives to encourage the purchase of commercial pension insurance and encourage individuals to save for themselves.

options.t: 我认为以公共养老为主、私人险作补充，兜底还得靠公家。
options.t_en: I think that with public old-age care as the mainstay and private insurance as the supplement, we still have to rely on the public.

options.t: 我倾向个人自己买、自己规划，别指望谁来安排晚年。
options.t_en: I tend to buy and plan by myself, don't expect someone to arrange my later life.

options.t: 我主张强制建第二支柱，像公积金一样人人缴，老了才真有双保险。
