options.t_en: I advocate the compulsory construction of the second pillar. Like the provident fund, everyone pays, and only when they are old can they really have double insurance.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The basic pension is not enough. The government wants to encourage everyone to buy commercial pension insurance. Whether it is tax preferential, the principals are the mainstay, buy it by themselves, or force the second pillar, the path is different.

scene: 老龄化加剧，养老医保长期吃紧，怎么让制度可持续：扩面增收、控支出、还是多元筹资，三派各有账本。

options.t: 我支持把更多人纳进制度、做大蛋糕，缴费基数广了才撑得久。
options.t_en: I support including more people into the system and making the cake bigger, and the payment base is broad enough to last for a long time.

options.t: 我认为该控支出、提质效，钱花在刀刃上、别铺张。
options.t_en: I think the control of spending, quality and efficiency, money spent on the blade, do not spread.

options.t: 我主张多元筹资，政府、企业、个人、市场一起扛，单一来源太脆。
options.t_en: I advocate diversified financing. The government, enterprises, individuals, and the market shoulder it together. A single source is too fragile.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Aging has intensified, and pension and medical insurance have been tight for a long time. How to make the system sustainable: expanding income, controlling expenditure, or diversifying financing, the three schools have their own ledgers.

scene: 一对双职工夫妻搬进新家，下班后家务堆积如山，两人都累。一方觉得谁有空谁干，另一方认为该有个明确安排。背后的张力是：家务算不算劳动、要不要讲公平，还是顺其自然。

options.t: 我会和伴侣坐下来把做饭、打扫、带娃列成清单，两人各认领一半，轮流也不计较谁多做了一点，毕竟家是共同的。
options.t_en: I will sit down with my partner to make a list of cooking, cleaning, and bringing a doll. They each claim half, and I don't care who does more in turn. After all, the home is common.

options.t: 我回家看谁当时不累、没在忙别的就谁顺手做，不用算得那么清，日子又不是打卡考勤。
options.t_en: I went home to see who was not tired at the time, not busy doing anything else, no need to calculate so clearly, the days are not clock-in.

options.t: 他炒菜好吃就他掌勺，我收纳整齐就归我整理，谁干什么看本事不看性别，省得互相折腾。
options.t_en: He cooks delicious dishes and he takes the lead. I organize them neatly. Whoever does what and does not look at gender can save each other.

options.t: 我宁愿每月花一笔钱请保洁或做饭阿姨，把时间留给自己休息和陪伴，钱能买到的效率就别消耗感情。
options.t_en: I would rather spend a monthly amount of money on cleaning or cooking aunties, leaving time for myself to rest and accompany, and the efficiency that money can buy should not consume emotions.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A couple of employees moved into a new home. After work, the housework was piled up and both of them were tired. If one party feels that someone has the time to do something, the other party believes that there should be a clear arrangement. The tension behind it is whether housework is considered labor, fairness, or natural.

scene: 一对准父母在给孩子办出生登记前争论孩子跟谁姓。一方觉得跟妈妈姓也挺好，另一方担心长辈和传统亲戚会有意见。张力在：姓氏是家族传承的符号，还是父母可自由约定的私事。

options.t: 我认为孩子跟妈妈姓完全没问题，姓氏只是个符号，谁带得多、家里怎么商量都行，不必非得传男系。
options.t_en: I think that there is no problem between the child and the mother's surname. The surname is just a symbol. Whoever brings more and how the family can discuss it, there is no need to pass on the male line.

options.t: 我倾向随父亲姓，这是家里一直延续的习惯，改了长辈心里不舒服，也没必要为这个较劲。
options.t_en: I tend to follow my father's surname. This is a habit that has continued in my family. I have changed my elders' discomfort, and there is no need to fight for this.

options.t: 我觉得可以父母商量后取双姓，或者等孩子大了让他自己选，命名权本就该回归家庭本身。
options.t_en: I think it is possible for parents to take a double surname after consultation, or when the child is older and let him choose for himself, the naming right should be returned to the family itself.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A pair of prospective parents argue about the child's surname before registering the child for birth. One side felt that the surname of the mother was also very good, and the other side was worried that elders and traditional relatives would have opinions. Tension: Is the surname a symbol of family heritage, or is it a private matter that parents can freely agree on?

scene: 新手爸妈都在上班，孩子还小需要人盯。一方认为育儿是两人共同的责任，另一方觉得母亲天然更细心、该多担一些。张力是：养育是双亲义务，还是可以依传统角色分工。

options.t: 我和伴侣排好班，夜里喂奶、周末带孩子都轮流来，谁也不该缺席，育儿是两个人的事不是一个人的苦差。
options.t_en: My partner and I arranged shifts, breastfeeding at night, and bringing children on the weekend all took turns. No one should be absent. Parenting is for two people, not for one person.

options.t: 我觉得妈妈带孩子更细致也更放心，爸爸在外打拼赚钱，家里的养育主要交给我也心安。
options.t_en: I feel that my mother is more detailed and more assured with her children. My father is working hard to earn money outside, and I am also relieved that the main care at home is given to me.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The new parents are all at work, and the children still need to be watched. One side believes that childcare is a shared responsibility of the two, while the other side feels that mothers are naturally more careful and should bear more. The tension is whether parenting is a parental obligation or whether it can be divided according to traditional roles.

scene: 父母年纪大了，子女在考虑是接来同住尽孝，还是让他们住得近但独立。老人既想要儿女照应，又怕同住闹矛盾、失去自己的空间。张力在：孝道是朝夕相伴，还是尊重彼此独立。

options.t: 我把父母接来一起住，日常三餐有人管、生病有人陪，趁还能相处多尽点孝心，钱省下不如人在身边。
options.t_en: I took my parents to live with me. Everyday, three meals are managed by someone, and sick people are accompanied by someone. While I can still get along with them, I can be as filial as possible, and save money. It is not as good as being around people.

options.t: 我在同小区给父母租或买套小房子，走路几分钟能到，既能照应又互不打扰，两代人都有喘息空间。
options.t_en: I rented or bought a small house for my parents in the same neighborhood. It is a few minutes' walk away, so I can take care of each other without disturbing each other. Both generations have room to breathe.

options.t: 如果父母愿意，我选设施专业的养老机构，有医护有同伴，比我在家手忙脚乱更靠谱，也减轻子女压力。
options.t_en: If the parents want, I choose a professional elderly care institution with facilities, with medical care and companions, which is more reliable than my busy life at home, and also reduces the pressure on my children.

options.t: 我不在原则上提前定死，看父母身体和意愿随时调整，能自理就独立、需要人时就靠拢，灵活最重要。
options.t_en: I do not set my death in advance in principle. I look at my parents' body and wishes to adjust at any time. I can take care of myself independently, approach people when I need them, and be flexible and most important.

options.t: 我自己更想要独立的生活，长辈也该有他们的社交和节奏，过度捆绑对两代人都累。
options.t_en: I myself prefer to live independently, and elders should also have their social and rhythmic, overbundling is tiring to both generations.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Parents are getting older, and their children are considering whether to come and live with them for filial piety, or let them live close but independent. The elderly not only want to take care of their children, but also are afraid to live together in conflict and lose their own space. Tension is in: whether filial piety is accompanied by morning and evening, or whether it respects each other's independence.

scene: 一对夫妻闹到要离婚，一方冲动提了申请，另一方在冷静期里反复纠结。有人担心冷静期能拦住一时冲动，也有人觉得这等于强迫不想过的人多耗一个月。张力在：保护婚姻稳定还是个人退出自由。

options.t: 我觉得设个缓冲期挺好，多少人是一气之下签字，过两周冷静下来还能挽回，给婚姻最后一次机会。
options.t_en: I think it's good to have a buffer period. How many people sign in one breath? After two weeks, they can calm down and save it and give the marriage a last chance.

options.t: 我反对强制冷静期，过不下去的人多拖三十天只是煎熬，离不离该由当事人自己决定，不该被代做主。
options.t_en: I oppose the compulsory cooling-off period. Those who can't go on for more than 30 days are just suffering. It should be decided by the parties themselves and should not be taken for the boss.

options.t: 我认为若存在家暴，必须立刻放行、不能卡冷静期，弱势一方等不起，这种例外必须写进规则。
options.t_en: I think that if there is domestic violence, it must be released immediately, the cooling-off period cannot be stuck, and the vulnerable party cannot afford to wait. Such exceptions must be written into the rules.

options.t: 我主张把冷静期做成可选项，想缓冲的去申请、铁了心要离的直接办，尊重每个人的实际情况。
options.t_en: I advocate making the cooling-off period optional, wanting to buffer to apply, ironing out the need to do it directly, and respecting everyone's actual situation.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: A couple got into a rush to get divorced, one side made an impulse application, and the other side struggled repeatedly during the cooling-off period. Some people worry that the cooling-off period can stop the impulse, and others feel that it is equivalent to forcing people who do not want to spend an extra month. The tension lies in: protecting the stability of the marriage or the freedom of the individual to withdraw.

scene: 年轻夫妻算账发现养孩子从奶粉到补习花掉大半收入。一方希望社会通过补贴分摊，另一方认为这是家庭自己的事。张力在：育儿算不算社会再生产、该不该公共埋单。

options.t: 我支持用税收给育儿家庭发补贴和普惠托育，孩子将来是社会劳动力，成本不该只压在父母肩上。
options.t_en: I support the use of tax subsidies and universal childcare for families raising children. Children will be social workers in the future, and the cost should not be solely on the shoulders of parents.

options.t: 我觉得生养是自己的选择，账目自己扛，不该指望别人掏钱，量入为出就行。
options.t_en: I think health is my choice, the accounts should be borne by myself, and I shouldn't expect others to pay for it, just pay for it.

options.t: 我更看重单位给的实打实支持，比如带薪育儿假、托管班，比发钱更能帮上班族平衡工作家庭。
options.t_en: I pay more attention to the solid support given by the unit, such as paid parental leave and custody classes, which can help office workers balance working families more than paying money.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Young couples settle accounts and find that raising a child spends most of their income from milk powder to tutoring. One wants society to share through subsidies, while the other sees it as the family's own business. The tension is: whether childcare is considered social reproduction, and whether it should be paid by the public.

scene: 社区里出现单亲、重组、同性伴侣等非典型家庭，有邻居觉得不舒服，也有邻居主张一视同仁。物业在考虑活动通知和场地使用要不要区别对待。张力在：传统家庭观还是私人生活平等尊重。

options.t: 我对邻居家的组成不多问不多管，孩子一样要上学、大人一样要上班，相处时给足基本尊重就好。
options.t_en: I don't ask much about the composition of my neighbors' homes. Children should go to school, adults should go to work, and basic respect should be given when getting along.

options.t: 我更认同传统的一父一母家庭模式，社区活动若有示范还是以主流为先，不希望模糊了孩子认知。
options.t_en: I agree with the traditional one-parent family model. If there is a demonstration or the mainstream is the first, I do not want to obscure the child's cognition.

options.t: 我认为只要合法登记，非传统家庭在落户、继承、就医上就该和别人完全一样，权利义务不能打折。
options.t_en: I believe that as long as it is legally registered, non-traditional families should be exactly the same as others in terms of settlement, inheritance, and medical treatment, and rights and obligations cannot be discounted.

options.t: 别人家里怎么过是他们的事，只要不侵害他人，公权力和邻居都不该伸进卧室去评判。
options.t_en: What others do at home is their business. As long as they do not invade others, public power and neighbors should not reach into the bedroom to judge.

options.t: 我自己的观念偏传统，不反对别人那样生活，但涉及公开表彰或教材呈现我还是倾向守旧。
options.t_en: My own ideas are traditional and I am not opposed to others living like that, but I still tend to be conservative when it comes to public recognition or presentation of textbooks.

options.t: 这种话题离我生活挺远，谁家怎么过都行，我懒得掺和也不太关心。
options.t_en: This topic is quite far from my life, no matter how anyone's family lives, I am too lazy to get involved and I don't care much.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: There are atypical families in the community, such as single parents, reorganization, and same-sex couples, and there are neighbors who feel uncomfortable and neighbors who advocate for equal treatment. Whether the property should be treated differently when considering event notices and site use. The tension is in: traditional family outlook or equal respect for private life.

scene: 夫妻对孩子上什么兴趣班、选哪所小学意见不一，一方想全权安排，另一方想要两人商量。张力在：教育决策权归一方还是共商。

options.t: 我和伴侣遇到择校、报班都先聊聊，孩子的路是两个人一起铺的，单方面拍板我不放心。
options.t_en: My partner and I talked about school selection and newspaper work first. The child's road is paved by two people, and I am not worried about unilaterally patting the board.

options.t: 家里谁更懂教育、谁时间多就谁主要拿主意，省得每次都扯皮，定了我配合执行就是。
options.t_en: Whoever knows more about education in the family and who has more time will mainly take the idea, and save every time. I will cooperate with the implementation.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: Husbands and wives have different opinions on what kind of classes their children are interested in and which primary school they choose. One party wants to arrange it at their discretion, and the other party wants to discuss it with the other. The tension lies in: whether the right to make educational decisions belongs to one party or to the other.

scene: 小伙子和女方家谈婚论嫁，女方家按习俗要一笔彩礼，男方家觉得是负担也怕变买卖。社区里有人赞成传统、有人主张废除。张力在：彩礼是礼数还是剥削。

options.t: 我主张干脆取消彩礼，婚姻不该用钱衡量，动辄几十万把感情变成交易，也压垮普通家庭。
options.t_en: I advocate abolishing the bride price altogether. Marriage should not be measured by money. Hundreds of thousands of feelings are often turned into transactions, which also crushes ordinary families.

options.t: 我觉得给不给、给多少看两家情愿和经济能力，别攀比也别强求，心意到了就行。
options.t_en: I think that if you don't give and how much you give, you can see the willingness and economic ability of the two families. Don't force yourself to compete, as long as you have the intention.

options.t: 我支持设个上限管住天价彩礼，过高的数额逼出债务和矛盾，用规矩兜底普通人的体面。
options.t_en: I support setting an upper limit to control the sky-price bride price, pushing out debts and contradictions in excessively high amounts, and using rules to bolster the decency of ordinary people.

options.t: 我认这个老规矩，彩礼是两家结亲的礼数，按本地惯例走，图个尊重和圆满。
options.t_en: I think this old rule, the dowry is the number of gifts for the two families to marry, according to local practice, respect and perfection.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The young man talked about marriage with the woman's family. The woman's family wanted a bride price according to custom. The man's family felt that it was a burden and was afraid to change it into a sale. There are people in the community who are in favor of tradition, there are people who are in favor of abolition. The tension is in: whether the bride price is the number of gifts or exploitation.

scene: 一对伴侣争论家务要不要算钱，一方觉得亲人间明算账伤感情，另一方觉得不记账就总是一方吃亏。张力在：亲密关系里的劳动要不要计价。

options.t: 我家务做了就做了，跟自己人算钱太生分，谁多干点少干点看情况，情分比账单重要。
options.t_en: I did the housework and did it. Calculating money with my own people is too much. Whoever does more and does less depends on the situation. Sentiment is more important than bills.

options.t: 我倾向把家务折成值或轮值表，干多的另一方补点钱或等价劳动，长期不公平我心里会堵。
options.t_en: I tend to fold the housework into a value or rotation table, and the other party who does more will supplement the money or equivalent labor. If it is unfair for a long time, my heart will be blocked.

options.t: 争执不下的活我直接花钱请人做，既不占我时间也不欠伴侣人情，两边清静。
options.t_en: I directly paid people to do the disputed work, neither taking up my time nor owing my partner's affection, and both sides were quiet.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: A couple argues about whether to calculate money for housework. One party feels that the relationship between loved ones is clearly hurtful, and the other party feels that it is always a loss for one party if it does not keep an account. Tension in: Should labor in intimate relationships be priced?

scene: 一家人聚餐点菜，有人提议多点肉，有人因为动保理念想少点，还有人坚持日常吃肉没问题。张力在：动物福利与饮食自由。

options.t: 我有意减少吃肉，工厂化养殖里动物太受苦，少一盘肉也是为少些折磨，口味可以让一步。
options.t_en: I intentionally eat less meat. Animals in factory farming suffer too much. One less plate of meat is also for less torture, and the taste can make it one step.

options.t: 我觉得吃肉是再正常不过的饮食选择，营养均衡就行，没必要为理念委屈自己的胃口。
options.t_en: I think eating meat is a perfectly normal diet choice. Nutrition should be balanced. There is no need to quit your appetite for the concept.

options.t: 我不排斥吃肉，但会挑标榜人道养殖和屠宰的肉源，起码让动物死前少受罪。
options.t_en: I do not exclude eating meat, but I will promote the source of meat that is humanely bred and slaughtered, at least to make animals suffer less before they die.

options.t: 我已经吃素了，看着动物被杀我下不去嘴，青菜豆腐照样吃得香，也算是自己的坚持。
options.t_en: I was already vegetarian, watching the animals get killed and I couldn't go down the mouth. The vegetable tofu still tasted good, and it was my own insistence.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: When a family gathers for a meal to order, some people propose to order more meat, some people want to eat less because of the concept of mobile protection, and others insist on eating meat on a daily basis. Tension in: Animal welfare and dietary freedom.

scene: 某药厂要用实验动物测新药安全性，科研机构说不可或缺，动保团体要求停手。监管在权衡人类健康收益与动物痛苦。

options.t: 我认为治病救人的关键实验可以有限度做，但必须审批、减量和规范，不能随便用。
options.t_en: I believe that key experiments to treat patients and save people can be done to a limited extent, but they must be approved, reduced and standardized, and cannot be used casually.

options.t: 我主张全面停用实验动物，生命不该为人的便利牺牲，该把钱投向替代技术。
options.t_en: I advocate the complete deactivation of experimental animals, and that life should not be sacrificed for human convenience, and money should be invested in alternative technologies.

options.t: 我支持能不用就不用，先上细胞培养、计算机模拟等替代手段，实在绕不过才考虑动物。
options.t_en: I support whether you can use it or not, first go to alternative means such as cell culture and computer simulation, it is really impossible to consider animals.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A pharmaceutical company needs to use experimental animals to test the safety of new drugs. Scientific research institutions say it is indispensable, and the mobile protection group requires a stop. Regulation weighs human health gains against animal suffering.

scene: 城里要翻新老动物园，保育人士说该关掉放归自然，家长说孩子需要就近看活物学知识。张力在：动物福利还是公众教育。

options.t: 我觉得动物园该留着，孩子在这儿认识物种、种下爱护自然的种子，比课本直观多了。
options.t_en: I think the zoo should be kept. Children know the species here and plant nature-loving seeds here, which is much more intuitive than textbooks.

options.t: 我主张逐步关掉，把动物送回更适合的栖息地或保护区，圈着给人看本身就是不尊重。
options.t_en: I advocate gradually shutting down and returning animals to more suitable habitats or protected areas, which is disrespectful in itself.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: The old zoo needs to be renovated in the city. Conservationists say that it should be closed down and released into nature. Parents say that their children need to see biology knowledge nearby. The tension is in: animal welfare or public education.

scene: 小区宠物越来越多，有人被咬、有人嫌吵，议会讨论要不要立法管宠物福利和饲养。张力在：动物保护强度还是饲养自由。

options.t: 我支持立法管宠物的最低福利，绝育、免疫、不弃养写进规矩，养了就得负责。
options.t_en: I support legislation to regulate the minimum welfare of pets. Sterilization, immunization, and no abandonment are written into the rules, and you must be responsible when you raise them.

options.t: 我觉得不用太多法条，关键在主人自觉，自己管好自家猫狗、不影响别人就是本分。
options.t_en: I don't think there are many laws. The key lies in the owner's consciousness. It is his duty to take care of his own cats and dogs and not affect others.

options.t: 我的底线是禁止虐待和遗弃，至于怎么养、养几只交给主人，管太细反而添乱。
options.t_en: My bottom line is to prohibit abuse and abandonment. As for how to raise and raise a few to the owner, the management is too thin and messy.

options.t: 我认为成年人有养不养、养什么的自由，只要不伤人，规不规制由我自己定。
options.t_en: I believe that adults have the freedom to raise or not raise anything. As long as it does not hurt people, the rules and regulations are determined by myself.

options.t: 我赞成对数量和品种设限，尤其烈性犬得控住，邻里安全和安静比饲养随意重要。
options.t_en: I am in favor of setting limits on numbers and breeds, especially strong dogs, and neighborhood safety and quietness are more important than random breeding.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: There are more and more pets in the community. Some people are bitten and some people are noisy. The parliament discusses whether to legislate on pet welfare and breeding. The tension is: animal protection intensity or breeding freedom.

scene: 市场上有人偷偷卖珍稀野味和标本，环保组织要求全面禁，商户说合法养殖的该让卖。张力在：生态保育还是经营自由。

options.t: 我主张把野生动物贸易一刀切禁掉，只要有买卖就有偷猎，源头掐断最省事。
options.t_en: I advocate a one-size-fits-all ban on wildlife trade. As long as there is trade, there will be poaching, and cutting off the source is the most convenient.

options.t: 我支持发许可证、可溯源的才许经营，既保野生种群又给合规商户活路。
options.t_en: I support the issuance of licenses and traceable licenses, both to protect wild populations and to provide a livelihood for compliant merchants.

options.t: 我认为人工繁育、可持续采集的可以卖，关键是合法合规不碰野外种群，也满足需求。
options.t_en: I think that artificial breeding and sustainable collection can be sold, the key is to legally and legally do not touch wild populations, but also meet the needs.

options.t: 我倾向于不在公开市场摆卖任何野生动物制品，降低诱惑和灰色地带，网上线下都收紧。
options.t_en: I tend not to sell any wildlife products on the open market, reducing temptation and grey areas, and tightening up both online and offline.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: There are people in the market who secretly sell rare wild animals and specimens. Environmental protection organizations require a total ban. Merchants say that legal farming should be sold. The tension is in: ecological conservation or freedom of operation.

scene: 街角流浪猫狗成群，居民怕防疫和噪音，动保者心疼想救。街道在选处置方案。张力在：动物生命还是社区秩序。

options.t: 我赞成抓捕、绝育、打疫苗再放归，志愿者喂食登记，从源头控制数量又不赶尽杀绝。
options.t_en: I am in favor of catching, sterilizing, vaccinating and releasing again, volunteers feeding and registering, and controlling the number from the source without exterminating.

options.t: 我认为失控的就送收容所，无人领养且不可控的做安乐，总比流浪传病强。
options.t_en: I think that if it gets out of control, it will be sent to a shelter, and if there is no one to adopt and it is uncontrollable, it will be better than wandering and spreading diseases.

options.t: 我更想推领养，劝想养的人去收容所接一只，少一只买卖就少一只漂泊的。
options.t_en: I would rather push for adoption and persuade those who want to adopt to pick one up at the shelter, one less buy and sell one less drifter.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The stray cats and dogs on the street corner are in groups. Residents are afraid of epidemic prevention and noise, and protectors are anxious to save them. The street is choosing a disposal option. Tension: animal life or community order.

scene: 新小区入住，物业起草养宠规则，有人要自由、有人要严管。张力在：饲养自由还是公共安全。

options.t: 我觉得在自己家里养什么、养几只是我的事，不出门惹事就不该被指手画脚。
options.t_en: I feel that what I raise in my own home and how much I raise is just my business, and I shouldn't be told if I don't go out and cause trouble.

options.t: 我赞成养前登记报备，物业知道哪家有宠物、打了针没，出问题能找着人。
options.t_en: I am in favor of pre-adoption registration. The property knows which family has pets and whether they have injections. If there is a problem, you can find someone.

options.t: 我支持限个数量，比如一户两三只封顶，免得变成无序繁殖扰邻。
options.t_en: I support a limited number, such as two or three caps in a household, so as not to become disorderly breeding and disturbing neighbors.

options.t: 我主张禁养攻击性强的品种，公共楼道里安全第一位，爱好得让位于他人安心。
options.t_en: I advocate banning aggressive breeds, putting safety first in public corridors, and giving way to others' peace of mind.

options.t: 我倾向业主自己开会定规矩，大家共识出来的办法比上面硬塞的更容易服众。
options.t_en: I prefer to set the rules for the owner's own meeting, and the method agreed by everyone is easier to obey than the above.

options.t: 养不养宠、怎么管跟我无关，我既不养也不操这份心。
options.t_en: It has nothing to do with me not raising pets and how to manage it. I neither raise nor care about this heart.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: The new community checks in, and the property drafts pet rules. Some people want to be free and some people want to be strictly controlled. The tension lies in: breeding freedom or public safety.

scene: 商场皮草专柜促销，动保者举牌劝退，顾客各有取舍。张力在：穿着自由还是动物痛苦。

options.t: 我本人不买皮草，取皮过程太残忍，省下这件大衣换动物少受些罪，我乐意。
options.t_en: I do not buy fur myself, the process of taking fur is too cruel, save this coat and change animals to suffer less, I am happy.

options.t: 我觉得买不买是各人自由，有人喜欢真皮草的质感，只要合法我就尊重，不该被道德绑架。
options.t_en: I think that buying or not buying is everyone's freedom. Some people like the texture of real fur. As long as it is legal, I respect it and should not be kidnapped by morality.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Fur counters in shopping malls are promoted, and mobile protectors hold up their cards to discourage them. Customers have their own choices. The tension is in: dressing freely or animal suffering.

scene: 法院在审理一起宠物伤人赔偿，争论宠物算家人还是财物。张力在：动物法律地位。

options.t: 我把狗当家里一口，它陪我解闷、懂我情绪，伤了它我心里真疼，不该只当东西。
options.t_en: I take a bite of the dog at home, it accompanies me to relieve my boredom, understand my emotions, hurt it, my heart really hurt, should not just be a thing.

options.t: 我看法现实点，宠物再亲也是私有财物，丢了坏了按价赔，情感归情感、账得清。
options.t_en: I think the method is more realistic. Pets are also private property. Lost and damaged are compensated according to the price. Emotions belong to emotions and accounts are clear.

options.t: 我支持给伴侣动物比普通财物高一级的保护，虐待要罚，但不必和人权扯平。
options.t_en: I support giving companion animals a higher level of protection than ordinary property, and punishing abuse, but it does not have to be equal to human rights.

options.t: 我觉得既不能当人也不能纯当物，给个介于两者间的照料底线，务实就好。
options.t_en: I feel that I can neither be a person nor a pure object. To give a care bottom line in between, just be pragmatic.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A court is hearing a pet injury claim, arguing whether a pet is family or property. Tension in: Legal status of animals.

scene: 马戏团来巡演，动物钻火圈引孩子尖叫，动保者场外抗议。张力在：娱乐价值还是动物剥削。

options.t: 我主张禁掉动物表演，训练里的鞭子和笼子我看不得，孩子的笑不该建立在动物恐惧上。
options.t_en: I advocate banning animal performances, whips and cages in training I can't see, and children's laughter should not be based on animal fear.

options.t: 我认为不必全禁，把饲养、训练、演出条件管好，合规的马戏团也能存在。
options.t_en: I think there is no need to prohibit everything, keep the conditions for raising, training, and performing well, and a compliant circus can exist.

options.t: 我交给观众用脚投票，大家不爱看自然就淘汰，用不上强制禁令。
options.t_en: I leave it to the audience to vote with their feet, everyone will be eliminated if they don't like to see nature, and there is no use for a mandatory ban.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The circus came to tour, animal fire rings led children to scream, and activists protested outside the venue. Tension: entertainment value or animal exploitation.

scene: 市里文化预算有限，独立剧团和小影院喊穷，也有人觉得艺术该自己赚钱。张力在：公共扶持还是市场生存。

options.t: 我认为公共文化该政府多拨钱，免费或低价让普通人也能看戏看展，不能只服务有钱人。
options.t_en: I think that public culture The government allocates more money to allow ordinary people to watch theater and exhibitions for free or at a low price, and can not only serve rich people.

options.t: 我倾向让艺术自己找观众、靠票房活，纳税人的钱有更急的用处，别养闲人。
options.t_en: I tend to let the art find the audience by itself, live on the box office, the taxpayer's money has a more urgent use, do not support people.

options.t: 我主张政府保基础场馆、市场做商业创作，两边搭着来，既托底又留活力。
options.t_en: I advocate that the government protects the basic venues and markets for commercial creation, and the two sides are tied together to keep both the foundation and vitality.

options.t: 我更看好民间基金会和企业赞助，独立于行政也少些干预，艺术多样性能保住。
options.t_en: I am more optimistic about private foundations and corporate sponsorship, independent of administration and less intervention, and artistic diversity can be preserved.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The city's cultural budget is limited, independent theaters and small cinemas call it poverty, and some people think that art should make money on its own. Tension: public support or market survival.

scene: 美术馆要办一组题材敏感的前卫展，部分观众投诉看不懂还冒犯，馆方犹豫要不要开。张力在：表达自由还是公序良俗。

options.t: 我觉得只要合法就该办，看不看得懂、接不接受是个人事，禁掉才是真问题。
options.t_en: I think that as long as it is legal, we should do it. It is a personal matter whether we can read it or not, and banning it is the real problem.

options.t: 我主张先审一遍，涉及明显冒犯或误导的调一调，自由也得有边，别伤了公众感情。
options.t_en: I advocate a preliminary examination, involving a tune that is obviously offensive or misleading. Freedom must also have an edge, and don't hurt public feelings.

options.t: 我赞成照常展，但配文字和讲解员把创作意图说清，让人看懂争议在哪，比直接撤掉好。
options.t_en: I am in favor of the exhibition as usual, but it is better to clarify the creative intentions with words and commentators so that people can understand where the controversy is than to remove it directly.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The museum should hold a group of avant-garde exhibitions with sensitive subjects. Some visitors complained that they did not understand and were offended, and the museum hesitated to open them. The tension is in: freedom of expression or public order and good customs.

scene: 老街区改造，一面要保留木雕砖瓦，一面想建现代玻璃幕墙。张力在：文化传承还是创新表达。

options.t: 我舍不得老样子，雕花和老树是几代人的记忆，改得太新就丢了根。
options.t_en: I can't bear to look old, carved flowers and old trees are the memories of generations, too new to lose roots.

options.t: 我觉得城市要往前走，新形式、新手法才鲜活，老瓶装新酒才有生命力。
options.t_en: I think the city must move forward, new forms, new techniques are alive, and old bottles of new wine are alive.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The old neighborhood has been renovated, with wooden brick tiles on one side and modern glass curtain walls on the other. Tension is in: cultural heritage or innovative expression.

scene: 图书馆和博物馆运营要钱，理事会争论门票收不收、收多少。张力在：普惠开放还是可持续运营。

options.t: 我认为公共场馆就该全民免费，知识文化不该设门槛，运营靠财政兜底。
options.t_en: I think public venues should be free for all, knowledge and culture should not set thresholds, and operation should rely on financial pockets.

options.t: 我支持收一点低价维持基本运转，既不太贵挡人又有点收入补损耗。
options.t_en: I support taking a low price to maintain the basic operation, which is not too expensive and a little income to make up for the loss.

options.t: 我倾向按成本定价，谁用得多付得多，钱花在刀刃上，不靠补贴养。
options.t_en: I tend to price by cost, who pays a lot more, spends money on the blade, and does not rely on subsidies.

options.t: 我觉得常客办会员、偶尔来的买单次，用会员费撑起日常开放，灵活。
options.t_en: I think frequent guest members, occasional single purchases, and use membership fees to support daily openness and flexibility.

options.t: 我主张平时低价、特定时段免费开放，既普惠又错峰，照顾不同人群。
options.t_en: I advocate low prices and free opening at certain times, which is both inclusive and off-peak, and takes care of different people.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Libraries and museums require money to operate, and councils debate whether and how much to charge for tickets. Tension: Pratt & Whitney is open or sustainable.

scene: 一座古建年久失修，开发商想改民宿赚钱，文保者和居民各有说法。张力在：保护原真还是开发利用。

options.t: 我认为古建得政府牵头修和管，不能交给资本随意改，这是大家的记忆。
options.t_en: I think that Gu Jiande's government took the lead in repairing and managing it, and it can't be handed over to capital to change it at will. This is everyone's memory.

options.t: 我主张让本地居民一起议、一起护，活得起来的遗产才保得久，专家说了不算。
options.t_en: I advocate letting local residents deliberate and protect together, and the legacy of survival will last long, and experts do not count.

options.t: 我看好适度开发成文旅项目，用收益反哺维护，空着烂掉更可惜。
options.t_en: I am optimistic about moderately developing a documentary travel project, feeding the maintenance with the proceeds, and it is a pity that it is rotten in the air.

options.t: 我觉得保护和使用不矛盾，核心区原样留、周边做活化，分寸拿稳就行。
options.t_en: I think that there is no contradiction between protection and use. The core area should be left as it is, the surrounding area should be revitalized, and the size should be kept stable.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: An ancient building has fallen into disrepair, and the developer wants to change the homestay to make money. Civil insurers and residents have their own opinions. Tension in: Protecting the original truth or developing and utilizing it.

scene: 一种使用人数很少的方言面临失传，学者呼吁抢救，年轻人觉得没用。张力在：语言多样性还是实用效率。

options.t: 我认为小语种是文化基因，政府该扶一把、记下来教下去，断了就补不回。
options.t_en: I think that small languages are cultural genes. The government should support them and write them down to teach them. If they are broken, they cannot be repaired.

options.t: 我顺其自然，语言随使用者减少而消失是常态，硬保不如把资源投在活用的语种。
options.t_en: I let it go, language disappears with the decrease of users is the norm, hard insurance is better to put resources into the active language.

options.t: 我支持把它放进乡土课、录成教材，愿学的孩子能接触，留条根就好。
options.t_en: I support putting it into local classes and recording it into textbooks, so that children who are willing to learn can contact it and leave a root.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A dialect with few users is facing loss of popularity, scholars call for rescue, and young people feel useless. The tension is: linguistic diversity or practical efficiency.

scene: 步行街墙面被涂鸦占满，有人嫌乱，有人觉得有味道。城管在定策。张力在：市容秩序还是街头表达。

options.t: 我赞成划几面墙给涂鸦和卖艺，想画的去那儿画，既放开又不糊整条街。
options.t_en: I am in favor of drawing a few walls for graffiti and selling art, and I want to paint there, both to let go and not to muddy the whole street.

options.t: 我认为公共墙面就得干净，乱涂乱画归乱，一律清掉最省心。
options.t_en: I think that the public walls should be clean, scribbled and painted in a mess, and cleaned up all the most worry-free.

options.t: 我支持先申请再上墙，内容过关给地儿，谁画的谁负责，有章法。
options.t_en: I support applying first and then going up the wall, passing the content to the ground, whoever draws and who is responsible, there is a rule.

options.t: 我反而想请画师来做壁画，把街头变画廊，丑地方美起来大家都舒坦。
options.t_en: Instead, I wanted to hire a painter to do the mural, turn the street into a gallery, and make the ugly place beautiful and comfortable for everyone.

options.t: 我没那么在意墙上画什么，不挡路不伤人就由它，懒得管。
options.t_en: I didn't care so much about drawing anything on the wall. If I didn't get in the way or hurt people, I would just leave it alone and not care.

options.t: 涂鸦这种事我既不欣赏也不反感，存在就存在，与我无关。
options.t_en: Graffiti is a thing that I neither appreciate nor dislike. It exists when it exists, and it has nothing to do with me.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The walls of the pedestrian street were filled with graffiti, some people were disgusted, and some people felt that there was a smell. The city management is making up their minds. Tension in: city appearance order or street expression.

scene: 本地剧团接到海外商演邀请，有人觉得该主动走出去，有人觉得顺其自然别硬推。张力在：文化推广力度。

options.t: 我认为好东西该主动往外推，让外面多了解我们的故事，也是软实力。
options.t_en: I think that good things should be actively pushed outward, so that the outside world can learn more about our stories, and it is also soft power.

options.t: 我倾向不刻意，有市场、有人请就去，硬砸钱推广反而变味。
options.t_en: I tend to be unintentional. If there is a market or someone asks me to go, I will go there. If I hit the hard money to promote it, it will become unpleasant.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The local theater company received an invitation for overseas commercial performances. Some people felt that they should take the initiative to go out, and some people felt that it was natural not to push hard. Tension in: Cultural promotion.

scene: 一部电影送审，涉及暴力和亲密戏，审查、平台和观众各执一词。张力在：创作自由还是内容管制。

options.t: 我认为拍什么、怎么拍归导演，成年人自己会挑，别替观众做减法。
options.t_en: I think what to shoot and how to shoot the director, the adults will pick and choose, don't do subtraction for the audience.

options.t: 我支持按年龄分级，小孩不该看的标清楚，成年人看什么自己负责。
options.t_en: I support grading by age, children should not see the marks clearly, and adults are responsible for what they see.

options.t: 我主张上线前审查把关，敏感内容先处理，免得播出后引发更大争议。
options.t_en: I advocate censorship before launching, and sensitive content should be dealt with first, so as not to cause more controversy after broadcasting.

options.t: 我倾向先播，出问题上追责任，比事前一刀切更保创作空间。
options.t_en: I tend to broadcast first, blame the problem, and keep the creative space more than before.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: A film is submitted for censorship, involving violence and intimate drama, with censorship, platforms, and audiences each holding their own. The tension is: creative freedom or content control.

scene: 一件流失文物在两地博物馆间扯归属，一方要回，一方说在全球展更好。张力在：文化主权还是人类共享。

options.t: 我认为东西本是谁的就该回谁家，记忆的载体留在发源地才完整。
options.t_en: I think that whoever the thing is should go home, and the carrier of memory will be complete only when it is left at the place of origin.

options.t: 我倾向让它多国巡展、开放研究，文物是人类共同遗产，圈在一地太可惜。
options.t_en: I tend to let it tour many countries and open up research. Cultural relics are the common heritage of mankind, and it is a pity to be in one place.

options.t: 我主张按现有国际法规和契约来，白纸黑字怎么定就怎么办，少点情绪。
options.t_en: I advocate that according to the existing international regulations and contracts, what should be done with white paper and black words, less emotion.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: A lost cultural relic has been torn between the two museums. One side wants to return, and the other side says that it is better to exhibit it globally. The tension is: cultural sovereignty or human sharing.

scene: 某运动员药检阳性，联盟要罚，粉丝和律所各有说法。张力在：竞技公平还是处罚尺度。

options.t: 我支持一经查实就重罚甚至终身禁赛，作弊毁了所有人公平，不能手软。
options.t_en: I support a heavy penalty or even a lifetime ban once it is verified. Cheating destroys everyone's fairness and can not be soft.

options.t: 我认为得看是故意还是误服、量大不大，分档处理才公道，一刀切冤枉人。
options.t_en: I think it depends on whether it is intentional or misconstrued, the amount is not large, the grading is fair, and the person is wronged.

options.t: 我主张因病用药走豁免程序的该宽容，毕竟人家是真需要治病，不是耍心眼。
options.t_en: I advocate the tolerance of the exemption procedure for medication due to illness, after all, people really need to treat the disease, not play with their minds.

options.t: 我更看重把检测做密做实，威慑在前，事后罚多狠不如事前管住。
options.t_en: I pay more attention to making the detection more dense and practical, deterrence is beforehand, and the penalties afterwards are not as severe as those beforehand.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: A certain athlete has a positive drug test, and the league wants to punish him. Fans and law firms have their own opinions. Tension in: Athletic Fairness or Penalty Scale.

scene: 学校经费紧张，是添实验室还是修操场起争执，家长立场不一。张力在：学业还是体魄。

options.t: 我认为体育设施该多投，孩子体质一年比一年差，跑得动比多做两题更要紧。
options.t_en: I think sports facilities should vote more, children's physical fitness is worse year by year, running is more important than doing two more questions.

options.t: 我倾向把钱先花在课本和实验上，分数和升学才是硬道理，体育回家练也行。
options.t_en: I tend to spend my money on textbooks and experiments first, grades and schooling are the hard way, and sports can be practiced at home.

options.t: 我支持有兴趣的自己组队拉赞助，学校少出、孩子自己张罗，锻炼也练了处事。
options.t_en: I support the self-interested self to form a team to sponsor, the school is less frequent, the child's own Zhang Luo, and the exercise has also been practiced.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: School funds are tight, whether to add a laboratory or build a playground is disputed, and parents have different positions. Tension: academic or physical.

scene: 主队被资本收购，票价飞涨、队名都卖了，老球迷骂街，经理说这是趋势。张力在：体育精神还是商业逻辑。

options.t: 我觉得赚钱可以，但把招牌和情怀全卖了就过了，得留条底线护住球迷感情。
options.t_en: I think you can make money, but after selling all the signs and feelings, you have to leave a bottom line to protect the feelings of the fans.

options.t: 我认为职业体育本就是生意，票价随行就市、冠名换钱都正常，别太矫情。
options.t_en: I think professional sports is basically a business. The fares are normal, and the titles are changed. Don't be too affectionate.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The home team was bought by capital, ticket prices soared, team names were sold, old fans scolded the street, and the manager said it was a trend. The tension is in: sportsmanship or business logic.

scene: 城市竞标国际大赛，支持者说扬名，反对者说债要还几十年。张力在：城市形象还是财政风险。

options.t: 我支持去争办，全球转播下露脸、建起场馆，长远看值。
options.t_en: I support going to compete, appearing in global broadcasts, building venues, and seeing value in the long run.

options.t: 我主张掂量清楚，场馆赛后闲置、债务压几代人，不如把钱投民生。
options.t_en: I advocate weighing it clearly, it is better to invest money in people's livelihood if the venue is idle after the game and the debt weighs on generations.

options.t: 我倾向交给俱乐部和协会自己搞，政府别大包大揽，轻装上阵少负担。
options.t_en: I prefer to leave it to the clubs and associations to do their own work. The government should not make a big deal of it, and lightly load it with less burdens.

options.t: 我懒得追这种风口，别人办得热闹是别人的，咱把自家事办好就行。
options.t_en: I'm too lazy to chase this kind of outlet. It's someone else's job to be lively. Let's just take care of our own affairs.

options.t: 我先算账，能回本、带动旅游就办，铁定赔的本子我投反对。
options.t_en: I will calculate the accounts first, and if I can return the book and drive the tourism, I will do it. I will vote against the book of iron fixed compensation.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Urban bidding international competitions, with supporters claiming fame and opponents saying debt would take decades to pay. Tension: city image or financial risk.

scene: 顶级球星年薪上亿，网友吵该不该限，有人觉得凭本事，有人觉得太悬殊。张力在：市场回报还是收入均等。

options.t: 我认为明星球员带来票房和代言，市场给多少是他挣的，别眼红。
options.t_en: I think the star players bring the box office and endorsement, the market is how much he earns, don't blush.

options.t: 我支持设工资帽，把钱匀给青训和基层队员，队内差距别太离谱。
options.t_en: I support setting up salary caps and giving money to youth training and grassroots players. The gap within the team is too outrageous.

options.t: 我倾向收入和战绩挂钩，赢球拿得多、躺平就少，多劳多得最直观。
options.t_en: I tend to correlate income and track record, winning more, lying flat less, and working more is the most intuitive.

options.t: 我觉得冠军是集体拼的，奖金该大锅分，突出个人的天价我不太认同。
options.t_en: I think the champion is a collective fight, and the bonus should be divided into large pots, highlighting the individual's sky-high price. I do not agree.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: The annual salary of the top players is hundreds of millions, and netizens should not limit their quarrels. Some people feel that they can rely on their abilities, and some people feel that they are too disparate. The tension is: market returns or income parity.

scene: 少年体育苗子谁来培养起分歧，政府、俱乐部、学校各有盘算。张力在：普惠还是精英化。

options.t: 我认为青训该政府兜底、免费广覆盖，让普通孩子也有路走。
options.t_en: I think that the youth training government has a back seat, free and wide coverage, so that ordinary children have a way to go.

options.t: 我倾向交俱乐部市场化运作，能者上、效率高，政府少插手。
options.t_en: I prefer to hand over the club to market-oriented operation, capable and efficient, and the government is less involved.

options.t: 我主张校队和体校打通，孩子读书训练两不误，别早早退学搞专训。
options.t_en: I advocate that the school team and the sports school be connected, that the children's reading and training be correct, and that they not leave school early for special training.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The government, clubs, and schools have their own plans for who will cultivate differences in young sports seedlings. Tension: Pratt & Whitney is still elitist.

scene: 某跨性别运动员要报名，组委会为分组规则吵翻。张力在：公平竞赛还是包容。

options.t: 我主张按出生登记的性别分组，生理差异摆在那，否则对原组别的选手不公。
options.t_en: I advocate grouping by gender of birth registration, where the physiological differences are placed, otherwise it will be unfair to the players in the original group.

options.t: 我认为该尊重当事人自我认同，他或她觉得自己是哪个组就进哪个组。
options.t_en: I think it's important to respect the self-identification of the person, he or she feels like he or she belongs to a group.

options.t: 我倾向单设开放组，谁都能报，不硬塞进传统两类里，各比各的。
options.t_en: I prefer to set up a separate open group, anyone can report, do not squeeze into the traditional two categories, and compare each one.

options.t: 我觉得规则写不死，每例按医学和项目特点个案裁定，灵活处理。
options.t_en: I feel that the rules are not deadly, and each case is ruled according to the characteristics of the medicine and the project, and is handled flexibly.

options.t: 这种分组细节我不在意，谁赢谁输跟我关系不大。
options.t_en: I don't care about the details of this grouping, it doesn't matter who wins and who loses.

options.t: 我认为两类不够科学，可按激素水平等多设几档，更贴近真实差异。
options.t_en: I think that the two categories are not scientific enough, and can be set according to hormone levels and so on, which is closer to the real difference.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A transgender athlete wants to sign up, and the organizing committee quarrels over the group rules. The tension is: fair play or tolerance.

scene: 大赛领奖台，有选手想举标语表态，组委会怕惹事。张力在：赛场中立还是表达权。

options.t: 我认为体育归体育，领奖台别带货政治，免得赛事变战场。
options.t_en: I think sports belongs to sports, and podiums should not be political, so as not to turn events into battlefields.

options.t: 我支持选手在场上有话就说，沉默不是中立，表达也是人的权利。
options.t_en: I support players who say on the court that silence is not neutral and that expression is a human right.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: On the podium of the competition, some players wanted to hold up a slogan, and the organizing committee was afraid of causing trouble. Tension: Neutral or expressive.

scene: 电竞进不入大型赛事、算不算体育引争论，家长和孩子立场相反。张力在：体育定义。

options.t: 我认为电竞也是竞技，手眼协调和团队配合不比传统项目少，该认。
options.t_en: I think that esports is also a sport, and hand-eye coordination and team cooperation are no less than traditional projects, which should be recognized.

options.t: 我看法保守，打游戏就是娱乐休闲，硬塞进体育范畴我不太认。
options.t_en: I think it's conservative. Playing games is entertainment and leisure, and I don't really recognize it when it comes to sports.

options.t: 我支持给电竞一些政策和场地扶持，年轻人爱、产业也在，别当洪水。
options.t_en: I support giving some policy and venue support to e-sports. Young people love and industry are also there, don't be a flood.

options.t: 我交给市场，观众认、资本投它就能活，用不着官方定身份。
options.t_en: I hand it over to the market, and the audience can recognize it and invest capital in it, so there is no need for official identity.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Esports can not enter large-scale events, whether it is considered a sport to cause controversy, parents and children are in the opposite position. Tension in: Definition of sport.

scene: 德比战后看台互殴，警方和联盟商量怎么治。张力在：惩戒还是预防。

options.t: 我主张闹事的终身禁入球场、该拘就拘，零容忍才镇得住。
options.t_en: I advocate a lifelong ban on entering the stadium, detention and detention, and zero tolerance before it can be contained.

options.t: 我认为把安检和隔离做在前面，分流对立球迷，比事后抓人管用。
options.t_en: I think it is better to put security checks and isolation in front and divert opposing fans than to catch people afterwards.

options.t: 我更想从球迷文化入手，做导视、倡文明助威，根上少点火气。
options.t_en: I would like to start with the fan culture, do guidance, advocate civilization, and ignite less fire at the root.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: After the war, the derby stands beat each other, and the police and the alliance discussed how to deal with it. The tension is in: discipline or prevention.

scene: 养老金池子见紧，是否延退引发争论，老人想歇、财政想扛。张力在：基金可持续还是个人生活。

options.t: 我支持适当延退，多缴几年少领几年，池子才撑得住，也是为后人。
options.t_en: I support an appropriate retreat, paying more and less for a few years, before the pool can hold, but also for future generations.

options.t: 我主张让人早点退，辛苦一辈子该享清福，钱不够我用积蓄补，别熬到走不动。
options.t_en: I advocate letting people retire sooner, hard work should enjoy the blessings of a lifetime, the money is not enough for me to use my savings to supplement, don't work until you can't move.

options.t: 我倾向给个区间自己选，身体好想干的接着干、想休的到点休，别一刀切。
options.t_en: I tend to choose a range for myself. I want to do what I want to do, and I want to rest until the end, don't be one-size-fits-all.

options.t: 我认为体力活和脑力活分开定，井下挖煤和坐办公室不能一个岁数退。
options.t_en: I think that physical work and mental work are set separately, and underground coal mining and sitting in the office can not be withdrawn for one year.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The pension pool is tight. Whether to delay retirement has caused controversy. The elderly want to rest and want to bear the financial burden. The tension lies in whether the fund is sustainable or personal.

scene: 新建养老院是公办还是民办，居民和投资者各有所图。张力在：公益还是效率。

options.t: 我认为养老院该政府办、低价普惠，兜底弱势老人，不能纯赚钱。
options.t_en: I think that the government-run nursing home, low prices and universal benefits, and the vulnerable elderly can not make pure money.

options.t: 我倾向放开民办，多家竞争服务好、价格也合理，政府少养机构。
options.t_en: I tend to liberalize the private sector. Many competitive services are good, the prices are reasonable, and the government rehabilitates institutions.

options.t: 我更看好社区日间照料和上门服务，老人住熟的地儿、儿女也近，比进院强。
options.t_en: I am more optimistic about community day care and door-to-door services. The elderly live close to familiar places and children, which is better than entering the hospital.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: Whether the new nursing home is public or private, residents and investors have their own plans. The tension is in: public welfare or efficiency.

scene: 失能老人躺床，子女和工作两头烧，争论照护归家还是归社会。张力在：孝道还是专业化。

options.t: 我认为伺候爹妈是儿女本分，再难也得自己顶上，不能推给外人。
options.t_en: I think that serving parents is the duty of sons and daughters, and it is difficult to get on top of yourself and can not be pushed to outsiders.

options.t: 我主张交给专业护理和机构，子女出钱出力配合，专业照护比瞎忙更靠谱。
options.t_en: I advocate professional care and institutions, children pay for cooperation, professional care is more reliable than blind.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The disabled elderly lay in bed, their children and their work burned, debating whether to take care of their families or return to society. Tension: filial piety or professionalism.

scene: 社区推智能手环和监测床垫，老人嫌麻烦、子女图安心。张力在：科技照护还是自主。

options.t: 我支持政府给高龄老人免费配设备，紧急一键呼，兜底安全。
options.t_en: I support the government to provide elderly people with free equipment, emergency one-click call, and safety at the bottom of the pocket.

options.t: 我认为愿意用的自己买，丰俭由人，别拿公帑给人人配。
options.t_en: I think that I am willing to use myself to buy, frugality by people, don't take public money to everyone.

options.t: 我倾向社区摆几台共用的监测仪，谁家需要时借，省钱也覆盖到。
options.t_en: I tend to have a few shared monitors in the community, and anyone who needs to borrow them can save money.

options.t: 我交给市场，厂商出产品、老人挑，政府别包办。
options.t_en: I handed it over to the market, the manufacturer produced the product, the elderly picked it, and the government did not take care of it.

options.t: 我老了就信不过这些电子玩意，手环响了我还心慌，宁可土法照应。
options.t_en: I can't believe these electronic gadgets when I'm old. I'm still panicking when my wristband rings. I'd rather take care of it with clay.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The community pushes smart bracelets and monitoring mattresses, making the elderly feel troublesome and children feel at ease. Tension: technology care or autonomy.

scene: 退休教师想返聘，企业怕占年轻人岗，政策怎么定引议。张力在：发挥余热还是岗位挤出。

options.t: 我认为身体好、有经验的多干几年挺好，带带年轻人也充实自己。
options.t_en: I think it is good to have good health and experience for a few more years, and bring young people to enrich themselves.

options.t: 我主张设规矩，返聘不能挤掉该招的年轻人，岗位总量得守住。
options.t_en: I advocate the establishment of rules, rehiring young people who cannot squeeze out the recruitment, and the total number of positions must be kept.

options.t: 我反对招聘里暗设年龄线，行就行、不行就不行，不该因为岁数被挡。
options.t_en: I oppose the implicit age line in recruitment. If you can do it, you can't do it. You should not be blocked because of your age.

options.t: 我倾向不提倡不限制，想干的去、不想干的歇，个人自愿最要紧。
options.t_en: I tend not to advocate unrestricted, want to do, do not want to do rest, personal volunteering is the most important.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Retired teachers want to rehire, companies are afraid to occupy young people's posts, how to decide the policy. The tension is in: exerting waste heat or extruding from the post.

scene: 阿尔茨海默老人走失频发，家属和社会找解法。张力在：专门机构还是家庭社区支持。

options.t: 我认为该建专门失智照护中心，普通养老院搞不定，专业才少出事。
options.t_en: I think that the construction of a special dementia care center, ordinary nursing homes can not be done, professional accidents are rare.

options.t: 我支持给在家照顾的家属发补贴和培训，能不让老人离家的就别送走。
options.t_en: I support subsidies and training for family members who care at home. If you can't let the elderly leave the house, don't send them away.

options.t: 我倾向社区建日间中心和随访，家属喘息、老人也有伴，中间路线最稳。
options.t_en: I tend to build day centers and follow-ups in the community, with family members breathing and the elderly accompanying me, and the middle route is the most stable.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: Alzheimer's elderly are often lost, and families and society find solutions. The tension is in: specialized agencies or family community support.

scene: 独居老人整天没人说话，社区想点子解孤独。张力在：公共资源还是私人市场。

options.t: 我认为社区该建个活动室，老人下棋聊天有地儿去，热闹就不孤。
options.t_en: I think the community should build an activity room, and the elderly have a place to play chess and chat, and it is not lonely to be lively.

options.t: 我支持志愿者和老人一对一结对，常去看看、聊聊天，人情最暖。
options.t_en: I support one-on-one pairing between volunteers and the elderly. I often go to see and chat, and I feel the warmest.

options.t: 我觉得解孤独首先儿女常回、常打视频，外人替不了骨肉。
options.t_en: I think Xie Lugu first of all, his sons and daughters often return and often play videos, and outsiders can't replace bone and flesh

options.t: 我倾向教老人用平板和视频，隔空也能见着孙辈，科技拉近距离。
options.t_en: I tend to teach the elderly to use tablets and videos, and I can meet my grandchildren from space, and technology brings them closer.

options.t: 我认为愿意付费就买陪伴服务，有人陪逛陪聊，明码标价也省儿女心。
options.t_en: I think that if you are willing to pay for companionship services, someone will walk and talk with you, and the price tag will save your children's hearts.

options.t: 我看得开，老了独处是常态，习惯就好，不必大动干戈。
options.t_en: I can see it. It's normal to be alone when you're old, just get used to it, and you don't have to do much.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Old people who live alone have no one to talk to all day, and the community wants to solve their loneliness. The tension is: public resources or private markets.

scene: 老人立遗嘱，子女为多尽孝能不能多分吵。张力在：赡养义务还是继承回报。

options.t: 我认为伺候老人天经地义，不能拿继承当交换，尽孝不是买卖。
options.t_en: I think that serving the elderly is righteous and cannot be exchanged for inheritance, and filial piety is not a trade.

options.t: 我主张没尽孝的就少分乃至不分，权利义务对等，不能又不管又要钱。
options.t_en: I advocate that those who are not filial piety are less divided or even indiscriminate, their rights and obligations are equal, and they cannot and do not care about asking for money.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The elderly made a will, and the children could not make more quarrels for as much filial piety as possible. The tension lies in: maintenance obligations or inheritance returns.

scene: ICU 床位紧，先救老人还是青年起争议。张力在：年龄倾斜还是按需公平。

options.t: 我认为老人辛劳一生，该多分点医疗资源，尊老不能只挂嘴上。
options.t_en: I think that the elderly work hard all their lives, should have more medical resources, respect the elderly can not just hang on to it.

options.t: 我倾向按病情紧急和预后排，不因岁数加分也不减分，谁更救命救谁。
options.t_en: I tend to rank according to the urgency and prognosis of the situation, not because of age plus points or points, who saves lives and who saves lives.

options.t: 我主张把费用控一控，更多投向青年和儿童的长期健康，性价比更高。
options.t_en: I advocate controlling expenses in one place, and investing more in the long-term health of young people and children, which is more cost-effective.

options.t: 我认为不论老少都该被平等接住，制度设计别预埋年龄偏好。
options.t_en: I think that both young and old should be equally caught, and the system design should not embed age preferences.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The beds in the ICU are tight, and it is controversial whether to save the elderly or the young first. Tension in: Age tilt or on-demand fairness.

scene: 老楼没电梯、门槛高，改造钱谁出起分歧。张力在：公共出资还是业主自担。

options.t: 我支持政府出钱做坡道和电梯，这是基本适老刚需，老人等不起。
options.t_en: I support the government to pay for ramps and elevators, which are basically suitable for the elderly, and the elderly can't wait.

options.t: 我认为谁受益谁出，楼道是业主的，摊钱改造理所应当。
options.t_en: I think whoever benefits will come out, the corridor is the owner, and it is reasonable to contribute money to the renovation.

options.t: 我倾向政府补大头、住户出小头，既推得动又不全赖财政。
options.t_en: I tend to make the government bigger and households smaller, both pushing and not relying on finance.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The old building does not have an elevator, the threshold is high, and whoever renovates the money will disagree. Zhang Li in: public funding or the owner's own responsibility.

scene: 短视频里秒到账、零门槛的贷款广告轰炸年轻人。张力在：金融便利还是诱导风险。

options.t: 我认为这类广告得严管，专盯缺钱的学生诱他们借，坑人得治。
options.t_en: I think that such advertisements should be strictly controlled, targeting students who lack money to lure them to borrow, and the pitchers should be treated.

options.t: 我倾向让机构正常打广告，成年人有判断力，管太宽反倒不自由。
options.t_en: I tend to let agencies advertise normally, adults have judgment, and too wide a pipe is not free.

options.t: 我主张广告必须醒目写清利率和违约后果，让人看清再点，比禁掉实在。
options.t_en: I advocate that advertisements must clearly write the interest rate and the consequences of default, so that people can see it clearly, rather than ban it.

options.t: 我支持对在校学生和刚工作的青年限推，这拨人最易冲动负债，护一下。
options.t_en: I support the limited push on school students and young people who have just worked. This group is most prone to impulsive debt and protect them.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: In the short video, second-to-second, zero-threshold loan advertisements bombard young people. The tension is in: financial convenience or induced risk.

scene: 诚实破产的小店主申请免责重来，债权人怕被赖账。张力在：重生机会还是防滥用。

options.t: 我认为真心还不起的该给免责，让人甩掉包袱重新站起，社会也少个流浪债主。
options.t_en: I think that people who really can't afford to repay should be exempted from liability, so that people can get rid of their burdens and get back on their feet, and there are few wandering creditors in society.

options.t: 我主张把门槛设高、审查严，怕有人借破产逃债，规矩得硬。
options.t_en: I advocate setting a high threshold and strict censorship. I am afraid that someone will use bankruptcy to evade debts, and the rules will be tough.

options.t: 我倾向免一部分、留一部分慢慢还，两头兼顾，既减负又讲信用。
options.t_en: I tend to avoid some and leave some slowly, taking care of both ends, both reducing the burden and talking about credit.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The honest and bankrupt shopkeeper applied for exoneration again, and the creditor was afraid of being defaulted. The tension is in: rebirth opportunity or anti-abuse.

scene: 同事月月透支买新款，你咋看。张力在：理性储蓄还是信用工具。

options.t: 我认为能不欠就不欠，量入为出睡得着，透支买爽一时还债半年的事我不干。
options.t_en: I think I can't owe if I don't owe, I can fall asleep if I want to. I will not do the work of overdrafting to pay off debts for half a year.

options.t: 我看法灵活，额度用得好能周转应急，关键别超自己还款能力，工具无所谓好坏。
options.t_en: I think it is flexible, and the quota can be used for emergency turnaround. The key is not to exceed your own repayment ability, and the tools do not matter whether they are good or bad.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: What do you think of your colleague's monthly overdraft to buy a new model? The tension is in: rational savings or credit instruments.

scene: 某网贷年化高得吓人，监管在定利率天花板。张力在：利率管制还是市场定价。

options.t: 我支持设法定利率上限，太高就是吸血，弱势借款人得有护城河。
options.t_en: I support setting a legal interest rate cap, too high is blood sucking, and weak borrowers have to have moats.

options.t: 我认为利率随风险走、市场定，强压上限反而没人借钱给一般人。
options.t_en: I think that the interest rate goes with the risk and the market is fixed, and no one lends money to the average person to press the upper limit.

options.t: 我主张先把真实年化、费用全亮出来，借款人看得懂，比限价更治本。
options.t_en: I advocate first showing the true annualization and expenses, which is more understandable to borrowers than the limit price.

options.t: 我倾向直接禁掉明显高利和暴力催收的产品，这类碰都不能碰。
options.t_en: I tend to directly ban products that are obviously profitable and violently collected, and such touches cannot be touched.

options.t: 我更想抓金融科普，让人懂复利多吓人，少借自然少被宰。
options.t_en: I would rather catch financial science popularization, let people understand that compound interest is more scary, borrow less and be killed less naturally.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The annualization of a certain net loan is frighteningly high, and supervision is on the ceiling of fixed interest rates. The tension is in: interest rate control or market pricing.

scene: 弹窗、短信、直播轮番推销，消费者烦不胜烦。张力在：营销自由还是不被骚扰。

options.t: 我认为该立法管住狂轰滥炸，静默权是基本尊严，商家不能想推就推。
options.t_en: I think the legislation regulates indiscriminate bombing, the right to silence is a basic dignity, and merchants can't push it if they want to.

options.t: 我倾向自己练就火眼金睛，不点不买，规矩再多也不如自己清醒。
options.t_en: I tend to cultivate my own fire eyes and golden eyes, not ordering or not buying, and the rules are no more than my own sobriety.

options.t: 我支持平台和企业自定规范，少发垃圾信息，口碑比骚扰值钱。
options.t_en: I support the platform and the enterprise to set their own standards, spam less, word of mouth is worth more than harassment.

options.t: 我主张在休息时段、特定场合禁推销，比如夜里和医院学校周边。
options.t_en: I advocate banning sales during breaks and on certain occasions, such as at night and around hospital schools.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Pop-ups, text messages, and live streams are promoted in turn, and consumers are annoyed. The tension is: marketing freedom or not to be harassed.

scene: 到手工资，是存起来还是花掉，两口子习惯不同。张力在：稳健还是享受。

options.t: 我认为手里有粮心不慌，先存后花，万一失业生病才不至于抓瞎。
options.t_en: I think there is no panic in the hand, save first and then spend, in case of unemployment and illness, you will not be caught blind.

options.t: 我倾向挣了适当花，太抠自己对不起辛苦，把握分寸就好。
options.t_en: I tend to earn the right flowers. I'm too sorry for my hard work, just grasp the proportion.

options.t: 我本就不爱买，东西够用就行，少消费既省钱又少扔，活得轻。
options.t_en: I don't like to buy, I only need enough things. Consuming less saves money and less to throw away, and I live lightly.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Arrival salary, whether it is saved or spent, the two habits are different. The tension is: steady or enjoy.

scene: 朋友信用卡加网贷滚到还不上，问你咋办。张力在：求助路径多样。

options.t: 我建议他找银行或持牌机构谈分期重组，别碰黑中介，正道协商能减负。
options.t_en: I suggest that he talk to the bank or licensed institution about the phased restructuring, do not touch the black intermediary, the right way negotiation can reduce the burden.

options.t: 我认为这种时候先跟家里坦白，亲戚帮一把先把坑填上，亲情这时候顶用。
options.t_en: I think that at this time, I will confess to the family first, and the relatives will fill in the pit first, and the family will use it at this time.

options.t: 我主张符合条件的去申请社会救助或法律援助，制度本就是兜底的。
options.t_en: I advocate that eligible to apply for social assistance or legal aid, the system is in the background.

options.t: 我倾向自己多打份工慢慢还，虽然累但干净，债是自己的得自己扛。
options.t_en: I tend to pay back more work slowly, although tired but clean, the debt is my own to bear.

options.t: 若真山穷水尽，我走合法破产清零重来，也比躲债强。
options.t_en: If the real mountain is exhausted, I will go through legal bankruptcy and clear it again, which is also stronger than hiding debts.

options.t: 我选择不理催收电话，反正暂时还不上，等有了再谈，催也不多钱。
options.t_en: I chose to ignore the collection call. Anyway, I couldn't make it for the time being. I'll talk about it later, and there won't be much money to urge.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: My friend's credit card and net loan have not yet rolled over, ask you what to do. Tension in: There are many ways to get help.

scene: 财政想对奢侈品加税，有人赞调节、有人嫌多事。张力在：再分配还是消费自由。

options.t: 我认为对豪表游艇加税、补公共服务，富人的消费多担点，社会更平。
options.t_en: I think tax hikes on luxury yachts and making up for public services will make wealthy people's consumption more burdensome and society more equitable.

options.t: 我倾向别管，人家合法赚的愿买啥买啥，加税只会把消费赶去外地。
options.t_en: I tend to ignore the fact that people legally earn what they want to buy and what they want to buy. Increasing taxes will only drive consumption out of the country.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Finance wants to raise taxes on luxury goods, some praise regulation, some dislike many things. Tension: redistribution or freedom of consumption.

scene: 年轻人频频踩坑，要不要把理财课塞进学校起争议。张力在：必修干预还是自愿。

options.t: 我认为理财和防骗该进课堂必修，这比背公式管用，少一代人上当。
options.t_en: I think that financial management and fraud prevention should be compulsory in the classroom, which is more effective than the back formula and less than a generation.

options.t: 我支持搞社区讲座和公益课，覆盖面广、不占学制，成人也能学。
options.t_en: I support community lectures and public welfare classes, which cover a wide range of subjects, are not academic, and adults can learn.

options.t: 我倾向开选修和线上资源，想学的自来，别强制人人背金融术语。
options.t_en: I prefer to take electives and online resources. I want to learn from scratch. Don't force everyone to memorize financial terms.

options.t: 我觉得这种事家里教最实在，父母以身作则比学校一课印象深。
options.t_en: I think this kind of thing is the most real teaching at home, and my parents are more impressed by their example than the school.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Young people often step on the pit, and whether to cram the financial management class into the school is controversial. Tension in: Compulsory intervention or voluntary.

scene: 注册 APP 时自动续费被偷偷勾好，用户投诉。张力在：默认设置还是选择自由。

options.t: 我认为偷偷勾选续费就是坑，该禁止默认勾选，开通得用户主动点。
options.t_en: I think that secretly checking the renewal fee is a pit, the default check is prohibited, and the user can take the initiative to open it.

options.t: 我主张只要写清楚、位置醒目，让用户看见再决定，不必一刀切禁。
options.t_en: I advocate that as long as it is written clearly and the location is eye-catching, so that the user can see and decide, there is no need to ban it all.

options.t: 我倾向交给市场，用户用脚投票、差评倒逼改，监管别伸手太长。
options.t_en: I tend to leave it to the market. Users use their feet to vote, bad reviews to force changes, and supervision should not reach out too long.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The automatic renewal was secretly hooked up when registering the app, and the user complained. Tension in: default setting or freedom of choice.

scene: 沿海要建核电站补电力，居民怕泄漏、环保者赞低碳。张力在：清洁能源还是安全风险。

options.t: 我认为核电是低碳大头，气候账上划算，技术成熟就该建，替掉煤电。
options.t_en: I think nuclear power is a low-carbon big head, and it is cost-effective on the climate bill. If the technology matures, it should be built to replace coal power.

options.t: 我怕一旦出事殃及几代人，宁可慢点、用别的，安全比碳排更要紧。
options.t_en: I am afraid that if something happens to a few generations, I would rather slow down and use something else. Safety is more important than carbon emissions.

options.t: 我主张现有场址延寿、不再新开地址，人口密集处尤其慎重。
options.t_en: I advocate extending the life of existing sites and no longer opening new addresses, especially in densely populated areas.

options.t: 我倾向一址一评，地质、疏散、应急都过关才批，不盲目也不死拒。
options.t_en: I tend to comment on one site at a time. Geology, evacuation, and emergency response are all approved only after passing the customs, and they are not blinded or rejected.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: Coastal nuclear power plants should be built to replenish electricity, and residents are afraid of leaks and environmentalists praise low-carbon. Tension in: Clean energy or safety risk.

scene: 风电光伏靠补贴活，财政想退坡引争议。张力在：扶持新兴还是市场竞价。

options.t: 我认为绿电还在婴儿期，补贴拉着它长大，环境账长远看值。
options.t_en: I think green electricity is still in its infancy, subsidies have grown up with it, and the long-term value of environmental accounts.

options.t: 我倾向让绿电进场竞价，能便宜就留、不能就出，别永远靠喂奶。
options.t_en: I tend to let green electricity into the market bidding, can be cheap to stay, can not go out, do not always rely on breastfeeding.

options.t: 我主张设时间表慢慢退，逼行业降本，也别一下抽干把厂子搞垮。
options.t_en: I advocate setting a timetable to slowly retreat, forcing the industry to reduce costs, and don't drain the factory.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: Wind power and photovoltaics rely on subsidies to survive, and the financial desire to retreat from the slope is controversial. The tension is in: supporting emerging or market bidding.

scene: 电网要不要拆分引入民营，议论纷纷。张力在：统管公益还是市场化效率。

options.t: 我认为电网是命脉，国有统管才稳，不能交给资本逐利乱来。
options.t_en: I think the power grid is the lifeblood, the state-owned centralized management is stable, and it cannot be handed over to capital for profit.

options.t: 我支持引入竞争和民营，打破一家独大，效率和价格都能好。
options.t_en: I support the introduction of competition and the private sector, breaking the family apart, efficiency and price can be good.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: Whether the power grid should be split and introduced into the private sector has been discussed. The tension is in: controlling public welfare or market-oriented efficiency.

scene: 城市定禁售燃油车时间表，车主和车企反应不一。张力在：环保强制还是过渡自由。

options.t: 我支持定个年限停售燃油车，给明确预期，转型才推得动。
options.t_en: I support the suspension of sales of fuel vehicles for a set period of time, and give clear expectations before the transformation is pushed forward.

options.t: 我认为让电动车自己卷赢就行，强禁反而伤刚买油车的人。
options.t_en: I think it's ok to let the electric car win on its own, forcing a ban on people who have just bought a gasoline car.

options.t: 我主张发补贴鼓励以旧换新，老百姓少掏、减排也快，两头甜。
options.t_en: I advocate issuing subsidies to encourage exchanging the old for the new. The common people pay less and reduce emissions quickly, and the two ends are sweet.

options.t: 我倾向别下死命令，愿换换、不愿换开到报废，个人节奏自己定。
options.t_en: I tend not to give dead orders, willing to change, unwilling to change to scrap, personal rhythm.

options.t: 我支持对油车收碳税，用价格慢慢引导，比禁令柔和。
options.t_en: I support a carbon tax on gasoline cars, guided slowly by price, softer than a ban.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The city has set a timetable for banning fuel vehicles, and car owners and car companies have reacted differently. The tension is in: environmental compulsion or transition freedom.

scene: 一笔基建款，投生态工程还是投产业园，吵不完。张力在：生态、增长还是民生。

options.t: 我认为先投绿地、治污、海绵城市，环境好了人才能住。
options.t_en: I think that people can live only if the environment is good by investing in green space, pollution control, and sponge city first.

options.t: 我倾向投产业园和交通，先把经济和就业拉起来，钱包鼓了再说别的。
options.t_en: I tend to invest in industrial parks and transportation, pulling up the economy and employment first, and the wallet is bulging before saying anything else.

options.t: 我主张补学校、医院、老旧小区这些短板，老百姓天天用得着。
options.t_en: I advocate making up for the shortcomings of schools, hospitals, and old neighborhoods, which are used by ordinary people every day.

options.t: 我觉得三者都得沾，单押一边都偏，分配匀一点最稳。
options.t_en: I think that all three have to be dipped in. Single presses are biased on one side, and it is most stable to distribute them evenly.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: An infrastructure fund, investment in ecological projects or investment in industrial parks, endless noise. The tension is in: ecology, growth or people's livelihood.

scene: 冬天燃气涨价，要不要管制引议。张力在：民生保供还是市场价。

options.t: 我认为基础能源得管制，老人穷人扛不住暴涨，民生不能随波逐流。
options.t_en: I believe that basic energy must be regulated, the elderly and poor cannot withstand the soaring price, and the people's livelihood cannot go with the flow.

options.t: 我倾向价格随供需走，信号对了才省得浪费，补贴不如用在刀刃。
options.t_en: I tend to go with the supply and demand, the signal is right to save waste, subsidies are better used on the blade.

options.t: 我主张用多少、什么价分档，基本用量便宜、浪费的贵，公平又节能。
options.t_en: I advocate how much and what price to use, the basic amount is cheap, wasteful and expensive, fair and energy-saving.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: If the price of gas rises in winter, should it be regulated? Tension in: People's livelihood insurance supply or market price.

scene: 偏远村没光纤，运营商嫌亏不肯拉。张力在：普遍服务还是市场覆盖。

options.t: 我认为网络是基础设施，政府得托底让村村通，不能留数字鸿沟。
options.t_en: I think that the Internet is the infrastructure, and the government has to let the villages connect without leaving a digital divide.

options.t: 我倾向让运营商按收益自己铺，亏的地方它不来，市场说了算。
options.t_en: I tend to let the operator shop according to the revenue. Where it loses money, it does not come, and the market is in control.

options.t: 我主张城乡差异大的农村由政府专项兜底，城市交给市场。
options.t_en: I advocate that the rural areas with large differences between urban and rural areas should be specially backed by the government, and the cities should be handed over to the market.

options.t: 我支持政府补贴、企业出网，PPP 模式分摊，谁也别全扛。
options.t_en: I support government subsidies, enterprise out of the net, PPP mode sharing, who do not bear all.

options.t: 我认为愿用卫星或自购设备的自己装，不强求统一覆盖。
options.t_en: I think that I am willing to use the satellite or self-purchased equipment, and do not insist on uniform coverage.

options.t: 通不通宽带跟我住的地儿无关，我不操这份心。
options.t_en: The broadband connection has nothing to do with where I live, I don't care about that.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: There was no optical fiber in the remote villages, and the operators were reluctant to pull back. The tension is: universal service or market coverage.

scene: 河流要建大坝发电，环保说淹林、支持者说供电。张力在：能源还是生态。

options.t: 我认为大坝调水发电实在，枯水季有电、还能防洪，利大于弊。
options.t_en: I think that dam water diversion and power generation is real, there is electricity in the dry season, and it can also prevent floods, the benefits outweigh the disadvantages.

options.t: 我倾向慎重，淹掉的一片林和鱼道断了补不回，能不建就不建。
options.t_en: I tend to be cautious. A forest and fish path that has been flooded is broken and cannot be repaired. If it is not built, it will not be built.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: Rivers need to build dams to generate electricity, environmental protection says flooded forests, supporters say power supply. Tension: energy or ecology.

scene: 进口能源不稳，要不要死磕自家产量引分歧。张力在：自主还是全球采购。

options.t: 我认为能源握自己手里才安心，外部一卡就瘫，自主优先。
options.t_en: I think that only when the energy is in your own hands can you feel at ease, the external card will be paralyzed, and autonomy will take precedence.

options.t: 我倾向哪家便宜买哪家，全球化分工省成本，没必要样样自己造。
