options.t_en: I prefer which one is cheaper to buy, the global division of labor saves costs, and there is no need to make it yourself.

options.t: 我主张来源多几条线，不押一户、也不闭门，稳当。
options.t_en: I advocate that the source has a few more lines, do not bet one house, do not close the door, and be steady.

options.t: 我更想押风电光伏这类自家屋顶就能发的，少看别人脸色。
options.t_en: I would rather push wind, electricity, photovoltaics, and so on on my own roof, so as not to look at other people's faces.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Imported energy is unstable, whether to bog down in their own production will lead to disagreement. Tension: autonomous or global sourcing.

scene: 新修的路桥年年要养，钱谁出起争议。张力在：使用者付费还是财政维。

options.t: 我认为走的人出养路费、过桥费，谁用谁担，公平。
options.t_en: I think it's fair for people who walk to pay tolls and tolls, and who pays for them.

options.t: 我支持从税收里出维护，路是公共品，全民受益全民养。
options.t_en: I support maintenance from taxation, the road is public goods, and the whole people benefit from universal support.

options.t: 我倾向沿线受益的地方政府分摊，谁近谁多担，就近原则。
options.t_en: I tend to share among local governments that benefit along the route, and the principle of proximity is the principle of who is near and who is burdened.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The newly built roads and bridges have to be maintained year after year, and the money is disputed. The tension is in: the user pays or the financial dimension.

scene: 城市定减排目标，工厂、个人、政府互相看对方动。张力在：谁该带头。

options.t: 我认为减排得政府下指标、立规矩，靠自觉根本推不动。
options.t_en: I believe that emission reduction requires the government to set targets and establish rules, and it cannot be driven by consciousness.

options.t: 我主张从自己做起，少开空调多公交，聚沙成塔也是力。
options.t_en: I advocate starting from myself, turning on less air conditioning and more buses, and gathering sand into a tower is also a force.

options.t: 我倾向抓大头，企业排放占绝大多数，管住工厂比管百姓有效。
options.t_en: I tend to take the lead, companies account for the vast majority of emissions, and managing factories is more effective than managing the people.

options.t: 我认为这是全球病，各国一齐定标准、互通技术才治本。
options.t_en: I think this is a global disease. Only by setting standards and interoperating technologies can countries cure the root cause.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Cities set emission reduction targets, and factories, individuals, and governments look at each other. Tension in: Who should take the lead.

scene: 洪灾过后，灾民往哪安置起分歧。张力在：政府统筹、互助还是保险。

options.t: 我认为这种时刻得政府统一安置、发物资，秩序才稳。
options.t_en: I think that such moments must be unified by the government to place and distribute materials, so that order can be stable.

options.t: 我支持邻里和民间救援先顶上，乡亲凑物资、腾空房，人情最及时。
options.t_en: I support the neighborhood and folk rescue first, and the folks gather supplies and vacate the house, which is the most timely.

options.t: 我倾向让巨灾保险赔，事前的保费换来事后的底气，少靠临时拨款。
options.t_en: I tend to make catastrophe insurance claims, and the premiums beforehand are exchanged for the confidence afterwards, relying less on temporary allocations.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: After the floods, there were disagreements about where to place the victims. The tension is in: government planning, mutual aid or insurance.

scene: 海平面上升，临海村落要不要整体搬。张力在：避险还是恋土。

options.t: 我认为该早搬，命比房子金贵，淹了再悔就晚，政府规划好新村。
options.t_en: I think it is time to move early, life is more expensive than the house, it is late to repent after flooding, and the government plans a new village.

options.t: 我倾向加固堤坝、原地守着，祖辈的地挪不走，能扛就扛。
options.t_en: I tend to reinforce levees and guard them in place. My ancestors can't move the ground, so they can carry it if they can.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: If the sea level rises, should the coastal villages move as a whole? Tension is in: risk aversion or love.

scene: 一笔适应资金，投工程、生态还是搬迁吵。张力在：硬防护还是软恢复。

options.t: 我认为先修堤、建蓄水池这些硬杠杠，挡灾最立竿见影。
options.t_en: I think that the hard bars such as repairing the levee and building the reservoir first are the most immediate effects of preventing disasters.

options.t: 我主张种红树林、复湿地，自然系统兜底的性价比高也持久。
options.t_en: I advocate the planting of mangroves and complex wetlands, and the high cost performance and durability of natural systems.

options.t: 我倾向把钱用在帮高危区的人搬走，人挪活，比硬抗自然省。
options.t_en: I tend to use my money to help people in high-risk areas move away, and people move, which is harder to resist natural provinces.

options.t: 我支持用保险和再保险分散风险，市场工具补政府短板。
options.t_en: I support the use of insurance and reinsurance to spread risk, and market tools to make up for the shortcomings of the government.

options.t: 我看重社区自己练应急、囤物资、互帮，韧性从下往上长。
options.t_en: I value the community to practice emergency response, hoard materials, and help each other, and resilience grows from bottom to top.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: An adaptation fund, investment in engineering, ecology or relocation noise. Tension in: hard protection or soft recovery.

scene: 台风预警发到哪一层起争议。张力在：普惠、精准还是市场。

options.t: 我认为预警该人人免费收到，这是保命信息，不能设门槛。
options.t_en: I think the warning is free for everyone, this is a life-saving message, and there is no threshold.

options.t: 我主张结合位置推送到户，老人小孩也能被提醒，别只发公众号。
options.t_en: I advocate combining location push to households, the elderly and children can also be reminded, do not just issue public numbers.

options.t: 我倾向基础免费、深度分析付费，愿多知的买增值包。
options.t_en: I prefer to pay for basic free, in-depth analysis, and buy value-added packages if I want to know more.

options.t: 我支持社区大喇叭和网格员兜底，网络不通的地方靠人喊。
options.t_en: I support community loudspeakers and grids, and people shouting where the Internet is not working.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The level of the typhoon warning is disputed. The tension is in: Pratt & Whitney, Precision or Market.

scene: 收上来的碳税花哪引分歧。张力在：返贫、投绿技还是减税。

options.t: 我认为碳税压穷人最狠，税款该返给低收入家庭，别让他们买单。
options.t_en: I think the carbon tax is the hardest on the poor, and the tax should be returned to low-income families, don't let them pay for it.

options.t: 我主张把钱砸进清洁能源研发，从源头减碳，长远看最值。
options.t_en: I advocate throwing money into clean energy research and development, reducing carbon from the source, the best value in the long run.

options.t: 我倾向拿去对冲其他税，整体税负别因碳税抬高，企业轻一点。
options.t_en: I prefer to hedge against other taxes. The overall tax burden should not be raised due to carbon taxes, and companies should be lighter.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Where the carbon tax is collected leads to disagreement. Tension is in: returning to poverty, investing in green technology, or reducing taxes.

scene: 富国该不该掏钱帮穷国减排起争议。张力在：国际责任还是本国优先。

options.t: 我认为历史上排碳多的该出钱帮脆弱国，公平也互利。
options.t_en: I think that in history, we should pay for more carbon emissions to help fragile countries, which is fair and mutually beneficial.

options.t: 我主张带条件的援，钱花在实打实减排上，别养懒账。
options.t_en: I advocate conditional aid. Spend money on actual emission reduction, and don't be lazy.

options.t: 我支持转清洁技术代替直接给钱，授人以渔更长效。
options.t_en: I support the transfer of clean technology instead of direct payment, giving people a longer fishing effect.

options.t: 我倾向先把自己的家和穷人顾好，往外撒钱我投反对。
options.t_en: I tend to take care of my home and the poor first, and I vote against throwing money out.

options.t: 我认为用碳交易等市场手段撮合，钱跟项目走，别搞捐赠。
options.t_en: I think that with market means such as carbon trading, the money will go with the project, don't make a donation.

options.t: 这种国际扯皮离我太远，援不援都行，我不关心。
options.t_en: This kind of international trolling is too far away from me, whether you want to help or not, I don't care.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: It is debatable whether rich countries should pay poor countries to cut their emissions. The tension is in: international responsibility or national priority.

scene: 限塑令要不要加码引议。张力在：强制还是倡导。

options.t: 我认为限塑得强制，塑料袋白给惯了，不罚不改，海洋等不起。
options.t_en: I think the plastic limit is mandatory, the plastic bag is used to it, no penalty will not change, the ocean can't wait.

options.t: 我倾向多宣传、提供布袋，自愿减比硬罚更顺心，慢慢来。
options.t_en: I tend to advertise more, provide cloth bags, and voluntarily reduce the hard penalty more easily and slowly.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Should the plastic limit order be overweighted? Tension in: compulsion or advocacy.

scene: 地震带要不要强制巨灾险起分歧。张力在：强制共担还是自愿。

options.t: 我认为高风险区该强制投保，摊薄损失，灾后不用全靠哭穷。
options.t_en: I think that high-risk areas should be compulsorily insured, dilute losses, and do not rely on crying poverty after the disaster.

options.t: 我倾向愿保就保，有人觉得自己命硬或手头紧，强扭的瓜不甜。
options.t_en: I tend to be willing to keep it. Some people feel that they are fierce or tightly handed, and the strong melon is not sweet.

options.t: 我主张真出了大事政府先顶，保险补不上处由财政填。
options.t_en: I advocate that if something really big happens, the government will top it first, and the insurance will not be filled by the finance.

options.t: 我支持政府补贴、商业公司承保，性价比和覆盖面都顾到。
options.t_en: I support government subsidies, commercial company underwriting, value for money and coverage.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: Seismic zones should force the risk of catastrophe to diverge. Tension: compulsory sharing or voluntary.

scene: 给每人开碳账户记排放，有人赞激励、有人嫌监控。张力在：行为激励还是隐私。

options.t: 我认为建碳账户、攒积分换优惠挺好，正向引导比罚有效。
options.t_en: I think it is good to set up a carbon account and save points for discounts, and positive guidance is more effective than penalties.

options.t: 我倾向自愿开通，想省想绿的自己来，不强加给所有人。
options.t_en: I tend to open it voluntarily, and I want to think of myself as green and not impose it on everyone.

options.t: 我反对把个人生活盯得这么细，碳排多少是我的事，别拿数据绑人。
options.t_en: I object to focusing on my personal life so closely. How much carbon is my business, don't use data to kidnap people.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Open a carbon account for everyone to record emissions. Some people like incentives and others suspect monitoring. The tension is in: behavioral motivation or privacy.

scene: 外卖平台抽走骑手近三成，舆论要求限。张力在：劳方保护还是市场定价。

options.t: 我认为抽成得封顶，骑手跑一单就那几块，平台不能吸太多，兜底人家生计。
options.t_en: I think it was drawn to the top, and the rider ran just a few pieces. The platform should not absorb too much, and people's livelihood should be taken care of.

options.t: 我倾向费率让市场定，平台投入系统也该赚，强压反而降单价。
options.t_en: I tend to let the market set the rate, and the platform input system should also earn, and the pressure will reduce the unit price.

options.t: 我主张把抽成明细亮出来，骑手看得懂自己被拿走多少，比限价更治本。
options.t_en: I advocate drawing out the details, so that riders can understand how much they have been taken, which is more than the limit price.

options.t: 我支持骑手同时接多家、自由切换，用竞争压低被一家拿捏的程度。
options.t_en: I support riders taking multiple houses at the same time, switching freely, and using competition to reduce the degree of being pinched by a family.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The takeaway platform drains nearly 30% of the riders, and public opinion is limited. The tension is in: labor protection or market pricing.

scene: 骑手出了事故算不算工伤起争议。张力在：雇员保护还是灵活。

options.t: 我认为天天听平台派单的就是员工，该有社保工伤，出了事不能踢皮球。
options.t_en: I think that it is the employee who listens to the platform every day. There should be social security injuries, and you can't kick a ball in an accident.

options.t: 我倾向保持个体户，接单自由、时间自定，代价是风险自担，各取所需。
options.t_en: I tend to stay self-employed, accept orders freely and at my own discretion, at my own risk, and take what I need.

options.t: 我支持设个中间身份，不完全雇员也不纯个体，单独上保障，贴合实际。
options.t_en: I support the establishment of an intermediate identity, not fully employed and impure individuals, individually guaranteed, and in line with reality.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Whether a rider's accident counts as a work injury is disputed. Tension in: Employee protection or flexibility.

options.t_en: I would like to reserve the vacant lot for temporary parking for my own convenience.

options.t: 我要求建健身区并加装摄像头防设施被破坏。
options.t_en: I asked to build a fitness area and install cameras to prevent damage.

options.t: 我认为应全体投票决定，少数服从多数。
options.t_en: I think it should be decided by a vote of the whole, with the minority obeying the majority.

options.t: 我觉得这是物业的职责，自己懒得参与。
options.t_en: I feel that this is the responsibility of the property and I am too lazy to participate.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: There is a piece of public land that has been vacant for a long time downstairs in the community, and the neighborhood committee solicited opinions from residents to determine the use. This land is small, the expectations of different families for it vary greatly, and it also affects the debate about who should be served by public spaces.

scene: 楼上邻居几乎每晚都传来电视和走动声，你已经连续几周睡不好。你知道对方是普通上班族，并非故意扰民，但噪音确实影响生活。

options.t: 我直接上门礼貌沟通，请他在夜里调小音量。
options.t_en: I went straight to the door to communicate politely and asked him to turn down the volume at night.

options.t: 我找物业投诉，要求按规约介入处理。
options.t_en: I looked for a property complaint and asked to intervene in accordance with the regulations.

options.t: 我自己戴耳机忍着，不想为这点事伤和气。
options.t_en: I put on my own headphones and didn't want to be hurt by this.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Almost every night upstairs neighbors come in with TV and walking sounds, and you've been having trouble sleeping for weeks at a time. You know that the other person is an ordinary worker and does not intend to disturb the public, but the noise does affect life.

scene: 小区里有几只流浪猫常在垃圾桶翻找食物，有人觉得可爱，有人嫌脏乱。关于要不要喂养、怎么管理，住户之间出现了分歧。

options.t: 我每天投喂并联系机构做绝育，心疼这些生命。
options.t_en: I feed and contact the agency every day for sterilization, and I am heartbroken for these lives.

options.t: 我向物业反映猫叫扰民，要求清理这些猫。
options.t_en: I told the property that the cats were bothering people and asked to clean up the cats.

options.t: 我加入邻里志愿小组，轮流照看它们。
options.t_en: I join neighborhood volunteer groups and take turns looking after them.

options.t: 我觉得喂不喂是个人自由，旁人不该干涉。
options.t_en: I think that not feeding is personal freedom, and others should not interfere.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: There are a few stray cats in the neighborhood who often rummage through the trash for food. Some people think they are cute, and some people are unwanted and dirty. Disagreements arose between households about whether to feed and how to manage them.

scene: 对门独居的老太太最近很少出门，你不确定她是否身体不舒服。你和她只是点头之交，不确定该不该主动过问。

options.t: 我常敲门问候并顺手帮她买菜，邻里就该互助。
options.t_en: I often knock on the door to greet and help her buy food, and the neighbors should help each other.

options.t: 我尊重她的隐私，不打扰，真有事她会讲。
options.t_en: I respect her privacy and don't bother. She talks about things.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The old lady who lives alone at the opposite door rarely goes out recently, and you are not sure if she is unwell. You and her just nodded and weren't sure if you should take the initiative to ask.

scene: 公司形成一种惯例：下班后主管常在群里布置任务，不回消息会被认为不积极。你发现不少同事其实并不愿意，但没人敢先停下来。

options.t: 我带头准点下线，并在周会上提出限制非工作时间联络。
options.t_en: I took the lead in taking punctuality offline and proposed at the weekly meeting to limit non-working hours contact.

options.t: 我照常回复，毕竟拿工资就该配合安排。
options.t_en: I replied as usual, after all, I should cooperate with the arrangement to get a salary.

options.t: 我私下联合同事约定集体准点走，用行动改变文化。
options.t_en: I privately agreed with my co-workers to collectively go on time and change the culture with actions.

options.t: 我向人事反映，要求把离线权写进制度。
options.t_en: I responded to the personnel request to write the offline right into the system.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The company has a habit of assigning tasks to supervisors in groups after work, and not responding to messages will be considered inactive. You find that many colleagues are actually unwilling, but no one dares to stop first.

scene: 你发现同组一位同事经常把活儿转给别人，自己准点走。组长似乎没察觉，团队其他人也都在默默帮忙补位。

options.t: 我向主管如实反映，这种事不该由我私下了结。
options.t_en: I honestly told my supervisor that this kind of thing should not be closed by me privately.

options.t: 我自己多担一点，维持团队表面和谐。
options.t_en: I shoulder a little more on my own to maintain the superficial harmony of the team.

options.t: 我直接跟那位同事说清楚分工边界。
options.t_en: I spoke directly to the colleague to clarify the boundaries of the division of labor.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: You find that a colleague in the same group often transfers work to others and leaves on time. The team leader seems to be unaware, and the rest of the team is silently helping to fill the positions.

scene: 公司准备推行薪酬保密制度，违者处分。你觉得同事之间是否该知道彼此工资，直接关系到公平感。

options.t: 我支持公开薪酬，阳光之下更容易发现歧视。
options.t_en: I support open pay, and it's easier to spot discrimination in the sun.

options.t: 我反对公开，收入是个人隐私不该被比来比去。
options.t_en: I am against publicity, income is personal privacy and should not be compared.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The company intends to implement a salary confidentiality system and punish those who violate it. Whether you feel that colleagues should know each other's wages is directly related to the sense of fairness.

scene: 公司通知全员下月起必须回办公室坐班，取消远程办公。你住得远，且发现远程时效率更高，但管理层强调协作需要面对面。

options.t: 我接受安排，公司有权决定工作方式。
options.t_en: I accept the arrangement and the company has the right to decide how to work.

options.t: 我申请弹性工时，愿意用成果而非坐班证明自己。
options.t_en: When I apply for flexible working hours, I am willing to prove myself by results rather than by work.

options.t: 我联合同事请愿，要求保留远程选项。
options.t_en: My co-worker petitioned to keep the remote option.

options.t: 我考虑跳槽去允许远程的团队。
options.t_en: I am considering job-hopping to allow remote teams.

options.t: 我装监控打卡软件配合管理，效率由数据说话。
options.t_en: I install monitoring and punching software to cooperate with management, and the efficiency is spoken by the data.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: The company informed all employees that they must return to the office from next month and cancel telecommuting. You live far away and are more efficient when found remotely, but management emphasizes the need for collaboration to be face-to-face.

scene: 你在朋友圈转了一条有争议的生活观点，几位亲友留言激烈反对，也有人点赞。你不确定要不要保留这条动态。

options.t: 我保留并补充理由，观点就该摊开讨论。
options.t_en: I reserve and add the reason why the point of view should be discussed.

options.t: 我删掉，不想让关系变尴尬。
options.t_en: I deleted it and didn't want to embarrass the relationship.

options.t: 我设置仅自己可见，既保留又不影响别人。
options.t_en: My settings are only visible to me, they are reserved and do not affect others.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: You have circled a controversial view of life in your circle of friends, and several relatives and friends have fiercely objected to it, and others have liked it. You're not sure you want to keep this dynamic.

scene: 部门会议上多数人对方案表示赞同，但你发现一个明显漏洞。主管似乎希望尽快通过，气氛趋向一致。

options.t: 我当场提出疑问，哪怕显得唱反调。
options.t_en: I asked questions on the spot, even if it seemed counterproductive.

options.t: 我会后单独跟主管说明，不在会上扫兴。
options.t_en: I will explain to my supervisor separately afterwards, and I will not be discouraged at the

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Most people in the department meeting agree with the plan, but you find an obvious loophole. The supervisor seems to want to pass as soon as possible, and the atmosphere tends to be consistent.

scene: 本地论坛计划推行实名发言，称可减少恶意攻击。你常匿名参与讨论，也见过匿名带来的戾气。

options.t: 我支持实名，谁发言谁负责更文明。
options.t_en: I support real names, who speaks and who is responsible for being more civilized.

options.t: 我反对实名，匿名才能让人说真话。
options.t_en: I oppose real names, and anonymity allows people to tell the truth.

options.t: 我支持分级，普通讨论匿名、重要议题实名。
options.t_en: I support grading, general discussion anonymity, real names of important topics.

options.t: 我觉得平台该管内容而非管身份。
options.t_en: I think the platform should manage content rather than identity.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Local forums plan to roll out real-name presentations that claim to reduce malicious attacks. You often participate in discussions anonymously, and you have seen the fury of anonymity.

scene: 社区公告板有人贴出针对某类住户的抱怨纸条，措辞尖锐但没指名。物业征求居民意见是否保留这块自由张贴区。

options.t: 我主张完全开放，自由表达包括刺耳的声音。
options.t_en: I advocate full openness and free expression, including harsh sounds.

options.t: 我要求物业事先审核，禁止侮辱性内容。
options.t_en: I ask the property to review beforehand and prohibit abusive content.

options.t: 我建议改设线上匿名板，减少当面冲突。
options.t_en: I recommend switching to an online anonymity board to reduce in-person conflicts.

options.t: 我认为这类抱怨应私下沟通而非贴公榜。
options.t_en: I think such complaints should be communicated privately rather than on a public list.

options.t: 我提议贴反驳纸条，让不同声音都呈现。
options.t_en: I propose to paste a rebuttal note so that different voices can be heard.

options.t: 我建议干脆撤掉公告板，省得生事。
options.t_en: I suggest removing the bulletin board altogether to save your life.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Community Bulletin Boards Someone posted a note of complaint against a certain category of residents, with sharp but unspecified language. The property asks residents for their opinion on whether to keep this free posting area.

scene: 你所在行业传出要立法设定更高的最低报酬标准。小商户担心成本，基层员工盼望保障，舆论两边都有道理。

options.t: 我支持政府定底线，避免有人被过度压价。
options.t_en: I support the government to set the bottom line and avoid being overpriced.

options.t: 我反对统一标准，报酬应由供需自己谈。
options.t_en: I am opposed to uniform standards, and remuneration should be discussed by the supply and demand themselves.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: There is talk in your industry of legislating a higher minimum wage. Small businesses worry about costs, grassroots employees want protection, and public opinion is justified on both sides.

scene: 小区物业以人工涨价为由拟上调物业费两成。部分老人觉得负担重，物业说不涨就降服务。

options.t: 我投赞成，环境好大家都受益。
options.t_en: I voted yes, the environment is good, everyone benefits.

options.t: 我反对，钱应先公开账本再谈。
options.t_en: I object that the money should be discussed in the open ledger first.

options.t: 我建议按面积分档收费，大房子多掏。
options.t_en: I recommend charging by area, and paying more for a big house.

options.t: 我要求把支出明细上链公开接受监督。
options.t_en: I request that the spending breakdown be publicly monitored.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The property in the community is proposed to increase the property fee by 20% due to manual price increase. Some elderly people feel that the burden is heavy, and the property says that the service will not go up or down.

scene: 你参与的一个合作社年底有盈余可分。创始成员主张按初始出资分，干活多的成员希望按劳动分。

options.t: 我主张平均分配，大家是一起扛过来的。
options.t_en: I advocate equal distribution, and everyone carries it together.

options.t: 我认为该按实际贡献分，多劳才公平。
options.t_en: I think it should be based on the actual contribution points, more work is fair.

options.t: 我建议留一半作公共基金，一半按贡献分。
options.t_en: I suggest leaving half as a public fund and half as a contribution.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: One of the cooperatives you participate in has a year-end surplus. The founding members advocate that according to the initial contribution, the members who work more want to be divided according to labor.

scene: 地方讨论税制调整：一种方案对日常消费多征税，另一种对收入多征税。两种都会影响你的钱包，方向却相反。

options.t: 我偏好对高收入多征，消费税最伤普通人。
options.t_en: I prefer to levy more on high incomes, and consumption tax hurts ordinary people the most.

options.t: 我偏好消费税，收入归自己更能激励努力。
options.t_en: I prefer consumption tax, and I am more motivated by my own income.

options.t: 我主张两头都轻，政府少花钱最重要。
options.t_en: I advocate that both ends are light, and the government spends less money is the most important.

options.t: 我支持设基本免征额，保底后再谈怎么征。
options.t_en: I support the establishment of a basic exemption, and we will talk about how to collect it after the guarantee.

options.t: 我认为税制该公开辩论而非内部定。
options.t_en: I think the tax system is a public debate, not an internal one.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: Local discussion of tax system adjustments: one plan to tax more on daily consumption, the other to tax more on income. Both can affect your wallet, but in the opposite direction.

scene: 你家楼下开了第二家全国连锁便利店，挤压了经营多年的本地小杂货店。你每天买东西更方便了，也心疼老店主。

options.t: 我尽量去本地小店买，保住街坊生意。
options.t_en: I try to go to local small shops to buy and keep the neighborhood business.

options.t: 我哪便宜去哪，消费者不必替店铺操心。
options.t_en: Wherever I go cheaply, consumers don't have to worry about the store.

options.t: 我建议社区给老店减免租金扶持。
options.t_en: I recommend the community to give the old shops rent-free support.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: Your home opens a second national convenience store chain downstairs, squeezing out small local grocery stores that have been in business for years. It's more convenient for you to buy things every day, and you're also worried about the old shopkeeper.

scene: 本地一种传统手工业面临低价机器产品的冲击，有人提议政府给手艺人发补贴和订单。

options.t: 我支持补贴，传统技艺值得被保护。
options.t_en: I support subsidies and traditional skills deserve to be protected.

options.t: 我反对补贴，让市场自然选择更有效率。
options.t_en: I oppose subsidies to make market natural selection more efficient.

options.t: 我建议只补培训转型，不保落后产能。
options.t_en: I suggest only making up for the transformation of training and not keeping backward production capacity.

options.t: 我主张帮手艺人对接高端定制打开销路。
options.t_en: I advocate helping craftsmen connect with high-end customization to open up sales.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A local traditional handicraft industry is facing the impact of low-priced machine products, and it has been proposed that the government issue subsidies and orders to craftsmen.

scene: 超市同款商品有本地产和外地产两种，价格差不多。你注意到包装上标了产地，朋友说要优先支持本地。

options.t: 我优先买本地产，钱留在本乡更踏实。
options.t_en: I prefer to buy local properties, and the money is more solid in my hometown.

options.t: 我无所谓产地，哪个好用买哪个。
options.t_en: I don't care where it comes from, which one is good to buy.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: There are two types of supermarket products, local and foreign, with similar prices. You notice that the packaging is labeled with the place of origin and a friend says to prioritize local support.

scene: 社区开始强制执行垃圾分类，不分类就罚款，并派人定时在桶边检查。有人觉得麻烦，有人觉得环境确实变好了。

options.t: 我支持罚款，没约束大家不会认真分。
options.t_en: I support the fine, without restricting everyone will not seriously divide.

options.t: 我反对罚款，应靠宣传和便利设施引导。
options.t_en: I object to fines and should be guided by publicity and amenities.

options.t: 我自愿分好并帮邻居分类，少给检查员添堵。
options.t_en: I voluntarily sort and classify the neighbors, so as not to add blockages to the inspectors.

options.t: 我装家用分类处理器自己消化厨余。
options.t_en: I installed a home sorting processor to digest my own food waste.

options.t: 我接受检查，但要求公开罚款去向。
options.t_en: I was examined but asked to disclose the whereabouts of the fine.

options.t: 我觉得分类是作秀，照旧丢省事。
options.t_en: I think the classification is a show, and I have lost my mind as usual.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The community began enforcing garbage sorting, fining people without sorting, and sending people to regularly check at the side of the bucket. Some people feel troubled, some people feel that the environment has really changed for the better.

scene: 城边一条小河旁要建社区公园，规划方提出要么硬化成步道广场，要么保留野草浅滩做湿地。两边居民各有支持者。

options.t: 我支持保留湿地，野生动物也需要家。
options.t_en: I support keeping wetlands and wildlife in need of a home.

options.t: 我支持硬化公园，居民活动空间更重要。
options.t_en: I support hardening the park, and residents' activity space is more important.

options.t: 我主张一半硬化一半留野，折中处理。
options.t_en: I advocate half hardening, half staying in the field, and compromising.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: A community park is to be built by a small river on the edge of the city, and the planners propose to either harden it into a walkway square or keep the weed shoal as a wetland. The inhabitants on both sides had supporters.

scene: 朋友发起低碳挑战，倡议少点外卖、少坐飞机。你觉得理念好，但也觉得自己的那点习惯改变微不足道。

options.t: 我主动减量，哪怕影响有限也是态度。
options.t_en: I take the initiative to reduce the amount, even if the impact is limited.

options.t: 我觉得这是个人自由，旁人少管。
options.t_en: I think this is personal freedom, others care less.

options.t: 我支持用碳积分奖励引导而非道德绑架。
options.t_en: I support the use of Carbon Point Rewards to guide rather than ethical kidnapping.

options.t: 我认为该由大厂和制度担责，不该只压个人。
options.t_en: I think it should be the responsibility of large factories and systems, not just individuals.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Friends launched a low-carbon challenge, advocating less takeout and less flying. You think your philosophy is good, but you also feel that your habit change is insignificant.

scene: 超市将对一次性塑料袋收费并逐步禁供，你有时忘带布袋会觉得不便，也承认白色污染确实严重。

options.t: 我支持禁令，习惯自带袋就好。
options.t_en: I support the ban, it is good to bring your own bag.

options.t: 我反对，应让消费者自己选。
options.t_en: I object that consumers should be allowed to choose for themselves.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Supermarkets will charge for single-use plastic bags and gradually ban them. Sometimes you will feel inconvenience if you forget to bring a cloth bag, and admit that white pollution is indeed serious.

scene: 学校考虑恢复统一校服，称能减少攀比、方便管理。部分学生觉得压抑个性，家长也意见不一。

options.t: 我支持校服，省得孩子比穿戴分心。
options.t_en: I support school uniforms, saving children more distractions than wearing them.

options.t: 我反对校服，穿衣是孩子的自我表达。
options.t_en: I oppose school uniforms, and dressing is a child's self-expression.

options.t: 我建议只重大活动统一，平时自由。
options.t_en: I recommend only major events to be unified and free in normal times.

options.t: 我把决定权交给孩子自己选。
options.t_en: I leave the decision to the child.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The school considers restoring uniforms, saying they can reduce competition and facilitate management. Some students feel that their personalities are suppressed, and parents also have different opinions.

scene: 你孩子班级几乎所有人都报了课外补习，你不报怕掉队，报了又觉得童年被挤占。周围家长都在卷。

options.t: 我跟着报，不能让孩子掉队。
options.t_en: I followed the newspaper and couldn't leave the children behind.

options.t: 我拒绝补习，留时间给孩子玩和休息。
options.t_en: I refuse to tutor, leaving time for my children to play and rest.

options.t: 我联名家委会呼吁减作业量。
options.t_en: I joined the National Committee to call for a reduction in the workload.

options.t: 我支持学校免费补差，别都推给市场。
options.t_en: I support schools to make up the difference for free, and the difference is pushed to the market.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: Almost everyone in your child's class has reported for extracurricular tutoring. If you are not afraid of falling behind, you will feel that your childhood has been squeezed. Around the parents are rolling.

scene: 学校拟新开青春期与身体认知课，部分家长担心讲太早，部分认为越早越安全。

options.t: 我支持学校系统教，专业且平等。
options.t_en: I support the school system to teach professionally and equally.

options.t: 我反对，这类事该由家庭自己教。
options.t_en: I object that such matters should be taught by the family itself.

options.t: 我支持开课但允许家长申请免修。
options.t_en: I support classes but allow parents to apply for an exemption.

options.t: 我建议请家长旁听共同决定内容。
options.t_en: I recommend that parents listen to the co-determination.

options.t: 我认为该按年龄分层，不要一刀切。
options.t_en: I think it should be stratified by age, not one size fits all.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The school plans to start a new adolescence and body cognition class. Some parents are worried about speaking too early, and some think that the sooner the safer.

scene: 老师提议上课禁手机，统一锁进柜子。学生说查资料要用，家长怕联系不上孩子。

options.t: 我支持禁用，课堂就是该专注。
options.t_en: I support disabling, and the classroom is the place to focus.

options.t: 我反对禁用，工具用得好才关键。
options.t_en: I object to the ban, it's only when the tool is used well that it matters.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The teacher proposed to ban mobile phones in class and lock them in the closet. The student said that the information should be used, and the parents were afraid that they would not be able to contact the child.

scene: 小区新搬来几户外地来的租户，口音和习惯不同，电梯里偶有尴尬。有人在群里说要多包容，有人担心生活习惯冲突。

options.t: 我主动打招呼并介绍周边，帮他们落脚。
options.t_en: I took the initiative to say hello and introduce the surrounding area to help them settle down.

options.t: 我保持礼貌距离，各过各的就好。
options.t_en: I keep a polite distance, just pass each one.

options.t: 我组织邻里茶话会促进互相了解。
options.t_en: I organize neighborhood tea talks to promote mutual understanding.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The neighborhood has newly moved in several out-of-town tenants. The accent and habits are different, and there are occasional embarrassments in the elevator. Some people talk about tolerance in the crowd, and some worry about conflicting habits.

scene: 社区服务中心准备在指示牌上加注多种语言，方便新来的租户。有老住户觉得没必要、浪费钱。

options.t: 我支持多语标识，友好环境靠细节。
options.t_en: I support multilingual logo, friendly environment depends on details.

options.t: 我反对，本地标识就够了。
options.t_en: I object, the local logo will suffice.

options.t: 我建议先做常用语种，按需扩展。
options.t_en: I recommend starting with your preferred language and expanding it as needed.

options.t: 我主张用图标代替文字，谁都看得懂。
options.t_en: I advocate replacing words with icons, which everyone can understand.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: Community Service Centers are ready to add multiple languages to their signage to make it easier for new tenants to arrive. There are old residents who feel that it is unnecessary and a waste of money.

scene: 社区要办年度邻里节，有人建议加入新搬来住户家乡的节日元素，也有人希望只保留本地传统节目。

options.t: 我支持包容庆祝，多元才热闹。
options.t_en: I support inclusive celebration, and diversity is lively.

options.t: 我倾向守住本地传统，别搞得太杂。
options.t_en: I tend to keep local traditions and don't mess around too much.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The community is hosting an annual Neighborhood Festival, with some suggesting festive elements for newly relocated residents and others wanting to keep only traditional local programming.

scene: 小区要换装带人脸识别的门禁，称能防陌生人进楼。你方便了不少，也第一次意识到自己进出都被记录。

options.t: 我支持，安全比那点记录重要。
options.t_en: I support that safety is more important than that record.

options.t: 我反对，人脸数据不该被随手采集。
options.t_en: I object that face data should not be randomly collected.

options.t: 我支持但要求数据本地存储不联网。
options.t_en: I support but do not require data to be stored locally.

options.t: 我支持刷卡替代，不必用人脸。
options.t_en: I support swiping instead of using my face.

options.t: 我要求物业承诺不向第三方提供数据。
options.t_en: I request that the Property undertake not to provide data to third parties.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: The community should be equipped with facial recognition access gates, which are said to prevent strangers from entering the building. You are very convenient, and for the first time you realize that your entrance and exit are recorded.

scene: 公司想在办公电脑装行为监控，统计停留页面和按键频率，说是为了防泄密提效率。你觉得被盯着很不舒服。

options.t: 我支持安装，公司资产就该可监管。
options.t_en: I support the installation and the company's assets should be regulated.

options.t: 我反对，这是对人的不信任。
options.t_en: I object, it is distrust of people.

options.t: 我支持只监控公司设备上的工作账号。
options.t_en: I only support monitoring work accounts on company devices.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The company wants to install behavior monitoring on the office computer, calculate the frequency of staying pages and keys, and say that it is to prevent leaks and improve efficiency. You feel uncomfortable being stared at.

scene: 长辈想给上小学的孩子配定位手表，说防走失。你担心孩子从小习惯被追踪，也理解老人是出于担心。

options.t: 我给孩子戴，安全第一位。
options.t_en: I wear it for my children, safety first.

options.t: 我不给，教会他求助比追踪重要。
options.t_en: I don't give, it's more important to teach him to ask for help than to trace.

options.t: 我用只在放学时段开启的定位。
options.t_en: I use positioning that is only turned on during school hours.

options.t: 我和孩子商量，让他自己决定。
options.t_en: I consult with the child and let him decide for himself.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The elders wanted to equip the children in elementary school with positioning watches to prevent them from getting lost. You are worried about your child's habits being tracked from an early age and understand that the elderly are worried.

scene: 街道为降发案率拟在巷口加装更多摄像头，几乎无死角。居民对安全感和平安感评价两极。

options.t: 我支持多装，亮出来就少有人作恶。
options.t_en: I support more outfits, and few people do evil when it comes out.

options.t: 我反对过度覆盖，正常生活不该被拍遍。
options.t_en: I am opposed to excessive coverage, and normal life should not be filmed all over.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The street is planning to install more cameras in the alleyway to reduce the incidence rate, and there are almost no dead corners. Residents rated the sense of safety and security as polar.

scene: 单位组织一项可预防风险的常规接种，人事说鼓励但非强制。几位同事以个人理由拒绝，群里开始议论。

options.t: 我支持单位倡导，集体健康靠参与。
options.t_en: I support the advocacy of the unit, and the collective health depends on participation.

options.t: 我反对强制，身体决定该在自己手里。
options.t_en: I oppose coercion, and the body decides that it should be in its own hands.

options.t: 我自愿去，但不勉强别人。
options.t_en: I volunteer to go, but I don't force others.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The unit organizes a routine vaccination against preventable risks, and personnel say it is encouraged but not mandatory. Several colleagues refused for personal reasons, and the group began to discuss.

scene: 一家社区医院床位紧张，两位患者都急需：一位缴了高价特需，一位排了很久的普通队。院长问你优先给谁。

options.t: 我主张按紧急程度分，谁危急救谁。
options.t_en: I advocate that according to the degree of urgency, who needs to be rescued and who needs to be rescued.

options.t: 我认为按缴费优先，资源也讲成本。
options.t_en: I think that by payment priority, resources also talk about cost.

options.t: 我建议抽签加急需双轨，避免人情。
options.t_en: I recommend drawing lots and urgently needing two tracks to avoid human feelings.

options.t: 我支持扩大公共床位，从源头缓解。
options.t_en: I support the expansion of common beds to provide relief from the source.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: A community hospital has tight beds, and both patients are in urgent need: one has paid a high price for special needs, and one has been in the regular team for a long time. The dean asks who you give priority to.

scene: 医保目录调整讨论是否纳入一些民间常用的传统疗法。支持者说百姓认，反对者说缺证据、怕浪费钱。

options.t: 我支持纳入，老百姓信的就该报销。
options.t_en: I support inclusion, the people's letter should be reimbursed.

options.t: 我反对，医保钱要花在有证据的项目。
options.t_en: I object that Medicare money be spent on items for which there is evidence.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The Medicare Catalogue Adjustment discusses whether to include some of the traditional therapies commonly used by folk. Supporters say the people admit it, while opponents say they lack evidence and are afraid of wasting money.

scene: 你和伴侣都上班，但家里家务和带娃几乎都落在你一人身上。你想重新分活，对方觉得一直这样也没问题。

options.t: 我列出分工表，要求对半承担。
options.t_en: I list the division of labor and ask for half-responsibility.

options.t: 我按擅长分，不强求绝对均等。
options.t_en: I am good at grading and do not insist on absolute parity.

options.t: 我主张请小时工，把时间买回来。
options.t_en: I advocate hiring hourly workers to buy back time.

options.t: 我联合同事推动单位给育儿假。
options.t_en: My co-workers are pushing for parental leave.

options.t: 我接受现状，省得为小事争执。
options.t_en: I accept the status quo and avoid arguing about small things.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: You and your partner go to work, but household chores and childcare fall almost entirely on you. You want to redistribute your work, and the other party feels that it is okay to do so all the time.

scene: 某单位招聘为改善结构，对某一性别设了名额保障。落选的另一性别应聘者认为自己更胜任，网上吵翻。

options.t: 我支持设名额，结构失衡需要纠偏。
options.t_en: I support the establishment of quotas, and structural imbalances need to be corrected.

options.t: 我反对名额，能力该是唯一标准。
options.t_en: I am against the quota, ability should be the only criterion.

options.t: 我支持透明评审，不预设名额。
options.t_en: I support transparent reviews with no preset quota.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: In order to improve the structure of recruitment, a certain unit has set up a quota guarantee for a certain gender. The unsuccessful candidate of the other gender thinks they are more competent and quarrels online.

scene: 公共场馆计划在男女厕之外增设不分性别的第三卫生间，方便陪伴异性别长辈或孩子的人。部分人觉得多余。

options.t: 我支持增设，照顾到被忽略的需求。
options.t_en: I support additions to accommodate neglected needs.

options.t: 我反对，现有分隔就够了。
options.t_en: I object, the existing separation is enough.

options.t: 我支持但只设在人流少的楼层。
options.t_en: I support but only on less crowded floors.

options.t: 我主张全部改家庭卫生间更通用。
options.t_en: I advocate that all family bathrooms be more versatile.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: Public venues plan to add a third gender-neutral bathroom outside the men's and women's toilets, making it easier for people to accompany elders or children of the opposite sex. Some people feel redundant.

scene: 公司试点用算法给员工每月打分排绩效，称客观公平。你发现算法看不懂你那些难量化的贡献。

options.t: 我支持用算法，减少人主观偏心。
options.t_en: I support the use of algorithms to reduce subjective eccentricity.

options.t: 我反对，评价人不能全交给模型。
options.t_en: I object that the reviewer cannot be completely handed over to the model.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: The company pilot uses algorithms to rate and rank the performance of employees on a monthly basis, calling it objective and fair. You find that the algorithm can't read your hard-to-quantify contributions.

scene: 一辆自动驾驶小巴在小区接驳路上为避让小孩急刹，导致车内乘客轻伤。责任算谁，厂商、乘客还是系统，众人争不休。

options.t: 我主张责任归厂商，它该为系统兜底。
options.t_en: I advocate that responsibility rests with the manufacturer, which should be the backbone of the system.

options.t: 我认为乘客自担风险，坐了就该认。
options.t_en: I think riders are at their own risk and should acknowledge it once they're seated.

options.t: 我支持设强制保险池，出事统一赔。
options.t_en: I support the establishment of a compulsory insurance pool for unified compensation in the event of an accident.

options.t: 我主张算法决策要可解释并公开。
options.t_en: I advocate that algorithmic decisions be interpretable and public.

options.t: 我倾向保留人类司机最终负责。
options.t_en: I prefer to keep the human driver ultimately in charge.

options.t: 我觉得该让乘客上车前自选风险等级。
options.t_en: I think it's time to let riders choose their risk level before they get in the car.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: An autonomous minibus was on the community shuttle road to avoid the sudden braking of the children, causing minor injuries to the passengers in the car. Who is responsible, the manufacturer, the passenger or the system, everyone is in constant contention.

scene: 你常看由模型生成的图文和视频，平台多数不标明。有人提议强制标注AI生成，有人认为多此一举。

options.t: 我支持强制标注，读者有权知道来源。
options.t_en: I support mandatory tagging and readers have the right to know the source.

options.t: 我反对标注，内容为王何必管怎么来。
options.t_en: I objected to the annotation. Why did Wang have to do with the content?

options.t: 我支持标注但由平台自定方式。
options.t_en: I support annotation, but it's up to the platform.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: You often see images and videos generated by the model, most of which are not specified on the platform. Some have proposed mandatory labeling for AI generation, others have argued that this is an extra step.

scene: 你做个小工具，朋友劝你开源免费，也有人劝你闭源收费，两种做法各有一批拥趸。

options.t: 我选开源，让更多人改进步。
options.t_en: I choose open source to get more people to improve my steps.

options.t: 我选闭源收费，劳动该有回报。
options.t_en: I choose to charge the closed source, and the labor should be rewarded.

options.t: 我开源核心、高级功能收费。
options.t_en: I charge for open source core, premium features.

options.t: 我交给社区共管，不自己定。
options.t_en: I leave it to the community to manage, not to decide for myself.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: You make gadgets, your friends advise you to open source for free, and others advise you to charge for closed source, both of which have a group of followers.

scene: 小区两户因漏水闹矛盾，金额不大却僵持。调解员问你更倾向走法庭还是社区协商。

options.t: 我倾向社区调解，伤了邻居不好。
options.t_en: I tend to mediate in the community and hurt my neighbors badly.

options.t: 我坚持走法庭，规矩得靠判决立。
options.t_en: I insist on going to court, and the rules depend on the judgment.

options.t: 我建议先调解不成再诉讼。
options.t_en: I recommend mediation before litigation.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: The two households in the community were conflicted over the water leakage, and the amount was not large, but there was a stalemate. The mediator asks whether you prefer to go to court or community consultation.

scene: 讨论对屡次小偷小摸者是否该拘留威慑，还是以罚款教育为主。你既嫌治安乱，也怕处罚过重。

options.t: 我支持严一点，小恶不纠会变大。
options.t_en: I support stricter, small evil will become bigger.

options.t: 我反对重罚，轻微该以教育为主。
options.t_en: I am opposed to heavy penalties, and education should be the main focus of the minor.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: Discuss whether repeated petty theft should be detained as a deterrent, or whether fine education should be the main focus. You are both suspected of disorderly public order and afraid of excessive punishment.

scene: 一起邻里纠纷中，过错方愿道歉赔偿并参与公益。有人主张重罚示警，有人主张给改过机会。

options.t: 我主张恢复性处理，赔了道了就翻篇。
options.t_en: I advocate restorative treatment. If I lose my way, I will turn the page.

options.t: 我认为该依法惩处，不能私了了事。
options.t_en: I think it should be punished according to law, and it can't be a private matter.

options.t: 我支持罚与服务并行，既责也教。
options.t_en: I support punishment in parallel with service, both blaming and teaching.

options.t: 我主张让受害方决定接受与否。
options.t_en: I advocate for the aggrieved party to decide whether to accept it or not.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: In a neighborhood dispute, the wrongdoing party is willing to apologize for compensation and participate in public welfare. Some people advocate heavy penalties and warnings, and some people advocate giving them a chance to change.

scene: 市政广场节日布置用了某类信仰的图案，有居民认为公共空间应保持中性，管理者说这是文化传统。

options.t: 我支持移除，公共空间该世俗中性。
options.t_en: I support removing the mundane neutrality of public spaces.

options.t: 我支持保留，这是本地文化一部分。
options.t_en: I support retention as part of the local culture.

options.t: 我建议改成多种符号并存更平衡。
options.t_en: I suggest a more balanced coexistence of multiple symbols.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: The festival layout of the municipal square uses a certain kind of religious pattern, and some residents believe that the public space should remain neutral, which managers say is a cultural tradition.

scene: 一个信仰团体申请办一所带价值教育的学校，课程含其信仰内容。支持者说多元，反对者怕渗透。

options.t: 我允许办，家长有选择权。
options.t_en: I allow it, parents have the choice.

options.t: 我限制，公立价值不能混信仰。
options.t_en: I limit that public values cannot be mixed with beliefs.

options.t: 我允许但要求信仰课可免修。
options.t_en: I allow but require faith classes to be exempt.

options.t: 我主张这类学校自筹经费不占公帑。
options.t_en: I advocate that self-financing of such schools does not account for public funds.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: A faith group applies for a school with a value education, and the curriculum contains its faith content. Supporters say diversity, opponents fear infiltration.

scene: 单位排班把一位同事的信仰休息日排了班，他申请调休。主管怕开了口子大家都提特殊要求。

options.t: 我支持为他调休，尊重信仰该落实。
options.t_en: I support his suspension and respect for the implementation of the faith.

options.t: 我反对，排班讲统一不讲特殊。
options.t_en: I object. Uniformity in scheduling does not mean special.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The work schedule arranged a colleague's faith rest day, and he applied for a rest break. The supervisor was afraid to open his mouth, and everyone asked for special requirements.

scene: 你所在城市酝酿房租指导价，房东说会撤房降供给，租客说终于能喘气。你正租房，也理解房东的账。

options.t: 我支持管制，房租不能任人喊。
options.t_en: I support regulation, rent can not be shouted.

options.t: 我反对管制，房东有权定自己的价。
options.t_en: I am against regulation and hosts have the right to set their own prices.

options.t: 我支持只管涨幅不管绝对价。
options.t_en: I support an increase regardless of the absolute price.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Your city is brewing rent guidance prices. The landlord said that he would evacuate the house to reduce supply, and the tenant said that he can finally breathe. You are renting and understand the landlord's account.

scene: 老楼加装电梯投票，高层住户极力推动，一二楼担心采光噪音和房价受损坚决反对。你住中间层，两边都要顾及。

options.t: 我投赞成，老人上下楼太难。
options.t_en: I voted yes, it was too difficult for the old man to go up and down the stairs.

options.t: 我投反对，低层权益不能牺牲。
options.t_en: I vote no, low-level rights and interests cannot be sacrificed.

options.t: 我提议高层补偿低层再装。
options.t_en: I propose to compensate the upper floor for the lower floor refit.

options.t: 我主张政府出钱补低层损失。
options.t_en: I advocate that the government pay for the low-level losses.

options.t: 我建议先装外挂梯试运行。
options.t_en: I recommend first installing a hanging ladder for trial operation.

options.t: 我弃权，让直接利益相关方定。
options.t_en: I abstain and let the direct stakeholder decide.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: The old building was voted on by installing elevators, and high-rise residents pushed hard. The first and second floors were firmly opposed to the lighting noise and damage to house prices. You live in the middle floor, take care of both sides.

scene: 街道要改造一条商业街，方案由上面的设计院出，居民只能在公示期提意见。你希望参与更早。

options.t: 我要求从设计阶段就开居民会。
options.t_en: I asked for a residents' meeting from the design stage.

options.t: 我信任专业设计，公示够了。
options.t_en: I trust professional design, enough publicity.

options.t: 我建议做线上征集让更多人发声。
options.t_en: I recommend doing an online call for more voices.

options.t: 我主张按多数住户票决方案。
options.t_en: I advocate a majority vote solution.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The street needs to be transformed into a commercial street. The plan is out of the design institute above, and residents can only give their opinions during the publicity period. You want to get involved earlier.

scene: 超市货架出现标注是否含新育种技术的食品，价格相近。有人坚持要看清，有人认为没必要区分。

options.t: 我支持强制标注，选择权在先。
options.t_en: I support mandatory labeling, with the option first.

options.t: 我反对强制标，增加成本转嫁消费者。
options.t_en: I am opposed to mandatory standards, increasing costs and passing them on to consumers.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: Supermarket shelves are marked with whether or not the food contains the new breeding technology, and the prices are similar. Some people insist on seeing clearly, some people think that there is no need to distinguish.

scene: 菜场本地有机菜比外地普通菜贵一倍，你既想支持本地农户、少点运输，也心疼钱包。

options.t: 我多买本地有机，为环境和乡邻值。
options.t_en: I buy more local organic for the environment and rural values.

options.t: 我买便宜的外地菜，过日子要算账。
options.t_en: I buy cheap foreign food, and I have to pay for my life.

options.t: 我折中，贵菜偶尔买。
options.t_en: I compromise, and I buy delicacies occasionally.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: Local organic dishes are twice as expensive as ordinary dishes in the field. You want to support local farmers, transport less, and love your wallet.

scene: 一家养殖场上规模后效率更高、肉更便宜，但邻里嫌气味重，动物福利组织也来关注。

options.t: 我支持大场，便宜肉惠及普通人。
options.t_en: I support big venues, and cheap meat benefits ordinary people.

options.t: 我支持小场散养，环境动物都更好。
options.t_en: I support small farm free-range breeding, and environmental animals are better.

options.t: 我主张限规模并补周边住户。
options.t_en: I advocate limiting the size and replenishing the surrounding households.

options.t: 我愿为福利肉多付钱。
options.t_en: I am willing to pay more for welfare meat.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: Animal welfare organizations also pay attention to the fact that a farm is more efficient and cheaper when it is scaled, but the neighborhood is not smelly.

scene: 本地资讯平台被指充斥标题党和谣言，运营方说要加人工审核。用户担心审核会变成删帖。

options.t: 我支持严格审核，谣言太害人。
options.t_en: I support strict scrutiny, and rumors are too harmful.

options.t: 我反对严审，宁可乱点也别被替你删。
options.t_en: I oppose strict scrutiny, I would rather not be deleted for you.

options.t: 我支持算法降权而非删除。
options.t_en: I support algorithm reduction rather than deletion.

options.t: 我主张用户可自助屏蔽并标注存疑。
options.t_en: I advocate that users can self-block and flag suspicions.

options.t: 我建议设独立事实核查公示。
options.t_en: I recommend setting up an independent fact-checking publicity.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: The local information platform was accused of being full of headline parties and rumors, and the operator said that it should be manually reviewed. The user is concerned that the moderation will result in a post deletion.

scene: 你平时只看一两个常看的消息源，朋友提醒你信息太单一。你承认但觉得省心。

options.t: 我主动加几个不同立场的源对照。
options.t_en: I proactively added a few source controls for different positions.

options.t: 我懒得换，顺手就好。
options.t_en: I'm too lazy to change, just do it.

options.t: 我支持平台强制混入异见内容。
options.t_en: I support platforms that force dissent.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: You usually only look at one or two common sources, and a friend reminds you that the information is too single. You acknowledge but feel secure.

scene: 网上出现以假乱真的合成视频，有人拿它当真转发。平台讨论是否强制打上合成标记。

options.t: 我支持强制标注，真假必须分得清。
options.t_en: I support mandatory labeling, and true and false must be clearly divided.

options.t: 我反对强制，标不标由发布者定。
options.t_en: I oppose compulsion, and the label is not determined by the publisher.

options.t: 我支持由第三方检测后标注。
options.t_en: I support labeling after inspection by a third party.

options.t: 我主张对恶意造假追责而不是只标注。
options.t_en: I advocate accountability for malicious counterfeiting and not just labeling.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: There is a fake and scrambled real composite video on the Internet, and some people take it seriously and forward it. The platform discusses whether to impose a composite marker.

scene: 你常走的夜路最近加了定点巡查和移动探照，安全感上来了，也有人觉得像被盯梢。

options.t: 我支持加巡查，夜里踏实。
options.t_en: I support the patrol and stay steady at night.

options.t: 我反对高密度巡查，正常走动也紧张。
options.t_en: I am opposed to high-density patrols, and I am nervous about walking normally.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The night road you often walked has recently added fixed-point inspections and mobile searching, which has given you a sense of security, and some people feel like they are being followed.

scene: 有人提议把多次轻微扰乱秩序的行为入刑，以儆效尤；也有人说罚点钱教育就行，别轻易留案底。

options.t: 我支持入刑，小乱不治会蔓延。
options.t_en: I support incarceration, and small chaos will spread.

options.t: 我反对入刑，轻微该以罚代刑。
options.t_en: I oppose imprisonment, and a slight punishment should be substituted for punishment.

options.t: 我支持累犯才入刑，初犯免。
options.t_en: I support recidivism before being sentenced, and first-time offenders are exempted.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Some people propose to jail for repeated acts of slightly disrupting order, in order to follow suit; others say that punishing people with a little money is enough to educate them, and do not easily save the case.

scene: 一名初犯青年被判社区服务代替短期监禁，邻里议论：有人怕放出来不安全，有人觉得给机会更人道。

options.t: 我支持社区矫治，利于回归社会。
options.t_en: I support community-based remediation for social reintegration.

options.t: 我倾向监禁，犯错就该隔离。
options.t_en: I tend to be incarcerated and should be isolated if I make a mistake.

options.t: 我支持严管下的社区服役。
options.t_en: I support community service under strict control.

options.t: 我主张让受害社区参与监督。
options.t_en: I advocate for the involvement of victimized communities in surveillance.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: A young first-time offender was sentenced to community service instead of short-term imprisonment, and the neighbors argued that some were afraid that it would be unsafe to release him, and some felt that it would be more humane to give him a chance.

scene: 本地要拿出一笔钱支援外地受灾社区，同时本市还有路段年久失修。有人主张先顾自家。

options.t: 我支持向外支援，互助不分远近。
options.t_en: I support outward support, and mutual help is not far away.

options.t: 我反对，自家路都没修先管别人。
options.t_en: I object, my own road has not been repaired to care about others first.

options.t: 我主张内外都做，但先保基本。
options.t_en: I advocate doing it internally and externally, but first keep it basic.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: The local community must provide a certain amount of money to support the affected communities in the field, and there are still sections of roads in the city that are in disrepair. Some people advocate taking care of themselves first.

scene: 你所在的地区要加入一项跨地区协作协议，承诺互通标准和互助。支持者看好长远，谨慎者怕被绑住。

options.t: 我支持加入，协作才有大市场。
options.t_en: I support joining, and collaboration is the big market.

options.t: 我反对，关键事得自己说了算。
options.t_en: I object, the key matter is up to you.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: Your region is joining a cross-regional collaboration agreement that commits to standards and mutual assistance. Supporters are optimistic about the long run, and cautious people are afraid of being tied up.

scene: 社区学院想多招外地来的交换学员，床位和语言支持都要加。部分居民欢迎，部分担心资源被分走。

options.t: 我支持多招，交流开阔眼界。
options.t_en: I support multiple moves and broaden my horizons.

options.t: 我反对扩招，先满足本地需求。
options.t_en: I oppose the enrollment expansion to meet local needs first.

options.t: 我支持但要求单独筹资不占公费。
options.t_en: I support but ask that separate fundraising do not account for public fees.

options.t: 我主张限额开放保持平衡。
options.t_en: I advocate for open quotas to be balanced.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: Community colleges want to recruit more exchange students from overseas, with additional beds and language support. Some residents welcomed, and some feared that resources would be diverted.

scene: 有专家提议给每位居民发一笔无条件基本生活金，钱来自统一税收。支持者说托底，反对者说养懒人。

options.t: 我支持发放，底线安全让人敢试错。
options.t_en: I support distribution, and bottom-line safety makes people dare to try and make mistakes.

options.t: 我反对，白给会削弱干活动力。
options.t_en: I object. White giving will weaken stem activity.

options.t: 我支持只给真正困难者而非人人有。
options.t_en: I support giving only to those who are truly in need, not everyone.

options.t: 我主张先小范围试点再扩。
options.t_en: I advocate a small-scale pilot before expanding.

options.t: 我认为该由社区评议发放对象。
options.t_en: I think it's up to the community to decide who to send it to.

options.t: 我担心税收转嫁最终还是普通人扛。
options.t_en: I am worried that the tax transfer will eventually be borne by ordinary people.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: Some experts propose to give each resident an unconditional basic living money, which comes from a unified tax. Supporters say Teddy, opponents say lazy.

scene: 养老金讨论是由全市统收统支，还是留在各区自管。统则均衡，分则灵活，两类居民各有算盘。

options.t: 我支持全市统筹，富区帮穷区。
options.t_en: I support the city's overall planning, rich areas and poor areas.

options.t: 我支持各区自管，自己的钱自己定。
options.t_en: I support the autonomy of each district, and I decide my own money.

options.t: 我主张设最低统一、之上可自选。
options.t_en: I advocate for a minimum unity, above which you can choose.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: Pension discussions are governed by the city's revenue collection and expenditure, or remain under the control of each district. The system is balanced, the rules are flexible, and each of the two types of residents has an abacus.

scene: 失业救济该发多久引发争论：长一点给人缓冲，短一点促人找工作，也省公共开支。

options.t: 我支持延长，让人找到合适的而非将就。
options.t_en: I support lengthening so that people find the right one, not the right one.

options.t: 我支持缩短，久领易生依赖。
options.t_en: I support shortening, and I can rely on it for a long time.

options.t: 我主张按缴费年限长短浮动。
options.t_en: I advocate fluctuating according to the length of the payment period.

options.t: 我支持配职业培训而非纯发钱。
options.t_en: I support vocational training rather than pure money.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: How long unemployment relief should be caused by the debate: longer to give people a cushion, shorter to promote people to find work, but also to save public spending.

scene: 你和伴侣筹备婚礼，长辈要办热闹的传统仪式，你们更想要简单旅行结婚。两代人对仪式的意义理解不同。

options.t: 我按长辈意思办，老人开心重要。
options.t_en: I act according to the wishes of my elders, and it is important for the elderly to be happy.

options.t: 我坚持简办，自己的事自己定。
options.t_en: I insist on brevity and decide my own affairs.

options.t: 我折中，小办仪式加旅行。
options.t_en: I compromise, small ceremony plus travel.

options.t: 我把预算省下做共同储蓄。
options.t_en: I save my budget for co-saving.

options.t: 我让双方家庭各出代表协商。
options.t_en: I asked both families to negotiate on behalf of each other.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: You and your partner are planning a wedding, the elders have to perform lively traditional ceremonies, and you want a simple trip to get married. The two generations understood the meaning of the ritual differently.

scene: 你们有了孩子，谁来主要带成了矛盾。一方想请长辈帮，另一方想自己带并调整工作。

options.t: 我主张请长辈搭手，家庭共养。
options.t_en: I advocate asking elders to help, and family to support each other.

options.t: 我主张自己带，亲子不能被替代。
options.t_en: I advocate that I bring my own, and that parents and children cannot be replaced.

options.t: 我支持一方降工时，收入换陪伴。
options.t_en: When I support one side to reduce work, the income is exchanged for companionship.

options.t: 我主张送托幼机构更专业。
options.t_en: I advocate sending kindergartens more professionally.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: You have children, who will bring the main contradiction. One side wants to ask the elders to help, and the other side wants to bring and adjust the work themselves.

scene: 父母年迈，你姐弟几人商量赡养：是同住照料，还是送就近的照料机构，费用怎么摊也成问题。

options.t: 我接父母同住，尽近身孝道。
options.t_en: I picked up my parents to live with them, as close as possible to filial piety.

options.t: 我倾向机构，专业照顾更稳妥。
options.t_en: I prefer institutions and professional care is more secure.

options.t: 我主张姐妹轮住分摊。
options.t_en: I advocate sister-sharing.

options.t: 我按出钱多少定照料分工。
options.t_en: I set the division of care according to how much I pay.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: Your parents are old, and your siblings are discussing support: whether to live in the same care or send to the nearest care institution, how to share the cost is also a problem.

scene: 你和伴侣买房，一方提议签婚前财产协议厘清归属，另一方觉得伤感情、像不信任。

options.t: 我签，先把账算清省后患。
options.t_en: I'll sign it and clear the account first.

options.t: 我不签，算计钱伤了信任。
options.t_en: I don't sign, calculating money hurts trust.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: When you and your partner buy a house, one party proposes to sign a prenuptial property agreement to clarify the ownership, and the other party feels sad and distrustful.

scene: 一所学校想用小动物做基础观察实验，称有助于理解生命。动保人士要求改用录像和模型。

options.t: 我支持限用并严审，必要才做。
options.t_en: I support restriction and scrutiny, only if necessary.

options.t: 我支持严格禁用于教学。
options.t_en: I support a strict ban on teaching.

options.t: 我认为教学价值大于个体牺牲。
options.t_en: I believe that teaching value outweighs individual sacrifice.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: A school wants to do basic observation experiments with small animals, saying it helps to understand life. The activist asked to switch to video and modeling.

scene: 你家的猫到了该绝育的年纪，兽医建议做，说有利健康也控数量。你有点舍不得它受那一下。

options.t: 我带它做，长远对它和种群都好。
options.t_en: I take it with me and it's good for it and for the population in the long run.

options.t: 我不做，身体完整该由它自己。
options.t_en: I don't do it, the integrity of the body should be its own.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: When your cat reaches the age of sterilization, the veterinarian recommends doing it, saying that it is beneficial to health and also controls the number. You're a little reluctant to put up with it for a while.

scene: 城里一座老动物园经营困难，动物空间局促。有人建议关停放归或迁大场，有人觉得孩子需要能看动物。

options.t: 我支持迁建大场，动物福利优先。
options.t_en: I support the relocation of Daejeon, and animal welfare is a priority.

options.t: 我支持保留，城市记忆不能丢。
options.t_en: I support preservation, and the memory of the city cannot be lost.

options.t: 我主张改造展区而非关停。
options.t_en: I advocate the renovation of the exhibit area rather than closure.

options.t: 我认为该由公众票决去留。
options.t_en: I think it should be decided by public vote to stay.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: An old zoo in the city is difficult to operate, and the animal space is cramped. Some people suggest shutting down or moving the venue, and some people feel that children need to be able to see animals.

scene: 市里要裁减给小剧场的公共补贴，称该让市场养艺术。从业者说没了补贴就活不下去。

options.t: 我支持政府继续资助，文化不能纯算账。
options.t_en: I support the government to continue funding, culture can not be pure accounting.

options.t: 我反对补贴，艺术该自己找观众。
options.t_en: I oppose subsidies, and art should find an audience on its own.

options.t: 我支持只补公益类演出。
options.t_en: I support only charity performances.

options.t: 我主张设文化基金由众人捐。
options.t_en: I advocate the establishment of a cultural fund to be donated by everyone.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene_en: The city wants to cut public subsidies for small theaters, saying the market should be allowed to nurture the arts. Practitioners say they can't live without subsidies.

scene: 本地一门老手艺申请专项保护资金，年轻人不太看，长辈怕失传。钱有限，争的人多。

options.t: 我支持拨钱保护，断了难续。
options.t_en: I support the transfer of funds for protection, which is difficult to continue.

options.t: 我反对专款，顺其自然别硬保。
options.t_en: I am opposed to special funds, please do not insure them.

options.t: 我支持进校园让年轻人接触。
options.t_en: I support access to young people on campus.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene_en: A local old craftsman applied for special protection funds. Young people don't see it very well, and elders are afraid of losing it. Money is limited, and there are many people fighting.

scene: 广场上常有人唱歌画画摆摊，管理方想划区限时，艺人说这样没了自由氛围。

options.t: 我支持放开，街头文化才鲜活。
options.t_en: I support letting go, and street culture is alive.

options.t: 我支持划区，免得扰民乱糟糟。
options.t_en: I support zoning so as not to disturb the people.

options.t: 我主张只在非居住区放开。
options.t_en: I advocate only in non-residential areas.

options.t: 我让居民投票定开放范围。
options.t_en: I asked the residents to vote for an open area.

options.t: 我建议发许可取代禁止。
options.t_en: I recommend issuing permits instead of prohibitions.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: People often sang and painted stalls on the square. The management wanted to divide the area for a limited time, and the artists said that there was no free atmosphere.

scene: 学校运动会变味成班班争第一，弱的孩子被排挤。老师想淡化排名，家长怕没了拼劲。

options.t: 我支持重参与，每个孩子都该上场。
options.t_en: I support heavy involvement, and every child deserves to be on the court.

options.t: 我支持保排名，竞争出成绩。
options.t_en: I support the ranking and compete for results.

options.t: 我主张分组别，强弱分开比。
options.t_en: I advocate grouping, and the ratio of strength to weakness.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene_en: School sports will turn into class competition first, and weak children will be excluded. The teacher wanted to dilute the ranking, and the parents were afraid of losing their efforts.

scene: 业余联赛查出有人用了违禁补剂，处罚轻重有争议：有人要重罚立威，有人觉得业余别太较真。

options.t: 我支持零容忍，规则面前无大小。
options.t_en: I support zero tolerance and no size in front of the rules.

options.t: 我主张教育为主，业余别上纲。
options.t_en: I advocate education as the mainstay and amateur class.

options.t: 我支持禁赛但留改过通道。
options.t_en: I support the ban but leave the aisle open.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene_en: The amateur league found that some people used banned supplements, and the severity of the penalty was controversial: some people had to punish Li Wei heavily, and some people thought that amateurs were too real.

scene: 社区球场被一家机构包下做收费培训，居民免费踢球时间被挤占。居民不满，机构说养场地要钱。

options.t: 我反对商业化，公共球场该公用。
options.t_en: I am opposed to commercialization and the public course should be shared.

options.t: 我支持收费，有人维护才长久。
options.t_en: I support charging, and it takes a long time for someone to maintain it.

options.t: 我主张分时段，居民优先。
options.t_en: I advocate time-sharing, with residents first.

options.t: 我建议居民众筹养场地免收费。
options.t_en: I recommend residents to crowdfund their farms free of charge.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene_en: The community stadium was contracted by an agency for fee-based training, and residents' free kick time was squeezed. The residents were dissatisfied, and the agency said that the farm needed money.

scene: 讨论退休年龄是否该延后，年轻人怕岗位被占，长辈说还能干、不愿早退领薄钱。

options.t: 我支持延退，身体好就该多贡献。
options.t_en: I support retreat, and if you are in good health, you should contribute more.

options.t: 我反对延退，早退给年轻人腾位。
options.t_en: I oppose postponement and early retirement for young people to vacate their seats.

options.t: 我主张弹性，愿退愿留自选。
options.t_en: I advocate flexibility, and I am willing to leave my choice.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene_en: Discuss whether the retirement age should be postponed. Young people are afraid of occupying their jobs, and their elders say they are still capable and unwilling to withdraw from thin money early.

scene: 给独居老人装智能监测，跌倒自动报警。子女说安心，老人说像被盯，隐私不舒服。

options.t: 我装，安全比那点顾虑重要。
options.t_en: I pretend that safety is more important than that concern.

options.t: 我不装，尊重老人不愿被看。
options.t_en: I don't pretend to respect the elderly and don't want to be seen.

options.t: 我装但数据只家人可见。
options.t_en: I pretend but the data is only visible to the family.

options.t: 我先问老人意愿再定。
options.t_en: I'll ask the old man's wishes before I make a decision.

options.t: 我用按铃替代持续监测。
options.t_en: I use the bell instead of continuous monitoring.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene_en: Intelligent monitoring for elderly people living alone, automatic alarm for falls. The children said they were reassured, the elderly said they felt stared at, and their privacy was uncomfortable.

scene: 规划中的新社区想把老人公寓和幼托放一起，称代际互助。有人叫好，有人怕两代人互相打扰。

options.t: 我支持代际混居，彼此都受益。
options.t_en: I support intergenerational mixed living, which benefits both of us.

options.t: 我反对，两代人最好分开清静。
options.t_en: I object, it is better for two generations to be separate and quiet.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene_en: The planned new community wants to put the elderly apartment and kindergarten together, which is called intergenerational mutual aid. Some people shouted, some people were afraid that the two generations would bother each other.

scene: 各类先花后还的广告铺天盖地，针对年轻人。有人主张限制这类营销，有人说成年人自己负责。

options.t: 我支持限制，别诱导人过度借。
options.t_en: I support restrictions and do not induce people to borrow excessively.

options.t: 我反对限制，成年人该自己掂量。
options.t_en: I am against restrictions, adults should decide for themselves.

options.t: 我支持标注真实成本提醒。
options.t_en: I support flagging real cost reminders.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene_en: All kinds of advertisements that are spent first and then returned are overwhelming, targeting young people. Some advocate limiting this type of marketing, others say adults are responsible for themselves.

scene: 一位邻居因意外欠债还不上，面临被追到家里。讨论个人破产保护该严还是宽。

options.t: 我支持强保护，给人翻身机会。
options.t_en: I support strong protection and give people the opportunity to turn around.

options.t: 我支持弱保护，借了就该还。
options.t_en: I support weak protection, it should be repaid when borrowed.

options.t: 我主张分恶意与否区别对待。
options.t_en: I advocate a distinction between malice and non-malice.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
