options.t_en: I would back the 1,200-apartment plan on the least sensitive third. It delivers real housing without touching the core habitat, and I would require an independent ecological review before construction and ring-fence part of the revenue for wetland restoration.

options.t: 我会支持完整项目，但前提是开发商出资在上游建一块同等规模的人工湿地，并为此缴纳保证金。如果补偿确实有效，城市两头都能得到；如果无效，保证金就用来支付修复费用。
options.t_en: I would support the full project only if the developer funds an equal-size constructed wetland upstream and posts a bond for it. If the offset genuinely works, the city gets both; if it does not, the bond pays for restoration.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 由于扒窃和自行车盗窃案增多，公共交通运营方提议在所属 200 座车站全面安装带人工智能的摄像头。系统会实时标记可疑行为模式，录像保留 30 天。一个公民自由组织要求要么不部署，要么把保存期缩短为 72 小时自动删除；运营方回应说 72 小时太短，因为受害者往往很晚才报案。公开征求意见正在进行中，你提交的意见会被记录在案。
scene_en: After a rise in pickpocketing and bicycle theft, the transit operator proposes installing AI-enabled cameras across its 200 stations. The system would flag suspicious behavior patterns in real time and keep footage for 30 days. A civil liberties group demands either no deployment or a 72-hour auto-delete window; the operator responds that 72 hours is too short because victims often report crimes late. A public consultation is open, and your input will be recorded.

options.t: 我会支持按原方案部署。三十天的录像破获过不少证人毫无印象的案件，对正常出行的人来说，公共交通空间里的摄像头并不可怕。
options.t_en: I would support the rollout as proposed. Thirty days of footage has solved cases where witnesses remembered nothing, and people going about their day have little to fear from cameras in public transit spaces.

options.t: 我会反对这次部署。行为预测系统会把普通人的小动作标记成可疑，而且对某些群体的盘查远多于其他群体；我宁愿把钱花在增加站台工作人员上，也不想为了财产犯罪就让大规模录像成为常态。
options.t_en: I would object to the deployment. Behavior-prediction systems flag ordinary quirks as suspicious and stop some groups far more than others; I would rather fund more staff on the platforms than normalize mass recording for property crime.

options.t: 我只接受配上 72 小时自动删除、且延长保存必须严格凭司法令状的摄像头方案。如果证明 72 小时确实不够，运营方应该拿证据回来申请，而不是默认就拿到 30 天。
options.t_en: I would accept the cameras only with the 72-hour auto-delete and a strict warrant rule for any extension. If that window proves too short, the operator can come back with evidence rather than getting 30 days by default.

options.t: 我会建议先在盗窃案最多的 20 座车站试点一年，每季度公开审计每一次系统标记和比对结果，让城市根据实测准确率和投诉数据做决定，而不是听任何一方的说法。
options.t_en: I would suggest a one-year pilot at the twenty stations with the most thefts, with quarterly public audits of every flag and match, so the city decides on measured accuracy and complaint numbers instead of either side's assertions.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你所在国家的议会正在重新设计育儿假。目前九成的带薪休假由母亲休掉，雇主们把这当作招聘年轻女性时犹豫的理由。方案一：每孩 12 个月带薪假在父母之间不可转让，谁不休就作废；方案二：维持现有灵活共享的假期池，另加一笔统一数额的生育补助金；方案三：假期总额更高，但完全由每个家庭自行分配。雇主担心成本，工会担心僵化，财政部门则想要一个能进预算的确切数字。
scene_en: Your country's parliament is redesigning parental leave. Today, mothers take 90% of paid leave, which employers cite as a reason to hesitate before hiring young women. One proposal makes 12 months of paid leave per child strictly non-transferable between parents; another keeps the current flexible pool and adds a flat birth grant instead; a third offers generous leave but lets each family split it however it wants. Employers warn about costs, unions warn about rigidity, and the finance ministry wants a number it can budget.

options.t: 我会支持不可转让的 12 个月方案。假期不休就作废，父亲就会去休；等招聘主管看到男性和女性离职休假的可能性一样大，他们犹豫要不要招年轻女性的借口就站不住脚了。
options.t_en: I would support the non-transferable twelve months. If leave lapses when unused, fathers take it, and once hiring managers see both sexes as equally likely to leave, the excuse for hesitating over young women loses its footing.

options.t: 我会支持保留灵活共享的假期池。每个家庭情况不同，护士和倒班工人组成的家庭，与两个自由职业者的安排完全不一样；我宁愿相信父母自己分配时间，也不想让一部法律替他们做决定。
options.t_en: I would support keeping the flexible pool. Families differ — a nurse married to a shift worker plans differently from two freelancers — and I would rather trust parents to divide the time than have a statute decide for them.

options.t: 我会支持统一数额的生育补助金。现金对任何家庭形态都管用，又不规定谁必须留在家里，还避免给雇主提供一个预测应聘者将来休不休假的新由头。
options.t_en: I would back the flat birth grant. Cash supports every family shape without dictating who stays home, and it avoids handing employers any fresh reason to guess at a candidate's future leave.

options.t: 我会让育儿假成本由雇主和国家分摊，不让任何一家企业独自承担全额账单。否则假期池只是纸面上还在，招聘主管早就悄悄把这份风险算进了女性的职业发展里。
options.t_en: I would split the cost of leave between employers and the state so no single firm bears the full bill. Otherwise the flexible pool survives on paper while hiring managers quietly price the risk into women's careers.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 你所在城市的交通管理中心目前仍由人工调控信号灯。一家供应商推出了号称能把平均通勤时间缩短 18% 的人工智能系统，它靠预测拥堵来调灯，但系统是个黑箱，供应商拒绝公开源代码。另有一个开源替代方案，预测精度稍逊，但任何人都能逐行审查其代码。议会必须在预算内二选一，两套系统都配有紧急情况的人工接管开关。
scene_en: Your city's traffic management center still relies on human operators adjusting signals. A vendor offers an AI system that claims to cut average commute time by 18% by predicting congestion, but it operates as a black box and the vendor refuses to open the code. An open-source alternative is less accurate in its predictions but can be audited line by line by anyone. The council must pick one within budget, and both come with an emergency manual override.

options.t: 我会选供应商系统，要那 18%。堵车每天都在消耗城市的钱并制造排放，人工接管开关加上写进合同的追责条款，能覆盖主要的故障情形。交通路网的存在意义就是通行效率。
options.t_en: I would take the vendor system and its 18%. Gridlock costs the city money and emissions every day, and the manual override plus a contract-backed liability clause covers the main failure modes. Performance is what a traffic network exists for.

options.t: 我会选开源系统。当公共路网由一份不许任何人查看的代码来操控时，市民就无从追问为什么自己家门口的街道被降低了通行优先级；收益小一点，换来一套城市真正能掌控、能核验的系统，这个代价我接受。
options.t_en: I would choose the open-source system. When a public road network is run by code no one may inspect, citizens cannot check why their street was deprioritized; a smaller gain is an acceptable price for a system the city can actually own and verify.

options.t: 我只会在城市拥有全部数据、保留人工接管权、并在合同里拿到对模型决策的审计权的情况下签约。只要结果能被独立核验，供应商的代码可以继续保密。
options.t_en: I would sign only if the city owns all the data, keeps the override, and gets contractual audit rights over the model's decisions. The vendor's code can stay closed as long as outcomes can be verified independently.

options.t: 我会继续用人工调控。交通管理是公共服务，自动化程度越深，出了问题越难说清责任；而且那个 18% 是卖方给的数字，不是从这座城市自己的街道上测出来的。
options.t_en: I would keep the human operators. Traffic control is a public function where responsibility gets hard to attribute once automation deepens, and the 18% figure comes from the seller, not from this city's own streets.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 一名 19 岁、无前科的年轻人夜间撬门进入一家店铺，偷走了现金和电子产品；店主当时不在场，损失约合两个月的收入。检察官给出两个选择：一年监禁，或参加恢复性司法项目——加害者需与店主见面、劳动偿还损失，并在监督下执行为期一年的改造计划。店主表示他想要回损失，但拿不准要不要和撬他家店门的人面对面坐着。量刑指南对两种路径都留有余地。
scene_en: A 19-year-old with no prior record broke into a shop at night and stole cash and electronics; the owner, who was not present, lost about two months of income. Prosecutors offer a choice between a one-year prison sentence and a restorative justice program where the offender meets the owner, works to repay the loss, and follows a supervised plan for a year. The owner says he wants his money back but is unsure about sitting across from the person who broke in. Sentencing guidelines leave room for either path.

options.t: 我会倾向于恢复性司法项目。19 岁时的第一次犯罪可能决定一个人一生的走向；赔偿加监督既能回应损害，又能让他保住正常工作记录的可能——而一年的牢狱很可能断送这条路。
options.t_en: I would favor the restorative program. A first offense at nineteen can set the direction of a life; repayment and supervision address the harm while keeping a normal work record within reach, which a prison year likely forecloses.

options.t: 我会判处一年监禁。闯入别人赖以谋生的店门，就必须承受实打实的后果；监督项目随时可能半途而废，一个明确且被执行的刑罚，才能保护那条街上的其他店主。
options.t_en: I would impose the one-year sentence. Breaking into someone's livelihood has to carry real consequences, and a supervised program can be abandoned midway; a clear, enforced penalty protects every other shopkeeper on that street.

options.t: 我会选择附严格条件的缓刑：一年内全额赔偿、宵禁，一旦再犯立即收监。店主能拿回损失，街道的安全也有人盯着，监狱作为后手悬在那里，形成约束。
options.t_en: I would choose a suspended sentence with strict conditions: full repayment within a year, a curfew, and immediate custody upon any reoffense. The owner gets made whole, the street stays protected, and prison remains one step away as leverage.

options.t: 我会在向店主讲清两条路径后，让他自己选。损失是他承担的，结果也是他日后要面对的；无论他选哪条，国家都能提供对应的执行机制。
options.t_en: I would let the owner choose between the two paths after both are explained to him. He bore the loss and he lives with the outcome; the state can supply the enforcement machinery either way.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 一所公立学校的校董会正在重新审视校规，起因是一位教师开始佩戴头巾上课，部分家长投诉，也有家长表示支持。现行规则要求教职员工在课堂上保持宗教中立，学生则可以自由佩戴宗教饰物。修正案一：维持现行教职员工规则；修正案二：废除该规则，此事交给每位教师凭良心决定；修正案三：只要求校董会本身保持中立，教职员工和学生的个人宗教表达一概不限制。校董会将在听证会后表决。
scene_en: A public school board is reviewing its rules after a teacher began wearing a headscarf to class, prompting complaints from some parents and support from others. Current rules require classrooms to be religiously neutral for staff, while students may wear religious symbols freely. One proposed amendment would keep the staff rule; another would drop it and leave the matter to each teacher's conscience; a third would require the board itself to stay neutral while allowing any staff or student expression. The board will decide after a hearing.

options.t: 我会维持现行教职员工规则。当教师作为公共机构的代表站在 25 个孩子面前时，教室应当让每个家庭、无论信什么，都觉得向自己敞开；教职工在下班后的私人时间里完全可以自由表达信仰。
options.t_en: I would keep the staff rule. When a teacher stands before twenty-five children as the face of a shared public institution, the classroom should read as open to every family regardless of faith, and staff can express their beliefs freely outside duty hours.

options.t: 我会废除该规则，相信每位教师自己的判断。成年人戴一条头巾并不会让孩子改信什么，把有信仰的教师挡在公立学校门外，筛选的是他们是什么人，而不是他们教什么。
options.t_en: I would drop the rule and trust each teacher's conscience. A scarf on an adult does not convert a child, and barring believing teachers from public jobs screens people out for what they are rather than for what they teach.

options.t: 我会采纳第三项修正案。校董会本身不该推崇任何宗教，也不该偏袒任何一方，但工作中的个人仍是个人；学校的中立体现在课程和制度里，而不是体现在管人穿什么衣服上。
options.t_en: I would adopt the third amendment. The board itself should promote no religion and favor none, but individuals at work remain individuals; the school's neutrality lives in its curriculum and procedures, not in policing clothing.

options.t: 我会把决定权交给各校的家长和教职工联席会。彼此熟识的社区学校有能力就地解决这个问题，而一条全省统一的规则，无论怎么定，都会在某个地方让这场争执持续下去。
options.t_en: I would hand the decision to each school's parents and staff council. A village school where everyone knows one another can settle this locally, and a single province-wide rule will keep this fight alive somewhere whichever way it goes.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 一家开发商提议在一个地铁站旁的停车场上建 14 层公寓楼，该地块位于一片以 4 层历史联排住宅闻名的街区。五年来区内租金上涨了四成，而这块地距地铁站步行仅七分钟；反对者列举的理由包括相邻花园将被遮挡、历史街貌会被改变、施工车辆的影响。区划委员会可以选择照原案批准、批准缩减为 8 层的版本，或否决并保留停车场用途。支持和反对两份请愿书都已收集到数百个签名。
scene_en: A developer proposes a 14-story apartment block on a parking lot beside a metro station in a neighborhood of 4-story heritage townhouses. Rents in the district have risen 40% in five years, and the lot is a seven-minute walk from the station; opponents cite shadowing on adjacent gardens, the heritage streetscape, and construction traffic. The zoning board can approve as proposed, grant a reduced 8-story version, or reject it and keep the lot for parking. Hundreds have signed both petitions.

options.t: 我会批准 14 层的方案。距地铁站步行七分钟的一片停车场，是全区最说得上理由的增建住宅地点；一条把自己子女的房价都抬到住不起的历史街貌，就不再成其为一个街区了。
options.t_en: I would approve the 14 stories. A parking lot seven minutes from a metro station is the most defensible place in the district to add homes, and a heritage streetscape that prices out its own children stops functioning as a neighborhood.

options.t: 我会否决这个方案。四层楼高的街巷花了一个世纪才长成今天的样子，一栋 14 层的楼投下的阴影，是那些花园的主人从未料想过的；新住宅完全可以建到两个街区外那条空置办公楼带上。
options.t_en: I would reject it. Four-story lanes took a century to become what they are, and a slab of fourteen floors casts shadows those gardens never planned for; new housing can go on the corridor of empty offices two districts over.

options.t: 我会促成缩减为 8 层、高层部分逐级后退的折中版本。住宅数量接近翻倍，而阴影线不会落到相邻花园上，我还会在批文中附加一定比例的可负担住房。
options.t_en: I would negotiate the 8-story version with stepped-back upper floors. It nearly doubles the homes while the shadow line stays off the gardens, and I would attach a share of affordable units to the permit.

options.t: 我会把决定留给市场和地块的所有者。项目若无利可图或没人需要，自然无人去建；若确实有人需要，区划委员会的口味就不该横在一个租房者和一套公寓之间。
options.t_en: I would leave the decision to the market and the owner of the lot. If the project is unprofitable or unwanted, no one builds it; if it is wanted, the zoning board's taste should not stand between a renter and an apartment.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 农业部正在评估是否批准一个耐旱转基因小麦品种。田间试验显示，干旱年份该品种增产两成，灌溉用水减少三成；反对者则提出两点担忧：基因可能漂移到邻近的有机农场，以及种子授权模式会把农民绑定在单一供应商身上。周边国家已批准类似品种；有机认证机构警告，一旦发生异花授粉，邻近农场将失去有机认证。本月底前农业部接受书面意见。
scene_en: The agriculture ministry is weighing approval of a drought-tolerant genetically modified wheat variety. Field trials show 20% higher yields in dry years and a 30% cut in irrigation water; opponents raise concerns about gene flow to neighboring organic farms and about seed licensing that binds farmers to one supplier. Neighboring countries have approved similar varieties; organic certifiers warn that any cross-pollination would cost adjacent farms their certification. The ministry accepts written comments until the end of the month.

options.t: 我会在强制标识的前提下批准该品种。在越来越热的这十年里，抗旱增产和节水都是实打实的收益；有其他偏好的消费者可以看标签选择，有机农场则可以用隔离带规则来保护。
options.t_en: I would approve the variety with mandatory labeling. Drought yields and water savings are measurable gains for a warming decade, and shoppers who prefer otherwise can read a label; organic farms can be protected with buffer-zone rules.

options.t: 我会否决这项批准。基因一旦漂移进邻近的田地就收不回来，而绑定单一授权方的种子供应会把主粮的权力集中到一家手里；比起让农民失去独立性，增产那点收益抵不上。
options.t_en: I would reject the approval. Once gene flow reaches neighboring fields it cannot be recalled, and a seed supply locked to one licensor concentrates power over staple food; the yield gain does not outweigh losing farmers' independence.

options.t: 我只会在强制设隔离带、并由种子公司出资设立责任基金的前提下批准：任何因此失去有机认证的农场都应获得全额补偿。只有当副作用的代价落在受益者而不是邻居头上时，创新才配继续推进。
options.t_en: I would approve it only with mandatory buffer strips and a liability fund paid into by the seed company, so any organic farm that loses certification is compensated in full. Innovation can proceed when the cost of its side effects lands on its beneficiary, not on neighbors.

options.t: 我会让每位农民自己决定：种子层面做好标识，不强制设隔离带。农民比部委更清楚自己的买家和邻居，而相邻农场之间本来就靠各类合同处理通行权等种种地界事务。
options.t_en: I would let each farmer decide, with labeling at the seed level and no buffer mandate. Farmers know their buyers and their neighbors better than a ministry does, and contracts between adjoining farms already handle easements of every other kind.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 一家地区报纸正在决定是否刊发从市长办公室流出的内部邮件，邮件显示一份旧改合同给了一家由市长亲属持有的公司。邮件真实性无争议，但获取途径是一名被解职的前雇员离职后把文件拷到私人硬盘带出。报纸律师提醒，刊发可能让消息源面临刑事追诉，报社也可能被民事起诉。市长办公室否认有不当行为，称这批邮件属于人事私事。主编须在周五前决定：全文刊发、刊发一份不引用原文但描述文件内容的摘要，或暂时压下。
scene_en: A regional newspaper is deciding whether to publish leaked internal emails from the mayor's office showing that a redevelopment contract went to a firm owned by a relative. The emails are authentic, and no one disputes their content, but they were obtained by a former staffer who copied them onto a personal drive after being dismissed. The paper's lawyer warns that publishing could expose the source to prosecution and the paper to a civil suit. The mayor's office denies wrongdoing and calls the leak a private personnel matter. The editor has until Friday to publish, to publish a summary describing the documents without quoting them, or to hold the story.

options.t: 我会全文刊发，并把文件原件放到网上。一份在家族内部授予的合同，正是地方报纸存在的理由；市长办公室也不能在采购记录变得尴尬之后，就把它重新归类为人事私事。
options.t_en: I would publish in full, with the documents online. A contract awarded inside a family is exactly what a local paper exists to expose, and the mayor's office does not get to reclassify procurement records as personnel matters once they become awkward.

options.t: 我会刊发描述文件内容的摘要，但不复制原文。读者仍能知道合同给了亲属、给了哪一天；那名前雇员不会被变成刑事移送中被点名的消息源，报社也还能在法庭上为这篇报道辩护。
options.t_en: I would publish the summary describing the documents without reproducing them. Readers learn that the contract went to a relative and on what date; the former staffer is not turned into the identified source of a criminal referral, and the paper can defend the story in court.

options.t: 我会先压下报道，同时请法院裁定这批邮件是否属于公共记录。刊发离职时带走的材料是可以辩护的，但一份裁定能替整个地区的媒体解决这个问题，而不只是这家报纸。
options.t_en: I would hold the story while the paper asks a court to rule on whether the emails count as a public record. Printing material taken on the way out of a job can be defended, but a ruling would settle the question for every outlet in the region, not just this one.

options.t: 我会刊发，但先请消息源签一份说明，写清是他自行取走文件，并由报社承担他的律师费。既然这篇报道值得印出来，让它能印出来的人就不该独自承担全部风险。
options.t_en: I would run it, but only after the source signs a statement that he took the files on his own initiative and the paper pays his legal costs. If the story is worth printing, the person who made it printable should not carry the whole risk alone.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 某分局一年内商店盗窃报案翻了一倍，主要集中在几条杂货街区。分局长有三个选项：把两名警员调去这些街区下午步行巡逻，代价是高速路巡段本就全市最慢的响应速度会进一步变差；出资设一名民事联络员，帮店主报案并装上他们自己能查看的摄像头；或者设立分流项目，把涉案金额低于某门槛的初犯送去修复与赔偿工作坊而不进入法院。市财政今年只够选一项。
scene_en: In one precinct, shoplifting reports have doubled in a year, mostly from a handful of grocery blocks. The commander can assign two officers to walk those blocks on foot during afternoon hours, which would pull them off highway patrol where response times are already the worst in the city, or fund a civilian liaison who helps shop owners file reports and install cameras they can monitor themselves. A third option is a diversion program that sends first-time offenders under a value threshold to a repair-and-restitution workshop instead of court. The city budget covers only one of the three this year.

options.t: 我会把两名警员排去步行巡逻。那几条街的店主每周都在丢货，而下午能看见的警员，是唯一能在人走进店门前改变其盘算的东西。
options.t_en: I would put the two officers on foot patrol. Store owners on those blocks are losing stock weekly, and a visible officer in the afternoon is the one thing that changes a would-be thief's calculation before he walks in.

options.t: 我会出资设民事联络员并装摄像头。这些报案大多没变成案子，是因为没人帮店主把表格填对；而店主自己看录像时，知道该报哪张脸。
options.t_en: I would fund the civilian liaison and the cameras. Most of these reports never become cases because nobody helps a shop owner fill out the form correctly, and when owners review their own footage they know which faces to report.

options.t: 我会设立分流项目。门槛以下的初犯通常还是能被拉回来的人，而一份法院记录会让下一份工作或下一份租约更难拿到，反过来把同一个人推回同几条街。
options.t_en: I would fund the diversion program. A first offense under the threshold is usually somebody who can still be pulled back, and a court record makes the next job or lease harder to get, which pushes the same person toward the same blocks again.

options.t: 我会把钱分给联络员和分流工作坊，高速路巡段的人手不动。高速上的响应速度影响的是没得选的人，而那几条街不用把警员调走也能帮上忙。
options.t_en: I would split the money across the liaison and the diversion workshop, and leave highway patrol staffing alone. Response times on the highway affect people who cannot choose to shop elsewhere, and the blocks can be helped without moving officers off that route.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 一个中等规模的国家正在决定是否加入一项区域协定：五年内取消成员国工业品关税。该国机床行业雇佣六万人，已警告无法与两个较大成员的劳动力成本竞争；港口与物流行业则预计规模翻倍。协定还包含一个裁决对成员有约束力的争端小组，并允许只签关税章节、暂缓加入争端小组。被排除在降税清单之外的农民目前尚未表态。
scene_en: A mid-sized country is deciding whether to join a regional agreement that would remove tariffs on industrial goods from member states within five years. Its machine-tool sector employs 60,000 people and has warned that it cannot match the labor costs of two larger members; its port and logistics sector expects to double in size. The agreement also contains a dispute panel whose rulings would bind members, and an option to sign the tariff chapter while deferring the panel. Farmers, who are excluded from the tariff cuts, have stayed quiet so far.

options.t: 我会完整加入，包括争端小组。港口和物流是下一代人将赖以谋生的增长点，而有约束力的争端小组正是防止两个较大成员在对自己方便时重开条款的东西。
options.t_en: I would join in full, panel included. Ports and logistics are the growth the next generation will work in, and a binding panel is what stops the two larger members from reopening the terms whenever it suits them.

options.t: 我会签关税章节但不进争端小组。港口那边的出口收益是实在的；而一个裁决无法上诉的机构就等于在境外决定我们的产业政策，若条款证明公平，成员资格以后也能再谈。
options.t_en: I would sign the tariff chapter but stay out of the panel. The export gains are real for the ports, while a body whose rulings we cannot appeal would decide our industrial policy from outside, and membership can be added later if the terms prove fair.

options.t: 我暂时不会加入。六万个机床岗位集中在四个镇上，那些地方没有别的产业能提供同等规模的就业，而五年降税时间比重新培训一批工人所需的时间还短。
options.t_en: I would not join yet. Sixty thousand machine-tool jobs are concentrated in four towns where nothing else employs at that scale, and a five-year tariff clock gives those towns less time than it takes to retrain one cohort of workers.

options.t: 我会加入，但条件是协定本身出资设立过渡基金，为机床工人提供十年再培训与工资保险。当承担代价的人在文本里被点名写清时，开放才可能是值得的。
options.t_en: I would join, but only with a negotiated transition fund paid by the agreement itself, covering retraining and wage insurance for machine-tool workers for a decade. Openness can be worth it when the people who absorb the cost are named in the text.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 某省正在重新设计失业保险。目前替代率为原工资的 45%、最长领取十二个月，且与正式劳动合同绑定，把外卖骑手、季节性农工和家政清洁工排除在外。备选方案有三个：替代率提高到 60%、领取期缩短为八个月；以每月固定缴费加等额财政配比的方式把非正规劳动者纳入；或保留现行方案，另设一项只面向零缴费者的经济状况审查最低收入底线。精算显示，现行规则下基金九年后将出现赤字。
scene_en: A province is redesigning unemployment insurance. Today benefits replace 45% of prior wages for up to twelve months and are tied to formal employment contracts, which excludes delivery riders, seasonal farmhands and domestic cleaners. Reform options on the table: raise the replacement rate to 60% and cut duration to eight months; extend coverage to informal workers by having them contribute a flat monthly amount with a matching state payment; or keep the current scheme and add a separate means-tested minimum-income floor for people with no contributions at all. Actuaries project the fund runs a deficit in nine years under current rules.

options.t: 我会把替代率提高到 60%，领取期缩到八个月。失业后的头几个月正是房租和学费到期的时候，一笔摊薄到全年的小钱，帮不了人撑过真正压垮他的那一个月。
options.t_en: I would raise the replacement rate to 60% and shorten the window to eight months. The first months after a job loss are when rent and school fees come due, and a thin payment spread over a year helps nobody through the month that actually breaks them.

options.t: 我会用固定缴费加等额财政配比把非正规劳动者纳进来。骑手崴了脚，房租和文员一样要付；一个只认合同的体系，恰好漏掉了劳动力市场中增长最快的那一部分。
options.t_en: I would extend coverage to informal workers with a flat contribution and a matching state payment. A rider who breaks an ankle has the same rent as a clerk, and a system that only recognizes contracts leaves out the fastest-growing part of the labor market.

options.t: 我会维持现有缴费方案，另为零缴费者加一道经济状况审查底线。把基金摊到覆盖所有人、替代率 60%，十年内要么被迫加征工资税，要么削减给付，而这两样最重的都是它本来要保护的那些劳动者。
options.t_en: I would keep the contribution scheme as it is and add a means-tested floor for people who never contributed. Stretching the fund to cover everyone at 60% would force either a payroll tax rise or a benefit cut within a decade, and both fall hardest on the workers it is meant to protect.

options.t: 我会把部分基金转为随人流动的个人账户，另留一个较小的公共池应对长期失业。十年里换四份雇主的人，在现行制度下根本搞不清自己该拿多少。
options.t_en: I would shift part of the fund into individual accounts that workers carry between jobs, with a smaller shared pool for long spells. People who change employers four times in a decade lose track of what they are owed under the current scheme.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 某市议会正在重新审查后院养禽的规定，起因是一个高密度住宅区就噪音和气味提出投诉。现行规定允许每户最多养六只母鸡、禁养公鸡。提案一：上限降为三只，鸡舍须与地界保持退距，并加收登记费；提案二：保留六只上限，改为依靠邻里投诉加调解程序；提案三：允许出售多余鸡蛋，而有几户其实早已在私下交易。养鸡的家庭表示，鸡还能减少家庭厨余。
scene_en: A city council is reviewing its rules on backyard poultry after complaints about noise and smell from a dense residential ward. Current rules allow up to six hens per household but ban roosters. A proposal would cut the limit to three hens, require coops set back from property lines, and add a registration fee; a second proposal would keep the six-hen limit and rely on a neighbor complaint process with mediation. A third would allow the sale of surplus eggs, which several households already do informally. Poultry keepers say the birds also cut household food waste.

options.t: 我会把上限降为三只，并加上退距和登记费。窄地块上养六只鸡，鸡舍离邻居厨房窗户只有几米；登记费则用来支付检查，让这条规定不至于只是一句话。
options.t_en: I would cut the limit to three hens with setbacks and a fee. Six birds on a narrow lot puts a coop within a few meters of someone else's kitchen window, and the registration fee pays for the inspections that make the rule mean anything.

options.t: 我会保留六只上限，走投诉加调解的路子。养三四只鸡的家庭大多从没引发过投诉，为少数几家立规矩，却让每个养鸡的人都变成申请人。
options.t_en: I would keep six hens and rely on complaints plus mediation. Most households with three or four birds never generate a complaint, and writing a rule for the few who do makes every keeper a permit applicant.

options.t: 我会在卫生检查的前提下允许出售多余鸡蛋。这些家庭本来就在私下卖，把交易纳入检查，至少会有人去看鸡舍，而不是继续假装那些蛋是送人的。
options.t_en: I would allow the sale of surplus eggs with a health inspection. Households are already selling them quietly, and putting that trade under inspection means someone checks the coop instead of pretending the eggs are a gift.

options.t: 我会按地块面积定上限，而不是一个统一数字，退距规则则到处适用。四分之一英亩的院子和阳台公寓不是一回事，一开始用一个数字管两者，正是这场争执的由来。
options.t_en: I would set the limit by lot size rather than a flat number, with the setback rule applying everywhere. A quarter-acre yard and a balcony flat are not the same situation, and one number for both is what produced this argument in the first place.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 某县唯一的养老院因建筑不达抗震标准即将关闭。91 位住民需要安置，其中 30 位重度失智、需要封闭照护单元；最近的带失智专区的机构在 70 公里外。选项有三：补贴私营机构在原址重建，需三年；把一所旧学校改建为县营机构，18 个月内提供 60 张床位；或向家庭发放月度津贴，让亲属在家照护并配巡诊护士。家属已组织起来，有人说宁愿把老人送到外地也不接受临时安置。
scene_en: A county's only nursing home is closing because its building fails seismic standards. Ninety-one residents need places; thirty have severe dementia and need locked units; the nearest alternative with a dementia wing is 70 kilometers away. Options: subsidize a private operator to rebuild on the same site, which takes three years; convert a former school into a county-run facility with 60 beds in eighteen months; or pay families a monthly allowance to keep relatives at home with visiting nurses. Families have organized, and some say they would move a parent across the country rather than accept a temporary placement.

options.t: 我会补贴私营机构在原址重建，并在过渡期安排异地安置加接送。三年是长，但那块地已有熟悉这些住民的员工；把 91 个人分散到三个县，这份熟悉就永久丢了。
options.t_en: I would subsidize the private rebuild on the same site and arrange interim placements with transport. Three years is long, but the site already has staff who know these residents, and scattering ninety-one people across three counties loses that knowledge permanently.

options.t: 我会在 18 个月内把旧学校改成县营机构，并设失智专区。建一个公共选项，意味着下一次关闭不再取决于私营机构算不算得过来账。
options.t_en: I would convert the school into a county facility within eighteen months, with a dedicated dementia wing. Building a public option means the next closure does not depend on whether a private operator finds the numbers work.

options.t: 我会发放家庭津贴并配巡诊护士，把新建的 60 张床位留给失智住民。这个县多数人说过想留在家里；津贴让能留的人留得下，床位则留给留不下的人。
options.t_en: I would pay families the monthly allowance with visiting nurses, and reserve the sixty new beds for the dementia residents. Most people in this county have said they want to stay home; the allowance makes that possible for those who are able and keeps the beds for those who are not.

options.t: 我会出资改建旧学校，并让每个家庭在它和异地安置加交通补贴之间自己选。一个家庭对父母最后几年怎么过，取决于县里的规划看不到的东西；交通补贴让这个选择成为真的，而不只是名义上的。
options.t_en: I would fund the school conversion and let each family choose between it and a placement elsewhere with a travel subsidy. What a family decides about a parent's last years depends on things a county plan cannot see, and the travel subsidy makes the choice real rather than nominal.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 某国监管机构正在审查先买后付服务，数据显示 25 岁以下用户漏付分期的概率是信用卡持卡人的四倍。该服务不收利息，但两次漏付即封号，并将违约记录报送共享登记系统。备选方案：对超过一定金额的每笔消费做还款能力审查；按核实收入的比例限制每位用户的未结余额上限；对超过一定金额的消费设 48 小时冷静期；或在任何封号前要求放贷方先提供困难还款方案。零售商表示，审查会把消费者推向境外的应用。
scene_en: A national regulator is examining buy-now-pay-later services after data showed that users under 25 are four times more likely to miss an installment than credit card holders. The services charge no interest but ban accounts after two missed payments and report the default to a shared registry. Options: require affordability checks for every purchase above a threshold; cap total outstanding balances per user at a share of verified income; require a cooling-off period of 48 hours on purchases over a set amount; or require lenders to offer a hardship plan before any ban. Retailers say checks will push shoppers to offshore apps.

options.t: 我会要求超过一定金额的消费做还款能力审查。一个 22 岁的人一晚上能开六个账户，而这些应用没有一个会问，开到第四个时还够不够交房租。
options.t_en: I would require affordability checks above a threshold. A twenty-two-year-old can open six accounts in an evening, and none of those apps ever asks whether the fourth one leaves enough for rent.

options.t: 我会按核实收入的比例限制未结余额上限。逐笔审查看不到整体格局；真正把人推入违约的，是五个应用加起来的总额，而任何单一放贷方都看不到这个数。
options.t_en: I would cap total outstanding balances at a share of verified income. Checks on each purchase miss the pattern; what actually lands people in default is the sum across five apps that no single lender can see.

options.t: 我会对较大金额的消费设 48 小时冷静期，而不是做收入审查。审查是在消费者和一双鞋之间塞一张表；两天的停顿把决定权留给本人，同时给他一个晚上重新想。
options.t_en: I would require a 48-hour cooling-off period on larger purchases instead of income checks. The check puts a form between a shopper and a pair of shoes; a two-day pause leaves the decision with the person while giving them a night to reconsider.

options.t: 我会要求封号前必须先提供困难还款方案。直接封号并记一笔违约，可能让人丢掉租约，而余额往往小到分四期就能还清。
options.t_en: I would require a hardship plan before any ban. Cutting off an account and logging a default can cost someone a lease, and the balance is often small enough that a payment schedule of four installments would clear it.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 一个三年内遭两次洪水的沿海辖区正在决定如何花一笔恢复资金。方案一：加高河湾处的堤防，保护 400 户人家；方案二：买断最低洼处 40 户住宅，把该地块改成蓄洪区；方案三：把钱用于全区预警系统和疏散演练。住在洼地的业主表示，他们家三代人都住在那儿，而买断报价低于向内陆一公里处的重置成本。
scene_en: A coastal district hit by two floods in three years is deciding how to spend a recovery grant. One plan rebuilds the levee higher along the river bend protecting 400 homes; a second buys out the 40 homes in the lowest pocket and turns that land into a retention basin; a third spends the money on an early-warning system and evacuation drills for the whole district. Homeowners in the pocket say their families have lived there for three generations and the buyout offer is below replacement cost a kilometer inland.

options.t: 我会加高堤防。四百户人家保住了房子，工程在下一个雨季之前就能看见，洼地的人也不必按他们觉得不公平的价格卖房。
options.t_en: I would raise the levee. Four hundred households keep their homes, the work is visible before the next rainy season, and the people in the pocket are not asked to sell at a price they consider unfair.

options.t: 我会买断洼地并建蓄洪区。保护四百户人家的堤防同时也会抬高它背后的水位，下一次漫堤时，下游所有人面对的洪水会来得更快、更深。
options.t_en: I would buy out the pocket and build the basin. A levee that protects four hundred homes also raises the water level behind it, and the next flood that overtops it arrives faster and deeper for everyone downstream.

options.t: 我会把钱用在预警系统和演练上。三年两次洪水，遇难的人大多不知道夜里水会来；对一家人在水到时还在睡觉的家庭，堤防帮不上忙。
options.t_en: I would fund the warning system and drills. Two floods in three years killed people who had no idea the water was coming at night; a levee does not help a family that is still asleep when it arrives.

options.t: 我会把资金分给堤防和预警系统，并让洼地住户各自决定是否按重置成本接受买断。有人会拿钱搬到内陆，也有人留下的理由是一个辖区规划看不到的。
options.t_en: I would split the grant between the levee and the warning system, and let the pocket households decide individually whether to accept the buyout at replacement cost. Some will take it and move inland; others have reasons to stay that a district plan cannot know.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 某国竞争主管机构发现，一款外卖应用承接了 71% 的订单，入驻餐厅支付的佣金是五年前的三倍。该应用还部分按餐厅的推广投入来排序。备选方案：强制该应用允许餐厅使用其他配送队伍；对佣金按订单金额设定比例上限；要求排序算法向用户披露付费推广位置；或把该应用拆分为市场平台和物流两块。该应用表示佣金用于支撑骑手网络，若配送队伍打价格战，骑手收入会下降。
scene_en: A country's competition authority finds that one food-delivery app handles 71% of orders and that restaurants listed on it pay commissions three times higher than five years ago. The app also ranks restaurants partly by how much they spend on promoted placement. Options: force the app to let restaurants use other delivery fleets; cap commissions as a share of order value; require the ranking algorithm to disclose paid placement to users; or break the app into a marketplace arm and a logistics arm. The app says commissions fund the courier network, and couriers' earnings would fall if fleets compete on price.

options.t: 我会强制该应用允许餐厅用其他配送队伍。佣金之所以高，是因为餐厅没别处可送；当三支队伍都能送同一单，费率就由市场决定，而不是由该应用的市场地位决定。
options.t_en: I would force the app to let restaurants use other delivery fleets. The commission is high because the restaurant has nowhere else to send the food; once three fleets can carry the same order, the rate is set by the market rather than by the app's position.

options.t: 我会对佣金按订单金额设比例上限，同时保留网络完整。让小餐馆三分之一收入流向一个中间商，是一笔它转嫁不出去的税；设上限既让骑手网络继续运转，也让餐馆活得下去。
options.t_en: I would cap commissions at a share of order value and keep the network intact. A third of a small restaurant's revenue going to one intermediary is a tax the restaurant cannot pass on; a ceiling lets the courier network keep running while the restaurant survives.

options.t: 我会要求排序披露哪些位置是付费的。食客本来就以为排在前面的最好吃；告诉他们哪些是广告，对应用成本很小，却会改变人们真正选什么。
options.t_en: I would require the ranking to disclose which slots are paid. Diners already assume the top of the list is the best food; telling them which entries are advertisements costs the app little and changes what people actually choose.

options.t: 我会把该应用拆成市场平台和物流两块，并要求物流块为任何市场平台服务。既拥有道路又决定谁能上路行驶的公司，永远比依赖它的商家多一根杠杆。
options.t_en: I would break the app into a marketplace arm and a logistics arm, with the logistics arm required to serve any marketplace. A company that owns the road and decides who drives on it will always have one more lever than the businesses depending on it.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 一座 20 万人口的城市两年间接纳了 9000 名新来者，多为劳动年龄人口；学校系统中在家极少或不说本地语言的学生已达 1400 名。市议会正在三个方案中选择：先设两年集中的接收班做语言强化再进入普通班；立即进入普通班并为每个受影响的班级配一名助教；或要求新来者通过语言考试才能获得长期居留许可。雇主说他们需要这些工人；新来者子女的家长则在分开教学究竟是有帮助还是造成隔离上分歧明显。
scene_en: A city of 200,000 has received 9,000 newcomers in two years, most of working age, and its school system now enrolls 1,400 students who speak the local language at home rarely or not at all. The council is choosing among: a two-year intensive language program in separate reception classes before mainstreaming; immediate mainstreaming with a classroom aide in every affected class; or a requirement that newcomers pass a language test before receiving a long-term residence permit. Employers say they need the workers; parents of newcomer children are split on whether separate classes help or isolate.

options.t: 我会办两年接收班。第一年跟不上课的学生，之后每学期都会拉得更远；先把语言学两年，等他们进普通班时，那个教室才是他们真能用得上的。
options.t_en: I would run the two-year reception classes. A student who cannot follow the lesson in year one falls further behind every term; two years of language first means the mainstream classroom is something they can actually use when they get there.

options.t: 我会让新来者立即进普通班，并给每个受影响的班级配助教。孩子从别的孩子那里学语言，比从练习册上快；分开上课意味着本该成为朋友的同龄邻居要晚一年才认识，甚至一直不认识。
options.t_en: I would mainstream immediately with an aide in every affected class. Children pick up a language from other children faster than from a worksheet, and separate classes mean the neighborhood kids who would be their friends meet them a year later, if at all.

options.t: 我会要求语言考试作为长期居留的前提。一张几十年的居留许可，应当附带不必靠翻译就能和医生、房东、学校说话的能力；把这道门槛放在许可之前，而不是之后。
options.t_en: I would require the language test for long-term residence. A permit that lasts decades should come with the ability to talk to a doctor, a landlord and a school without an interpreter, and the test sets that bar before the permit rather than after.

options.t: 我会为成人出资办接收班、为孩子配班级助教，居留规则则不动。成人学语言是为了工作，可以晚上去学；孩子学语言是为了交朋友，在操场上就会了，两个群体需要的答案不一样。
options.t_en: I would fund the reception classes for adults and the classroom aides for children, and leave the residence rules alone. Adults need language for work and can study it in the evening; children need it for friendship and pick it up in the playground, so the two groups need different answers.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 你住的六层老楼启动加装电梯表决。一楼两户反对，理由是遮挡采光和运行噪音；五、六楼住着两位每天扶栏爬楼的八十岁老人。业委会拿不出让所有人点头的分摊方案，表决一再延期。
scene_en: Your six-story walk-up has started a ballot on installing an elevator. The two households on the first floor object, citing blocked light and motor noise; on the fifth and sixth floors live two eighty-year-olds who climb the stairs holding the rail every day. The residents' committee has no cost-sharing plan that satisfies everyone, and the vote keeps being postponed.

options.t: 我会按受益层数分摊：楼层越高出得越多，并给一楼一笔一次性补偿。让每天用电梯的人承担大头，同时让每天忍受它的人得到折算。
options.t_en: I would share costs by floor benefit: the higher you live, the more you pay, with a one-time payment to the first floor. Those who use the elevator daily carry the bulk, and those who endure it daily get it converted into compensation.

options.t: 我会动用维修基金加上政府的适老化补贴，不再向住户额外收钱。电梯不是某一户的私人物件，用公共的钱办公共的事，表决才推得动。
options.t_en: I would use the maintenance fund plus the government subsidy for aging-friendly retrofits, and not collect extra from households. The elevator is not any one household’s private asset; paying for public things from public money is what gets the ballot moving.

options.t: 我会坚持谁受益谁付费：高楼层住户自筹，一楼不出一分钱，也不被要求接受补偿。用不上的人没有义务为用得上的项目买单，哪怕出于好意。
options.t_en: I would insist that beneficiaries pay: the upper floors fund it themselves, the first floor pays nothing and is not asked to accept compensation. People who cannot use a project owe nothing toward it, however well-intentioned.

options.t: 我会先做采光模拟和无声电梯试点，把数据贴在楼道里再表决。现在双方争的是想象中的电梯，等参数落地，反对的理由可能自己消失。
options.t_en: I would first run a light-shadow simulation and a silent-elevator pilot, post the data in the stairwell, and only then hold the vote. Right now both sides are arguing over an imagined elevator; once the specs are on paper, the objections may dissolve on their own.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 你所在的三百人公司上线了 AI 简历初筛，招聘周期从六周缩到九天。有落选者比对后发现，简历里有两年职业空窗的申请者得分系统性偏低，而拒信是模板自动生成的，没有联系方式。
scene_en: Your 300-person company switched to AI screening of resumes, cutting the hiring cycle from six weeks to nine days. Rejected applicants who compared notes found that candidates with a two-year employment gap scored systematically lower, and the rejection letters are auto-generated templates with no contact details.

options.t: 我会保留系统，但公开打分维度，并给每个落选者一条人工申诉通道。效率值得要，但一个没人能问询的决定，不配替人关门。
options.t_en: I would keep the system but publish the scoring dimensions and give every rejected applicant a human appeal channel. The efficiency is worth having, but a decision nobody can question should not be shutting doors on people.

options.t: 我会扩大使用范围。九天完成初筛意味着候选人不用边等边耗，空窗期打分偏差可以通过调参修正，总体上它比疲劳的招聘专员更稳定。
options.t_en: I would expand its use. A nine-day screening round means candidates stop burning savings while they wait; the gap-scoring bias can be tuned out, and overall the model is more consistent than a tired recruiter.

options.t: 我会退回人工初筛。筛简历本来就是这个规模公司养得起的人力成本，为省两周把判断权交给看不懂空窗期的模型，账算不过来。
options.t_en: I would go back to human screening. Reading resumes is a labor cost a company this size can afford; trading two weeks for a model that cannot read an employment gap is a bad deal.

options.t: 我会让 AI 只做候选池排序，任何拒绝决定必须由一名招聘人员签字负责。机器可以排队，但关门的动作得由人来做，出了错也有名有姓可追。
options.t_en: I would let the AI only rank the candidate pool, with every rejection signed off by a named recruiter. The machine may line people up, but the door must be closed by a person, so that when it errs there is someone to answer.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 市图书馆收到二十多封家长投诉，要求把一批描写战争创伤的回忆录从青少年区移到成人区并加封皮遮盖书名。与此同时，一位中学老师来信说，正是其中一本让班里一个沉默的孩子第一次开口谈了家里的事。
scene_en: The city library has received twenty-plus parent complaints asking that a set of war-trauma memoirs be moved from the teen section to the adult section with the covers wrapped. Meanwhile a middle-school teacher writes that one of these books was what made a silent student in her class talk about his family for the first time.

options.t: 我会把它们移到成人区。图书馆按年龄分层排架是几十年的惯例，家长对十二岁孩子读什么有发言权，这不等于那些书有问题。
options.t_en: I would move them to the adult section. Tiering shelves by age has been library practice for decades, and parents of twelve-year-olds have a say in what they read — that is not the same as saying the books are a problem.

options.t: 我会保持原位，只加一页导读，说明书里涉及的内容。把选择连同判断一起交回给读者和家长，图书馆的角色是备齐书架，不是替家庭把关。
options.t_en: I would keep them where they are and add a reader’s note describing the content. The choice, along with the judgment, goes back to readers and parents; the library’s job is to keep the shelves stocked, not to vet for families.

options.t: 我会把这批书撤出馆藏。二十多封投诉代表社区的真实情绪，公共机构不必用纳税人的钱坚持陈列大多数人不想让孩子看到的东西。
options.t_en: I would withdraw the books from the collection. Twenty-plus complaints reflect real feeling in the community, and a public institution need not spend taxpayers’ money insisting on keeping what most parents do not want their children to see.

options.t: 我会保留馆藏，并办一场作者对谈与师生共读会，把这场争议变成公共讨论。书架上吵不清的事，放到同一个房间里，往往反而说得清。
options.t_en: I would keep the collection and host an author talk and a staff-student reading circle, turning the dispute into a public conversation. What cannot be settled over a shelf is often settled in a shared room.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 你国的统计年鉴显示：GDP 增长 4.8%，基尼系数却升到 0.49，青年失业率 15%。财政部明年只有一个名额的旗舰政策，四套方案都在桌上。
scene_en: The national yearbook shows GDP growth of 4.8% while the Gini coefficient has climbed to 0.49 and youth unemployment stands at 15%. The finance ministry can fund only one flagship policy next year, and four proposals are on the table.

options.t: 我会选择给中小企业减税。把蛋糕做大是分配的前提，企业多雇一个人，胜过任何一笔转移支付，且不用养一套征税机器。
options.t_en: I would pick tax cuts for small firms. Growing the pie is the precondition for dividing it; one more person hired beats any transfer payment, and it does not require feeding a collection bureaucracy.

options.t: 我会扩大育儿和住房补贴。0.49 的基尼系数说明问题不在蛋糕大小而在切块，直接压低底层家庭的生活成本，是见效最快的再分配。
options.t_en: I would expand childcare and housing subsidies. A Gini of 0.49 says the problem is the slicing, not the size of the pie; directly cutting the cost of living for low-income households is the fastest-acting redistribution.

options.t: 我会开征财富税，专款用于公共服务。让资产增值的部分承担与其体量相称的税负，再用这笔钱修学校医院，比向工薪层加税更对症。
options.t_en: I would introduce a wealth tax earmarked for public services. Making asset gains carry a tax burden proportionate to their size, then spending it on schools and hospitals, targets the problem better than taxing paychecks.

options.t: 我会选基本收入试点，选两个城市发三年，用数据说话。转移支付的争论吵了四十年都靠猜，一笔足够大的样本能把猜变成算。
options.t_en: I would pick a basic-income pilot in two cities for three years and let the data speak. The argument over transfers has run on guesswork for forty years; a large enough sample turns guessing into arithmetic.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你国两年前对进口太阳能面板加征关税，本土工厂保住了两千个岗位，但屋顶光伏装机量下降了三成，安装商抱怨面板价格比邻国高 40%。议会正在评估要不要延续关税。
scene_en: Two years ago your country imposed tariffs on imported solar panels, preserving 2,000 factory jobs, but rooftop installations have fallen 30% and installers complain panels cost 40% more than across the border. Parliament is reviewing whether to renew the tariffs.

options.t: 我会延续关税。两千个岗位背后是两千个家庭和一条还没长成的产业链，装机放缓可以等，产业垮了重建要十年。
options.t_en: I would renew the tariffs. Behind those 2,000 jobs are 2,000 households and an industrial chain not yet mature; slower installations can wait, but a collapsed industry takes a decade to rebuild.

options.t: 我会取消关税。每延缓一批屋顶装机，就多烧一年进口燃气，三成的装机损失折算成碳排放和能源账单，早超过了那两千个岗位的工资。
options.t_en: I would scrap the tariffs. Every delayed rooftop means another year of imported gas; a 30% loss of installations, converted into carbon and energy bills, already outweighs those 2,000 paychecks.

options.t: 我会以关税为筹码，要求外国厂商在境内建厂换市场准入。要让市场，就留下产能和就业；只想卖货的，就绕不开关税。
options.t_en: I would use the tariffs as leverage, requiring foreign makers to build plants in-country for market access. Those who want the market leave capacity and jobs behind; those who only want to ship cannot get around the tariff.

options.t: 我会延续关税，同时对低收入家庭的屋顶装机发放安装补贴，两头都要顾：工厂的岗位保住，装不起面板的家庭也不被价格上涨挡在门外。
options.t_en: I would renew the tariffs while paying installation subsidies for low-income households’ rooftop systems. Both ends matter: the factory jobs stay, and families who could not afford panels are not priced out by the increase.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 一片三平方公里的滨海湿地旁拟建物流园区，承诺三千个岗位和每年四亿税收；同一片湿地是三十万只候鸟的迁徙中转站，环保部门记录显示周边开发已让它十年缩小了一半。
scene_en: A logistics park is proposed beside a three-square-kilometer coastal wetland, promising 3,000 jobs and 400 million a year in tax revenue; the same wetland is a stopover for 300,000 migratory birds, and records show surrounding development has already halved it in a decade.

options.t: 我会批准园区。三千个稳定岗位对一个失业率偏高的地区是实打实的账，湿地可以在规划里保留核心区，开发不必是清零。
options.t_en: I would approve the park. Three thousand stable jobs are concrete arithmetic for a region with high unemployment; the wetland can keep a core zone in the plan, and development need not mean wiping it out.

options.t: 我会否决项目。缩小一半只用了十年，剩下的再切一刀，三十万只候鸟的通道就断了，而岗位在哪儿都能创造，停歇地没了就是没了。
options.t_en: I would veto the project. It took only ten years to halve the wetland; one more cut breaks the corridor for 300,000 birds, and while jobs can be created anywhere, a stopover, once gone, is gone.

options.t: 我会批准缩水的方案：园区规模减半，开发商出资修复另一片退化湿地，做到面积上净零损失。就业要保，账也要算到生态这一栏。
options.t_en: I would approve a reduced plan: the park halved in size and the developer funding restoration of another degraded wetland, for net-zero area loss. The jobs get kept, and the ledger includes an ecology column.

options.t: 我会先做三年生态基线调查，园区审批冻结到数据齐为止。用三个岗位年去换一次真正弄清这块湿地还剩多少承受力，这笔账不亏。
options.t_en: I would commission a three-year ecological baseline survey and freeze the permit until the data is in. Trading three job-years to actually learn how much stress this wetland can still take is a fair price.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 你所在的初中改革招生政策，讨论是否按入学成绩分班。试点校数据显示：分班两年后尖子班竞赛获奖翻倍，普通班及格率下降六个百分点，普通班家长的投诉信堆满了校长信箱。
scene_en: Your middle school is debating whether to stream students by entrance scores. Pilot data show that after two years of streaming, competition awards in the top classes doubled while pass rates in the ordinary classes fell six points, and parents’ complaints have filled the principal’s inbox.

options.t: 我会分班。把进度差异大的孩子塞进同一间教室，等于让跑得快的陪跑、跑得慢的拖垮，分层教学对两头都是成全。
options.t_en: I would stream. Packing children of very different paces into one room means the fast ones coast and the slow ones drown; teaching in layers does right by both ends.

options.t: 我会保持混龄混合编班，用课内分层作业替代班级分层。及格率掉的那六个点是真实的孩子，竞赛奖牌不该用他们的初中去换。
options.t_en: I would keep mixed classes and replace class-level streaming with within-class tiered assignments. That six-point pass-rate drop is real children; medals should not be bought with their middle-school years.

options.t: 我会分班，但每学期允许流动，并把最好的教师轮换排进普通班。分层不是判刑，流动通道和资源倾斜才是它和放弃之间的区别。
options.t_en: I would stream, but with term-by-term movement between levels and the strongest teachers rotated into the ordinary classes. Streaming is not a sentence; mobility and tilted resources are what separate it from abandonment.

options.t: 我会把选择权交给家长：同等师资下自愿报名分层班。教育理念不该由校方统一，家庭对自家孩子的判断常常比测验分数准。
options.t_en: I would hand the choice to parents: opt-in streamed classes under equal teaching resources. Educational philosophy should not be set by the school, and a family’s read on its own child is often sharper than a test score.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 你所在的地区医院缺口四百名护士，从海外招人后，患者投诉集中在沟通障碍：用药说明听不懂、疼痛描述被误判。护理部提出三个方向，预算只够选一个。
scene_en: Your regional hospital is short 400 nurses and has recruited from overseas; patient complaints center on communication — medication instructions not understood, pain descriptions misread. Nursing leadership proposes three directions, and the budget covers only one.

options.t: 我会设上岗语言考试，不过线不发执照。病人把身体交给护士，靠的是一句话能被听懂，这道门槛应该排在病房之前。
options.t_en: I would set a language exam before licensure; no pass, no license. Patients hand their bodies to nurses on the strength of a sentence being understood, and that bar belongs before the ward.

options.t: 我会出资在职语言培训，并在各病区配翻译支持。四百名护士已经招到了，卡住他们上岗解决不了人手缺口，只会把缺口变成等待。
options.t_en: I would fund on-the-job language training with interpretation support in every ward. The 400 nurses are already recruited; blocking them from duty does not fill the shortage, it just turns the shortage into a waiting list.

options.t: 我会不加附加条件。病房里用到的护理词汇几个月就能上手；而这四百名护士每多等一个月，病区就多空一个月——护理质量取决于培训与督导，不取决于入职时的口音。
options.t_en: I would add no language condition. The vocabulary a nurse needs on a ward comes in a few months, and every month these four hundred wait is another month the ward runs short; care quality turns on training and supervision, not on accent at hiring.

options.t: 我会把这笔预算转投本地护理专业的奖学金和岗位薪资。海外招聘补的是眼前这几个月的排班，本地培养补的是十年后的供给；这样一来，语言磨合期的成本也不会落在患者身上。
options.t_en: I would move this budget into scholarships and pay for local nursing training. Overseas recruitment fills the rota for the next few months; local training fills the supply ten years out, and the cost of a language adjustment period then does not land on patients.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 你所在城市的地铁系统试点人脸识别抓捕，半年内在闸机比对中确认了十二名通缉犯，也误拦了三名长相相似的无辜市民，其中一人在派出所滞留了六个小时。公安部门申请扩大到全部四百个站点。
scene_en: Your city’s metro has piloted facial-recognition arrests: in six months gate-camera matching confirmed twelve wanted suspects, but also stopped three innocent lookalikes, one of whom was held at a station for six hours. Police now ask to extend it to all 400 stations.

options.t: 我会扩大试点。十二名通缉犯背后可能有多少未被犯下的案子，三起误拦用赔偿和道歉补救得起，放走的嫌疑人补救不了。
options.t_en: I would expand the pilot. Behind those twelve suspects are crimes that never got to happen; three wrongful stops can be remedied with compensation and apology, a suspect released cannot.

options.t: 我会停用。一个清白市民在派出所坐六个小时，是用他的无辜替系统交的学费，这个学费不该由路人来付。
options.t_en: I would shut it down. An innocent citizen spending six hours in a station is tuition paid by his good luck of being nobody’s target; bystanders should not be the ones paying for the system’s learning curve.

options.t: 我会继续，但加两条硬约束：比对数据二十四小时内删除，误拦率设红线，超标即熔断，并请独立机构季度审计。收益可以要，边界必须写死。
options.t_en: I would continue, with two hard constraints: matching data deleted within 24 hours, a red line on the false-stop rate that triggers automatic shutdown, and quarterly independent audits. The gains can be kept; the limits must be written in stone.

options.t: 我会把同样的预算转成警力：增派两百名站内巡警。人能看见谁在紧张谁在求助，机器只看见像素，治安需要的判断力不在摄像头里。
options.t_en: I would convert the same budget into officers: 200 more patrols in the stations. A human sees who is nervous and who needs help; a camera sees pixels, and the judgment policing needs is not in the footage.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 你所在的区域医院 ICU 常年超员，流感季三张空床来了五个符合条件的病人。医务委员会要定一条事前规则，避免每个夜班都由值班医生临场决定谁上呼吸机。
scene_en: Your regional ICU runs over capacity year-round; one flu season, five eligible patients arrived for three beds. The medical board must set a rule in advance so that on-call doctors stop deciding at 3 a.m. who gets the ventilator.

options.t: 我会定先到先得。事前规则做不到比到达顺序更公平，任何评分都会把一部分人排在队尾，而运气至少不挑人。
options.t_en: I would set first-come, first-served. No pre-set rule is fairer than order of arrival; every scoring system sends someone to the back of the line, and luck at least does not pick.

options.t: 我会按预后评分分配，让有限的床位救活最多的人。三个床位面对五个病人时，浪漫的公平等于多死一个人，数字在这里就是道德。
options.t_en: I would allocate by prognosis score, so limited beds save the most lives. With three beds and five patients, romantic fairness means one more death; here the arithmetic is the ethics.

options.t: 我会给高传染期承担照护的医护和其直系家属优先位。让暴露风险最高的人群排队排到最后，下一个流感季就没人愿意站在第一排。
options.t_en: I would give priority to frontline medical staff and their immediate families during epidemic peaks. Making those with the highest exposure wait in the back guarantees that next flu season nobody stands in the front row.

options.t: 我会用加权抽签：预后差的老者多得一次签，一线医护多得一次签，其余交给概率。规则承认差别，但不把任何一类人整个排除在门外。
options.t_en: I would use weighted lottery: the elderly with poor prognosis get an extra ticket, frontline staff an extra ticket, and the rest is left to chance. The rule acknowledges differences without excluding any group outright.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 你国上市公司董事会中女性占比 14%，十年只涨了四个百分点。议会辩论两项提案：设 40% 配额并配套罚款，或仅强制披露性别数据而不设指标。
scene_en: Women hold 14% of board seats at listed companies in your country, up just four points in a decade. Parliament debates two bills: a 40% quota with fines attached, or mandatory gender disclosure with no target.

options.t: 我会支持配额。披露制度已试了十年，四个百分点的增速说明信任自它会等到退休；不挂钩罚款的指标只是另一种建议。
options.t_en: I would back the quota. Disclosure has had ten years and delivered four points, which means waiting for goodwill means waiting for retirement; a target without fines is just another suggestion.

options.t: 我会支持只强制披露。名单在阳光下挂十年，董事会的构成自己会变；配额会让席位变成凑数，反而坐实了对女性董事的怀疑。
options.t_en: I would back disclosure only. Ten years of names in daylight already moves boards; quotas turn seats into headcount filler and feed the very doubts about women directors they claim to fix.

options.t: 我会把立法资源投给育儿假改革：父亲配额休满才生效。董事会的性别结构是果，家庭里的分工才是因，从上游改比在董事会门口设岗更有效。
options.t_en: I would spend the legislative capital on parental-leave reform: a father’s quota must be used for the benefit to activate. Board composition is the fruit; the division of labor at home is the root, and upstream beats a checkpoint at the boardroom door.

options.t: 我会两项都不通过。董事席位的分配是股东和自己钱的私事，十年四个百分点不是失灵，是市场按自己的节奏在走。
options.t_en: I would pass neither. Board seats are a private matter between shareholders and their own money; four points in ten years is not failure, it is the market moving at its own pace.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 你所在城市把政务热线换成 AI 客服后，日均处理量翻倍，但老年用户投诉集中在：方言识别失败、材料清单说不清、转人工要排队四十分钟。热线中心 next 年度预算听证在即。
scene_en: Since your city replaced the government hotline with an AI agent, daily case volume has doubled, but elderly users complain that dialects fail recognition, required-document lists come out garbled, and transfer-to-human queues run forty minutes. The hotline center’s budget hearing is next month.

options.t: 我会为 AI 追加训练预算，方言和清单问题都是数据量问题。退回人工等于把翻倍的效率还回去，老年人需要的接线员，年轻人同样需要。
options.t_en: I would add training budget for the AI; dialects and document lists are data-volume problems. Rolling back to humans hands back the doubled throughput, and the operator elderly users need, younger users need too.

options.t: 我会把人工窗口设为默认，AI 只做前置分流和表格预填。政务热线的用户没有义务先通过机器的面试才轮得到人，尤其是替这座城市交了几十年税的人。
options.t_en: I would make the human line the default, with AI doing upfront triage and form pre-fill. Users of a public hotline owe no interview with a machine before reaching a person — least of all those who have paid this city’s taxes for decades.

options.t: 我会推动立法：任何政务办理必须永久保留线下人工通道，AI 只能做增量。效率是平台的指标，不是市民的义务。
options.t_en: I would push a law: every government service must permanently keep an in-person human channel, with AI allowed only as an addition. Throughput is the platform’s metric, not the citizen’s obligation.

options.t: 我会把预算转投社区数字助老培训，让志愿者教老人用 AI 热线。机器的门槛会随熟练消失，把市民挡在门外的往往不是技术，是没人教。
options.t_en: I would redirect the budget to community digital-literacy training, with volunteers teaching seniors to use the AI hotline. The machine’s threshold fades with practice; what keeps citizens out is rarely the tech, it is that nobody taught them.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 你国法院同罪不同判的离散度引发关注：同样的盗窃数额，各市量刑跨度从缓刑到三年。司法部起草方案，引入量刑辅助算法为法官提供参考区间，法官保留最终决定权。
scene_en: Sentencing dispersion has drawn scrutiny in your country: for the same theft amount, terms across cities range from probation to three years. The justice ministry proposes a sentencing-support algorithm offering reference ranges, with judges keeping final authority.

options.t: 我会引入算法。三年和缓刑之间的差距不是司法个性，是同案不同价；参考区间能把它压回合理带宽，自由裁量留给区间之内。
options.t_en: I would adopt the algorithm. The gap between probation and three years is not judicial personality, it is the same conduct priced differently; a reference range squeezes that back to a sensible band, with discretion kept inside it.

options.t: 我会拒绝引入。量刑要读的是被告席上那个人，不是特征向量；把个案判断外包给模型，法官迟早从裁判者退化成签字员。
options.t_en: I would refuse it. Sentencing requires reading the person in the dock, not a feature vector; outsource the judgment to a model and judges will erode from adjudicators into signature clerks.

options.t: 我会引入，但强制公开算法逻辑与训练数据来源，辩护方有权质证。要参考可以，但控辩双方都得看得见那个第三只手。
options.t_en: I would adopt it, but mandate publishing the algorithm’s logic and training-data sources, with defense counsel entitled to challenge them. A reference is acceptable only if both sides can see the third hand in the room.

options.t: 我会先在轻罪范围试点两年，重罪维持纯人工。让算法先在代价最小的区域积累记录，记录干净了再谈往上走。
options.t_en: I would pilot it for two years in misdemeanor cases and keep felonies purely human. Let the algorithm build its record where mistakes cost least; only a clean record earns the next step.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 你所在省份议会讨论公立学校教师佩戴宗教服饰的禁令：支持者称讲台应保持中立，反对者称这把部分女性挡在了教师职业之外。全省现有二十七名在岗教师受此影响。
scene_en: Your provincial parliament is debating a ban on teachers wearing religious dress in public schools: supporters say the podium should stay neutral, opponents say it bars some women from the profession. Twenty-seven serving teachers across the province would be affected.

options.t: 我会支持禁令。讲台面向的是二十几个家庭的孩子，教师的服饰在教室里就是课程的一部分，世俗的中立性本身就是对所有家长的公平。
options.t_en: I would support the ban. The podium faces the children of twenty-plus families, and a teacher’s dress is part of the curriculum in a classroom; secular neutrality is itself fairness to every parent.

options.t: 我会反对禁令。一位戴头巾的数学老师教得和谁一样好，禁令并没有提高任何一门课的分数，只是把二十七个人请出了她们选的职业。
options.t_en: I would oppose the ban. A math teacher who wears a headscarf teaches as well as anyone; the ban raises no course grade, it simply escorts twenty-seven people out of a profession they chose.

options.t: 我会折中：学生不受限，教师受限于课堂场合。未成年人处在形成判断的年纪，而成年人有权为自己的信仰承担可见的代价。
options.t_en: I would compromise: students unrestricted, teachers restricted to classroom hours. Minors are at the age of forming judgment, while adults may bear the visible cost of their faith if they choose.

options.t: 我会把决定权下放到每个学区，由当地社区投票。一座城市习以为常的事，另一座城市觉得不可思议，一刀切才是制造对立的那一步。
options.t_en: I would devolve the decision to each school district by community vote. What one city finds unremarkable another finds unthinkable; a single statewide cut is the step that manufactures the conflict.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你所在的城中村住了三万租客，月租六百到九百，是这座城市最低的一档。开发商提出的整体改造方案承诺新房与地铁，但建成前租客需自行搬迁，周边同水平房源几乎没有。
scene_en: Your urban village houses 30,000 renters paying 600 to 900 a month — the cheapest tier in the city. The developer’s comprehensive redevelopment promises new housing and a metro line, but tenants must relocate on their own before completion, and virtually nothing at that price exists nearby.

options.t: 我会推进整体改造。三万人挤在没有消防通道的握手楼里，一场火就是头条；低价不能是忍受危险的理由，搬迁补偿可以谈得更高。
options.t_en: I would proceed with comprehensive redevelopment. Thirty thousand people packed into handshake buildings without fire corridors are one blaze away from a headline; cheapness is no reason to tolerate danger, and relocation compensation can be negotiated upward.

options.t: 我会改走微改造：不动楼体，逐栋补消防、水电和公厕，租金冻结三年。三万人的居住网络——通勤、生意、孩子上学——拆一次就没了。
options.t_en: I would switch to incremental renovation: no demolition, building-by-building fire safety, utilities and toilets, with rents frozen three years. Thirty thousand people’s web of commutes, trades and school runs is destroyed the day you demolish it.

options.t: 我会批准改造，但把容积率提到足够高，要求开发商配建不低于一万套保障房，原租客优先轮候。城市要长高，但长出来的面积得分给被挪走的人。
options.t_en: I would approve redevelopment with floor-area ratio raised high enough to require at least 10,000 subsidized units, with original tenants first in the queue. The city must grow taller, but the added floor area goes partly to the people displaced.

options.t: 我会放宽私人加建的合法化路径：补缴配套费即可转正，业主自己决定加建或出租。三万人的住房市场已经存在，政府要做的不是推倒它，是承认它。
options.t_en: I would legalize a path for private additions: pay the infrastructure fee, get titled, and let owners decide whether to build up or rent out. A housing market for 30,000 people already exists; the state should not demolish it but recognize it.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 你国农业部收到抗旱玉米品种的种植审批申请：试点田增产 22%，农药用量减半；反对联署由三百名种植户和五个环保组织发起，称花粉漂移无法召回。
scene_en: Your agriculture ministry has received an approval application for a drought-tolerant corn variety: pilot fields show 22% higher yield with half the pesticide use; a counter-petition from 300 growers and five environmental groups argues pollen drift cannot be recalled.

options.t: 我会批准种植。22% 的增产在旱年是实打实的口粮，半数的农药同样是生态收益；对一种作物的恐惧不该重于对一片田的实测。
options.t_en: I would approve planting. A 22% yield gain is real food in a drought year, and half the pesticide is an ecological gain too; fear of a technique should not outweigh measured results from a field.

options.t: 我会否决。花粉不认识田埂，一旦漂移就收不回；传统品种农户的种子被污染后，损失由谁赔，申请书写得再好也没写这一条。
options.t_en: I would reject it. Pollen does not respect field borders and cannot be recalled once drift happens; when a conventional farmer’s seed gets contaminated, nobody in the application says who pays for that loss.

options.t: 我会批准，但附两个条件：强制三百米隔离带，收成全程标识可溯源。让市场用货架投票，生产者用田埂负责，两边都有得选。
options.t_en: I would approve with two conditions: a mandatory 300-meter buffer strip and full traceable labeling of the harvest. The market votes on the shelf, growers answer at the field edge, and both sides keep a choice.

options.t: 我会批三年扩大试点：面积翻倍、独立机构全程监测、届满公开评审后再定。二十二个百分点值得认真对待，认真的意思是再看三年，不是签字。
options.t_en: I would approve a three-year expanded pilot: doubled area, independent monitoring throughout, and a public review at expiry before any final call. Twenty-two points deserve seriousness, and seriousness means three more years of looking, not a signature.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 大选前六周，一段候选人「承认受贿」的视频在短视频平台播放量破千万，事后证实是 AI 换脸。选举委员会要在投票日前完成规则修补，四个方案都在桌上。
scene_en: Six weeks before a national election, a clip of a candidate “admitting bribery” passed ten million views on short-video platforms before being confirmed as an AI face-swap. The election commission must patch the rules before voting day, and four proposals are on the table.

options.t: 我会全面禁止投票期前的政治深伪内容，一律下架。选举没有第二次，一段视频就能改写的民意，事后澄清追不回来。
options.t_en: I would ban political deepfakes outright during the campaign period, remove on sight. An election has no second run; a will rewritten by one clip cannot be recovered by later clarification.

options.t: 我会保留制作自由，但强制显著标识，无标识按虚假宣传重罚。成年人有权看任何内容，前提是知道自己在看什么。
options.t_en: I would keep creation free but mandate conspicuous labeling, with heavy fines for unlabeled use. Adults may watch anything, provided they know what they are watching.

options.t: 我会把规则交回平台自治。四家平台的政治内容审核队伍加起来是委员会的四十倍，让离内容最近的人管内容，比立法管得快。
options.t_en: I would leave the rules to platform self-governance. The four platforms’ political-content teams combined outnumber the commission forty to one; those closest to the content police it faster than legislation can.

options.t: 我会设公共事实核查机构，对爆量政治内容强制实时核查标注。下架会留下阴谋论的口子，标注把判断权和证据一起交给观众。
options.t_en: I would create a public fact-checking body that must verify and label viral political content in real time. Takedowns feed conspiracy theories; labels hand the judgment call to viewers together with the evidence.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 你省少年管教所超员 40%，再犯率 61%。司法厅拿两套方案：扩建少管所新增八百床位，或把预算转成社区矫治中心，让轻罪少年白天报到、晚间回家。
scene_en: Your province’s juvenile detention centers run 40% over capacity with a 61% reoffending rate. The justice department offers two plans: expand detention by 800 beds, or shift the budget to community-correction centers where low-level offenders report by day and sleep at home.

options.t: 我会扩建少管所。61% 的再犯率说明矫治不够重，围墙至少保证关押期内没有新的受害人，社区方案是把风险摊给街坊。
options.t_en: I would expand detention. A 61% reoffending rate says the correction is not weighty enough; a wall at least guarantees no new victims during the term, while the community plan spreads the risk across the neighborhood.

options.t: 我会选社区矫治。超员40%的围墙只会把少年犯培养成成年犯，白天报到、晚上回家的少年保住了学校、工作和不坐牢的朋友。
options.t_en: I would pick community correction. A wall 40% over capacity is a finishing school for adult prison; the teen who reports by day and sleeps at home keeps his school, his job, and the friends who never went inside.

options.t: 我会两条都批：轻罪走社区矫治，暴力罪保留监禁，家长承担连带矫治责任。按危险性分流，而不是按预算方便分流。
options.t_en: I would approve both: community correction for minor offenses, detention for violent ones, with parents bearing joint correctional responsibility. Sort by risk, not by whichever line item is easier to fund.

options.t: 我会把预算投给技能培训和犯罪记录封存的衔接：白天在技校学电工，出所后档案里没有这道墙。再犯率的另一半答案在释放那天之后。
options.t_en: I would put the budget into vocational training plus record-sealing: apprenticeship as an electrician by day, and a file without a wall after release. The other half of the reoffending answer starts the day they get out.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 你国正在谈判加入一个十二国区域自贸协定：出口制造业预计获益 3.2%，但农业部门测算全国 18% 的种植户会在五年内失去价格竞争力，其中多数集中在两个农业大省。
scene_en: Your country is negotiating accession to a twelve-nation regional trade pact: manufacturing exports are projected to gain 3.2%, but farm-sector modeling shows 18% of growers losing price competitiveness within five years, most of them concentrated in two agricultural provinces.

options.t: 我会加入。3.2% 的出口收益养活的岗位比流失的种植户多，且协定带来的是十二国市场的永久准入，一次谈判锁住几十年。
options.t_en: I would join. The jobs created by a 3.2% export gain outnumber the growers lost, and the pact buys permanent access to a twelve-nation market — one negotiation, decades of entry.

options.t: 我会不加入。18% 的种植户不是统计残差，是两个省的地基；制造业的订单可以换客户，农业的村落散了就聚不回来。
options.t_en: I would stay out. That 18% is not a statistical residue, it is the foundation of two provinces; manufacturing can change customers, but villages, once dispersed, do not reassemble.

options.t: 我会加入，同时设立农业转型基金：五年内向受冲击种植户支付转产与技能费用。开的门要开，被门挤到的人要有垫子。
options.t_en: I would join and create a transition fund: five years of payments for replanting and retraining to the affected growers. Open the door, but cushion the people it squeezes.

options.t: 我会继续谈，把农业过渡期从三年拉长到十年再签。协定跑不了，两省的种植户等得起十年，等不起第三年就断崖。
options.t_en: I would keep negotiating and stretch the agricultural transition from three years to ten before signing. The pact is not going anywhere; the growers in those two provinces can survive a decade, but not a cliff in year three.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 养老金精算报告显示：按现行参数，基金将于十一年后出现年度缺口，规模相当于当年财政支出的 6%。改革方向四个：延迟退休、提高缴费、降低替代率、财政注入。
scene_en: The pension actuarial report shows the fund tipping into annual deficit in eleven years at current parameters, equal to 6% of that year’s budget. Four reform directions are on the table: raise retirement age, raise contributions, cut replacement rates, or general-budget infusions.

options.t: 我会延迟退休，并按工种设弹性区间。预期寿命比制度设计时多了七年，领取年限不调整，缺口只会一年比一年大。
options.t_en: I would raise the retirement age with flexible ranges by occupation. Life expectancy is seven years longer than when the system was designed; without adjusting claiming years, the deficit only grows.

options.t: 我会提高高收入群体的缴费上限。工资单上已经贴着上限的缴费，等于让最需要保障的人补贴最有能力缴费的人，方向反了。
options.t_en: I would lift the contribution cap for high earners. A payroll cap means those who most need the security subsidize those most able to pay — the direction is backwards.

options.t: 我会温和下调替代率并推开个人养老金账户，让每个人为自己的第二支柱负责。制度的长寿不该建立在下一代更高的缴费单上。
options.t_en: I would trim replacement rates moderately and roll out personal pension accounts, making each person responsible for their second pillar. The system’s longevity should not rest on the next generation’s payslips.

options.t: 我会用财政逐年注入填补缺口。养老承诺是国家开出的支票，用今天 6% 的支出换十一年后的制度信用，是所有选项里唯一不用动千万人的。
options.t_en: I would close the gap with phased budget infusions. The pension promise is a check the state already wrote; spending 6% today to keep the system credible in eleven years is the only option that leaves millions of paychecks untouched.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 你国现行法规要求协议离婚经过三十天冷静期。婚姻登记处的数据显示：冷静期撤回申请占 22%，同期家庇护所入住率上升 9%。议会辩论是否延长至六十天。
scene_en: Current law requires a 30-day cooling-off period before consensual divorce. Registry data show 22% of filings are withdrawn during the period, while shelter admissions rose 9% in the same window. Parliament is debating extending it to sixty days.

options.t: 我会支持延长到六十天。有五分之一的申请在三十天内被撤回，多给三十天，改变的就是这五分之一的结果。
options.t_en: I would extend it to sixty days. One in five applications is withdrawn within the first thirty, and an extra thirty days changes the outcome for exactly that fifth.

options.t: 我会取消冷静期。成年人对婚姻的决定不需要国家替他复习一遍，两个想离婚的人多等的一个月，没有让一桩婚姻变好过。
options.t_en: I would abolish the cooling-off period. Adults do not need the state to proofread a marriage decision; an extra month of waiting has never made a bad marriage better.

options.t: 我会保留三十天，但设家暴与安全例外，并在登记处常驻调解员。这三十天挡下的是仓促提交的申请，不该挡下的是想尽快离开一段危险关系的人。
options.t_en: I would keep the thirty days with a domestic-violence and safety exemption, and a mediator at the registry. The thirty days catch hastily filed applications; they should not catch someone trying to leave a dangerous relationship quickly.

options.t: 我会把冷静期改为可选购：婚前协议里双方自主约定要不要、多长。婚姻的条款本就该由缔结婚姻的人来写。
options.t_en: I would make the cooling-off period opt-in, negotiated in a prenuptial agreement — whether to have one and how long. The terms of a marriage belong to the people entering it.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 你省现有九家马戏团饲养着 140 头表演用野生动物，兽医检查显示三成存在刻板行为。省议会讨论全面禁令，马戏团协会称这将直接关停约六百个岗位。
scene_en: Your province has nine circuses keeping 140 performing wild animals; veterinary inspections find stereotypic behavior in about a third. The provincial parliament debates a full ban, and the circus association says it would shut down some 600 jobs.

options.t: 我会支持全面禁止。狮子在拖车里来回踱步不是表演，是信号；一个行业的六百个岗位，不该建立在三成动物已经出问题的记录上。
options.t_en: I would support the full ban. A lion pacing a trailer is not a performance, it is a signal; six hundred jobs in one industry should not rest on a record where a third of the animals are already breaking down.

options.t: 我会保留行业但提高福利标准：活动面积、退役安置、年度独立检查，不达标即吊销许可。让达标的马戏团活下来，比让整个行业消失更可行。
options.t_en: I would keep the industry but raise welfare standards: space, retirement placement, annual independent inspection, license revoked for failure. Letting compliant circuses survive is more workable than making the whole trade vanish.

options.t: 我会批准逐步退出：三年缓冲期，财政补贴马戏团转杂技与哑剧，动物移交保护区。方向不让步，但给靠它吃饭的人一条下坡路而不是悬崖。
options.t_en: I would approve a phase-out: a three-year buffer, state subsidies to shift circuses toward acrobatics and mime, animals transferred to sanctuaries. The direction stands, but give those who live off it a slope instead of a cliff.

options.t: 我会让各市自决。九家马戏团分布在旅游县和小城，那里的就业结构和大城市完全不同，一刀切的禁令对它们是另一种成本。
options.t_en: I would let each municipality decide. The nine circuses sit in tourist counties and small towns whose job structures look nothing like the capital; a blanket ban prices them differently.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 市艺术基金评审会给一件获推荐的作品犹豫了：它以本市三十年前的一起公开悲剧为素材，手法包含遇害者亲属的采访影像，两位委员认为「公共资金不应加深城市伤疤」，评审流程因此停了两周。
scene_en: The city arts-fund jury has stalled over a recommended work: built on a public tragedy from thirty years ago, it incorporates interview footage of victims’ relatives. Two jurors argue “public money should not reopen the city’s wounds,” and the process has been frozen for two weeks.

options.t: 我会拨款。三十年前的悲剧被拍出来，是因为它还没有被这座城市消化；艺术家的作品迟到的三十年，比两位委员的不适更值得在意。
options.t_en: I would fund it. A tragedy from thirty years ago is being filmed because the city has not yet digested it; the artist’s work arriving thirty years late matters more than two jurors’ discomfort.

options.t: 我会暂缓拨款，先把方案交遇害者亲属征询。公共资金可以支持争议，但不该在当事人还在世时替他们决定伤痛的展出方式。
options.t_en: I would pause the grant and first consult the victims’ relatives. Public money may support controversy, but it should not decide for the living how their grief is exhibited.

options.t: 我会维持同行评审结论，行政不介入艺术判断。评审会有七个人投了票，让两个反对意见推翻流程，基金从此就在评审每一次。
options.t_en: I would uphold the peer-review verdict; the administration should not step into artistic judgment. Seven jurors already voted; letting two objections override the process means re-judging every grant from now on.

options.t: 我会拨款，但附展陈条件：独立展厅、入口设内容提示、提供心理辅导资源。作品值得被看见，走进去的人也应该被提前告知。
options.t_en: I would fund it with display conditions: a separate gallery, a content notice at the entrance, counseling resources available. The work deserves to be seen, and those who walk in deserve to be told first.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 市教育局调研发现：U10 足球联赛取消计分排名两年后，参赛率上升 18%，但十二岁以上的球员基本功和比赛阅读能力低于邻近保留计分的城市。各俱乐部意见分裂。
scene_en: An education-bureau survey finds that two years after scoring and standings were removed from U10 leagues, participation rose 18%, but players over twelve show weaker fundamentals and game-reading than peers in neighboring cities that kept scoring. Clubs are split.

options.t: 我会恢复计分。童年可以没有排名，竞技体育不能；十二岁才第一次学会输球的孩子，输不起的概率比谁都高。
options.t_en: I would restore scoring. Childhood can go without rankings, competitive sport cannot; a child who first learns to lose at twelve is the least equipped to lose well.

options.t: 我会维持不计分到 U12。18% 的参赛率是真的孩子走进球场，基本功的差距可以后来补，退出运动的孩子补不回来。
options.t_en: I would keep no-scoring through U12. That 18% is real children walking onto a pitch; skill gaps can be patched later, but a kid who quit the sport cannot be patched back.

options.t: 我会分龄处理：U10 不计分，U12 起恢复完整联赛制。参与和竞争不是对立项，它们只是适合的年龄不一样。
options.t_en: I would split by age: no scoring at U10, full league play from U12. Participation and competition are not opposites; they simply belong to different ages.

options.t: 我会把规则交还给俱乐部和联赛自定。体育局连每周末有多少孩子上场都统计不全，更不该替他们决定输赢重不重要。
options.t_en: I would return the rule to clubs and leagues. The sports bureau cannot even count how many kids play each weekend; it has no business deciding for them whether winning matters.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你市 60 岁以上人口占 23%，现有养老院床位缺口一万二千张，同时 78% 的老人问卷表示想留在自己家。民政局的年度预算只够押注一个方向。
scene_en: In your city, 23% of residents are over sixty, nursing-home beds run 12,000 short, yet 78% of surveyed seniors say they want to stay in their own homes. The civil-affairs budget can back only one direction.

options.t: 我会补贴居家养老：按失能等级发放上门护理时数。78% 的意愿本身就是政策答案，把床搬到老人家里，比把老人搬到床上便宜，也更像他们想要的生活。
options.t_en: I would subsidize home care: in-home nursing hours tiered by disability level. The 78% is itself the policy answer; moving the bed into the elder’s home is cheaper than moving the elder into a bed, and closer to the life they asked for.

options.t: 我会扩建公立养老院。意愿归意愿，独居老人的夜间跌倒和失能照护不会因为问卷说想在家就消失，专业床位缺口是硬数字。
options.t_en: I would expand public nursing homes. Wishes aside, nighttime falls and disability care for elders living alone do not vanish because a survey said they prefer home; the bed gap is a hard number.

options.t: 我会发现金津贴，让家庭自己雇人、买服务。每个家庭的养老安排不一样，政府补钱不补模式，是把判断权还给最了解老人的人。
