options.t_en: I would pay a cash allowance and let families hire help and buy services themselves. Every family’s care arrangement differs; funding without prescribing is returning the judgment to whoever knows the elder best.

options.t: 我会推开强制长期护理保险，用社会保险的资金池同时供养居家服务和机构床位。缺的不是方向，是一个能同时付两种账单的钱袋。
options.t_en: I would introduce mandatory long-term-care insurance, a social-insurance pool that funds both home services and institutional beds. What is missing is not a direction but a purse big enough to pay both kinds of bills.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 先享后付在你国三年铺开：用户超两亿，逾期率 12%，其中 18-24 岁用户平均同时使用 2.7 个平台。央行提出四个监管方向，平台联名反对任何接入征信的方案。
scene_en: Buy-now-pay-later has spread across your country in three years: 200 million users, a 12% delinquency rate, and users aged 18-24 juggling 2.7 platforms on average. The central bank proposes four regulatory directions, and the platforms jointly oppose any credit-bureau linkage.

options.t: 我会把它纳入信贷监管并接入征信。2.7 个平台的同时负债，在现行规则里对每一家都是隐形的，看不见的债务才是滚大的债务。
options.t_en: I would bring it under credit regulation and link it to the credit bureau. Debt spread across 2.7 platforms is invisible to each one under current rules, and invisible debt is the kind that compounds.

options.t: 我会要求行业自律：费用与逾期规则充分披露，平台自建共享黑名单。两亿用户的市场刚长出来，先让规则长在行业里，别急着移植银行的。
options.t_en: I would mandate industry self-regulation: full disclosure of fees and delinquency rules, plus a shared industry blacklist. A 200-million-user market is young; let the rules grow in the trade before transplanting the banks’.

options.t: 我会设硬限制：单笔上限、平台总数上限，未成年人账户直接禁止。对刚开始挣钱的人，保护比教育来得及时。
options.t_en: I would set hard caps: a per-purchase ceiling, a cap on platforms per user, and an outright ban on minors’ accounts. For people who just started earning, protection arrives sooner than financial education.

options.t: 我会把预算投进中学金融素养课程，监管保持现状。年轻人不是不懂风险，是没人教过他们算复利；教育比门槛更有长期回报。
options.t_en: I would put the budget into secondary-school financial-literacy courses and leave regulation as is. Young people are not oblivious to risk; nobody taught them compound interest. Education pays longer than a gate.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 你国要替换一座退役燃煤电厂的 2000 兆瓦容量。电网公司测算：新建核电可基荷运行但工期十二年、造价超支史频繁；风光加储能可三年建成，但冬季低出力时段需要燃气兜底。
scene_en: Your country must replace 2,000 MW from a retiring coal plant. Grid modeling shows new nuclear can run baseload but takes twelve years with a history of cost overruns; wind-solar-plus-storage builds in three years but needs gas backup during winter lulls.

options.t: 我会建核电。十二年等得起，因为燃煤电厂再跑十二年也是跑，而基荷电力一旦建成就运行六十年；储能至今没给出能过冬的答案。
options.t_en: I would build nuclear. Twelve years is affordable because the coal plant has twelve more in it anyway, and baseload once built runs for sixty; storage still has no answer for winter.

options.t: 我会建风光加储能。三年建成意味着三年减排，核电的清洁要等到第十二年才兑现，而气候变化不等人排完队。
options.t_en: I would build wind, solar and storage. Three years to build means three years of cuts; nuclear’s cleanliness only cashes out in year twelve, and the climate does not wait in line.

options.t: 我会按成本招标，不预设技术路线。政策的任务是最低成本的可靠电力，不是替技术路线站队；谁便宜谁上，核电风光燃气一视同仁。
options.t_en: I would run a technology-neutral auction. The policy job is reliable power at lowest cost, not picking a team; whoever is cheapest wins, with nuclear, renewables and gas judged alike.

options.t: 我会建燃气机组过渡，同步启动风光规划。它不是终点，但能在三年内顶上，为储能成本再降十年留出时间。
options.t_en: I would build gas as a bridge while starting the renewables plan in parallel. It is not the destination, but it covers the gap in three years and buys storage a decade of falling costs.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 你所在的河谷镇七年内被淹四次，气象模型显示五十年一遇洪水已变成十二年一遇。州政府方案：按灾前市价回购高风险地段三百户并退让为泄洪区；镇政府担心税基和人口流失。
scene_en: Your river town has flooded four times in seven years, and climate models show the once-in-50-year flood is now a once-in-12-year event. The state proposes buying out 300 households in the high-risk zone at pre-flood market value and returning the land to the floodplain; the town fears losing its tax base and people.

options.t: 我会推进强制回购。第四次洪水证明了概率，不是运气；留下来的人每一次都是新的受灾户，早搬一年少一年风险。
options.t_en: I would push the buyout through. Four floods in seven years is a pattern, not luck; whoever stays is a new disaster victim every time, and every year earlier out is a year of risk removed.

options.t: 我会改成自愿回购，并让洪水保险费率如实反映风险。有人愿意用便宜的房价换风险，那是他的账；政府该做的是把账算给他看。
options.t_en: I would make the buyout voluntary and let flood-insurance premiums honestly track the risk. Someone may trade cheap housing for risk, and that is his ledger; the government’s job is to show him the math.

options.t: 我会投资堤防加高和泵站升级，让镇子留在原地。三百户是一个镇的学校、教会和商业街，搬迁一个镇不是补偿能算平的账。
options.t_en: I would fund higher levees and upgraded pumping stations to keep the town in place. Three hundred households are a school, a church and a main street; you do not balance relocating a town with compensation math.

options.t: 我会只建预警系统，土地问题交给居民自己决定。第四次洪水没搬的人已经用行动表过态，政府该补的是警报的十分钟，不是替三百户搬家。
options.t_en: I would only build the early-warning system and leave the land question to residents. The people still there after four floods have already voted with their feet; what they need is ten more minutes of siren, not a moving company.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 你国青少年日均手游时长 94 分钟，近视率与睡眠不足数据连年上升。监管草案四个方向：强制 22 点后禁玩、强制家长端工具、要求平台去除成瘾性设计、仅对 12 岁以下限制。
scene_en: Teens in your country average 94 minutes of mobile gaming a day, and myopia and sleep-deprivation figures rise yearly. The draft regulation offers four directions: a mandatory post-10pm ban, mandatory parental-control tools, a requirement to strip addictive design, or limits only under age 12.

options.t: 我会强制 22 点后禁玩，由平台实名执行。青少年自控力是生理事实不是态度问题，作息这条线就该由系统划，而不是由每晚的家庭谈判划。
options.t_en: I would mandate the post-10pm ban, enforced by platforms with real-name verification. Adolescent self-control is physiology, not attitude; the bedtime line should be drawn by the system, not renegotiated in every household every night.

options.t: 我会强制家长端工具，规则由每个家庭自设。同样的 94 分钟，对不同家庭意义完全不同；国家替千万家庭定宵禁，一定定错大部分。
options.t_en: I would mandate parental-control tools and let each family set its own rules. The same 94 minutes means something different in every household; a national curfew will be wrong for most of them.

options.t: 我会要求平台去除成瘾性设计：取消每日签到、限时奖励和连胜机制。问题从来不是孩子意志薄弱，是几百人的团队在专职设计让他停不下来。
options.t_en: I would require platforms to strip addictive design: no daily check-ins, no timed rewards, no streak mechanics. The problem was never weak willpower in children; it is a team of hundreds employed to make stopping hard.

options.t: 我会只限制 12 岁以下，青少年交给家庭和学校管。一刀切的全国宵禁管住了最不需要管的人，也把真正能协商的家庭一起没收了协商权。
options.t_en: I would restrict only under-12s and leave teens to families and schools. A blanket national curfew binds the people who least need binding and confiscates the negotiating power of families who can handle it.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 你国公共广播下属的少数语言电视频道年观众量连降，人均收视成本已是主频道的 11 倍，董事会提议并入主频道设每日时段；该语言使用社区三万人集会反对，称频道是他们仅存的国家级媒体存在。
scene_en: A minority-language TV channel under your public broadcaster has seen viewership fall for years; its cost per viewer hour is eleven times the main channel’s, and the board proposes folding it into a daily slot on the main channel. The language community — 30,000 people — rallied against it, calling the channel their last national-level media presence.

options.t: 我会维持独立频道并保住预算。频道的人均成本高，是因为社区小，而小正是它存在的理由；并进主频道的时段，就是把它变成栏目组。
options.t_en: I would keep the channel independent and protect its budget. Its cost per viewer is high because the community is small, and small is the reason it exists; a daily slot inside the main channel is a slow downgrade to a desk.

options.t: 我会批准并入。11 倍的成本买的是绝大多数年份无人收看的内容，把这笔钱变成主频道的字幕和多语新闻条，服务面反而更大。
options.t_en: I would approve the merger. Eleven times the cost buys content most years nobody watches; converting the money into subtitles and multilingual tickers on the main channel serves more people for less.

options.t: 我会折中：独立频道保留新闻与儿童节目，其余内容并入主频道。语言存续靠的是孩子和突发事件，动画和灾难预报不该是省钱的第一刀。
options.t_en: I would compromise: keep news and children’s programming on the independent channel, merge the rest. A language survives through its children and its emergencies; cartoons and disaster alerts should not be the first cut.

options.t: 我会推动频道转型互联网平台，把电视预算转成流媒体与短视频团队。三万观众里的年轻人在手机上，不在电视机前，保住频道的形式不等于保住语言。
options.t_en: I would push the channel online, converting the TV budget into a streaming and short-video team. The young people among those 30,000 viewers are on phones, not television; preserving the channel’s form is not the same as preserving the language.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 小区有一块两百平米的闲置绿地，业主群为此吵了三个月：有车业主联名要求改划十二个停车位，另一批住户提交了社区花园方案，物业测算两种方案维护成本相近。
scene_en: Your residential compound has an idle 200-square-meter green patch, and the owners' group has argued for three months: car owners have petitioned for twelve parking spaces, while other households submitted a community-garden plan; property management estimates the upkeep costs are similar.

options.t: 我会改停车位。小区夜间违停堵消防通道是每周都在发生的事，花园种得再好看，挡不住救护车进不来。
options.t_en: I would pave the parking. Nightly illegal parking blocking fire lanes is a weekly fact here; no garden, however pretty, keeps an ambulance from getting through.

options.t: 我会建社区花园。这块地是全小区孩子的活动半径，十二个车位服务十二户，花园服务一百户，而且没有第二个两百平米了。
options.t_en: I would build the garden. This patch is within every child’s range in the compound; twelve spots serve twelve households, the garden serves a hundred, and there is no second 200 square meters.

options.t: 我会一半一半：临侧划六个车位，其余做花园，一年后按实际使用率调整。吵了三个月的两派都没错，只是都没被测量过。
options.t_en: I would split it: six parking spots along one side, garden on the rest, adjusted after a year by actual usage. After three months of arguing, neither side is wrong — just unmeasured.

options.t: 我会只让紧邻那栋楼的住户投票。花园的蚊子、车位的尾气，受影响的都是贴着这块地的人，远处的业主不该替他们做决定。
options.t_en: I would put it to a vote of the adjacent building only. The garden’s mosquitoes and the parking’s exhaust fall on the households touching this plot; owners elsewhere should not decide for them.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 你国四家企业的四天工作制试点满一年：产出持平，离职率下降 22%，客户投诉上升 8%。工会联盟推动立法全面推广，雇主协会要求保持自愿。
scene_en: A one-year four-day-workweek pilot across four companies in your country ended with output flat, attrition down 22%, and customer complaints up 8%. The union federation is pushing legislation to expand it nationally; the employers' association wants it voluntary.

options.t: 我会立法推广。产出持平说明这五分之一的工时本来就被磨掉了，离职率降两成是真金白银的招聘成本省了下来。
options.t_en: I would legislate the rollout. Flat output means that fifth of the hours was being ground away anyway, and a 22% drop in attrition is recruiting costs saved in real money.

options.t: 我会保持自愿。四家企业的样本决定不了千万家公司的排班，四天制在客户密集的行业就是另一笔账，立法一刀切会把弹性也切掉。
options.t_en: I would keep it voluntary. Four companies cannot set the schedule for thousands of firms; in client-heavy industries four days is a different ledger, and a blanket law cuts away flexibility along with hours.

options.t: 我会按行业集体谈判推进，立法只定框架。矿山和广告公司的四天不是同一种四天，让离排班最近的人谈出各自的版本。
options.t_en: I would advance it through sector-level collective bargaining, with legislation setting only the frame. Four days in a mine and four days in an ad agency are not the same four days; let those closest to the schedule negotiate their versions.

options.t: 我会不干预工时安排。想四天的人换四天的岗位，想五天钱的人留着五天的岗位，劳动力市场自己会分岔，不需要法律替所有人选一条。
options.t_en: I would leave working hours alone. People who want four days take four-day jobs, people who want five days of pay keep five-day jobs, and the labor market forks on its own — no statute needed to pick a lane for everyone.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 你所在的大学在上学期因两场访客演讲各爆发一次抗议，一次被迫改线上，一次临时取消。校务会讨论是否建立事前审查：外请讲者需提前提交提纲，由跨部门小组评估。
scene_en: Your university saw protests at two guest lectures last semester — one forced online, one cancelled on short notice. The university council is debating prior review: external speakers would submit outlines in advance for assessment by a cross-departmental panel.

options.t: 我会反对事前审查。大学存在的理由是让没被听过的说法有机会被听，把提纲先交给委员会审一遍，审掉的是大学本身。
options.t_en: I would oppose prior review. The reason a university exists is to let unheard arguments get heard; submitting outlines to a committee first is a review of the university itself.

options.t: 我会支持安全评估前置。两次失控的现场已经证明自由讨论需要场地还能开放作前提，评估针对的是秩序风险，不是观点。
options.t_en: I would support the security screening. Two chaotic events proved that open discussion presumes a venue still standing; the assessment targets order risks, not viewpoints.

options.t: 我会把决定权交给学生委员会：每场外请讲者由学生代表投票通过。来听课的是学生，被代表的不该是保卫处。
options.t_en: I would hand the decision to a student council: each external speaker approved by a vote of student representatives. The audience is the students; the ones speaking for them should not be campus security.

options.t: 我会分场地管理：公开大课维持开放，封闭研讨室允许争议性讲者。抗议的自由和听讲的自由各得其所，不用任何一方全赢。
options.t_en: I would manage by venue: open lectures stay open, closed seminar rooms host contested speakers. The freedom to protest and the freedom to listen each get a room, and neither side has to win everything.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 你国遗产税最高档 40%，起征点十年未动，房价上涨让中产家庭开始触及起征线。财政部提出四个调整方向，房产中介协会的游说预算创了纪录。
scene_en: Your country's top inheritance-tax rate is 40%, the threshold has not moved in a decade, and rising home prices are pulling middle-class estates across it. The finance ministry has four adjustment options on the table, and realtors' lobbying budgets just hit a record.

options.t: 我会提高累进档距。代际传递的财富是基尼系数里最硬的一块，躺着继承的税负不该比加班挣来的轻。
options.t_en: I would raise the top brackets. Inherited wealth is the hardest chunk in the Gini coefficient; money received lying down should not be taxed lighter than money earned at a desk.

options.t: 我会废除遗产税。一笔资产在一生里已被征过至少一次税，死亡不应触发第二次；家庭内部传递是最诚实的资本配置。
options.t_en: I would abolish the inheritance tax. An estate has already been taxed at least once during a lifetime; death should not trigger a second pass, and transfer within a family is the most honest allocation of capital there is.

options.t: 我会把起征点指数化，税率维持。政策当年瞄准的是金字塔尖，不是被房价推上来的中产；随通胀调整是把门槛放回原位，不是减税。
options.t_en: I would index the threshold and keep rates as they are. The policy was aimed at the pyramid’s tip, not at the middle class pushed up by housing prices; inflation-indexing restores the original gate, it is not a tax cut.

options.t: 我会设教育捐赠抵扣：应税遗产捐给公立教育可全额抵扣。让每一笔大额遗产在税单和课桌之间做选择，比单纯收走更有效率。
options.t_en: I would add a charitable deduction for public education: estates may deduct gifts to public schools in full. Letting every large estate choose between the tax bill and the classroom raises more than collection alone.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你国锂矿产量占全球 19%，议会讨论出口限制：支持者引用稀土国家的前例，称原矿出口换不来议价权；矿业公司警告限制将促使买家在他国另建供应链，五年后订单不可逆。
scene_en: Your country supplies 19% of world lithium output, and parliament is debating export restrictions: supporters cite the rare-earths precedent, saying raw-ore exports never bought bargaining power; mining firms warn buyers will build rival supply chains abroad, and orders after five years will not come back.

options.t: 我会限制原矿出口，只许出口加工品。19% 的份额是谈判桌上唯一真筹码，稀土国家的前例证明它换得回定价权，也证明只用一次最有效。
options.t_en: I would restrict raw-ore exports, permitting processed goods only. That 19% is the only real chip at the table; the rare-earths precedent shows it can buy pricing power — and that it works best spent once.

options.t: 我会保持自由出口。供应链的忠诚以年计，不忠诚以五年计；买家另建一条链是给对手国送礼，筹码攥太紧会自己贬值。
options.t_en: I would keep exports free. Supply-chain loyalty counts in years, and disloyalty in five; pushing buyers to build a rival chain is a gift to competitor states, and a chip clutched too tight devalues on its own.

options.t: 我会设出口配额并与伙伴国签长期协议：份额换下游建厂。既不像禁运那样逼走客户，也不像现在这样把加工增值白白留在境外。
options.t_en: I would set export quotas paired with long-term partner agreements: market share in exchange for downstream plants. It neither drives customers away like an embargo, nor leaves the value-added abroad as we do now.

options.t: 我会把预算投进锂回收和替代技术，而不是管出口。五年后电池回收的锂就是一座新矿山，管住出口管不住化学。
options.t_en: I would put the budget into lithium recycling and alternative chemistries instead of export controls. In five years recycled lithium is a new mine, and export rules cannot legislate chemistry.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 你所在的流域有六家造纸厂，下游渔业合作社记录鱼获十年减产 40%。环保局提出三案：排污总量管制加许可交易、直接关停排放最高的两家、按吨收费设补偿基金。
scene_en: Your river basin hosts six paper mills, and the downstream fishing cooperative has recorded a 40% decline in catch over ten years. The environment bureau proposes three options: a cap-and-trade permit system, closing the two worst emitters outright, or a per-ton levy funding a compensation fund.

options.t: 我会建排污权交易市场。总量锁死后减得最便宜的厂先减，四十个百分点的鱼获损失由市场用最低成本去还，监管只管总量一条线。
options.t_en: I would set up cap-and-trade. Once the cap is locked, the plants that can abate cheapest abate first; the market repays a 40% catch loss at minimum cost, and regulators police only one line — the total.

options.t: 我会关停排放最高的两家。十年 40% 的减产已经证明协商无效，一家厂的态度不该由整个下游的生计陪葬。
options.t_en: I would close the two worst emitters. Ten years of 40% decline proves negotiation has failed; one plant’s reluctance should not be subsidized by an entire downstream livelihood.

options.t: 我会按吨收费，收入进补偿基金直付渔民。让每吨污水在账本上有个价，把生态损失变成企业每月必须面对的发票。
options.t_en: I would levy per ton, with proceeds paid straight to the fishing cooperative. Put a price on every ton of effluent and turn ecological damage into an invoice the mills face every month.

options.t: 我会促成渔民与纸厂直接谈判赔偿协议，政府只做公证。谁能忍受多大的污染、值多少钱，谈判桌上的答案比任何公式都细。
options.t_en: I would broker direct compensation talks between the cooperative and the mills, with the state only notarizing. How much pollution a fishery can bear, and at what price, is an answer the negotiating table will make finer than any formula.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 你所在中学拟推行手机统一保管：到校入柜、离校领取。家长会分裂成两派，一派引用课堂注意力研究，另一派引用孩子放学后联系安全的需要；学生自治会提交了反对信。
scene_en: Your secondary school plans to lock phones in cabinets during school hours. The parents’ meeting has split — one side cites classroom-attention studies, the other cites after-school safety contact — and the student council has submitted a letter of objection.

options.t: 我会推行全天保管。注意力研究的结论一致到罕见，课堂上的手机不是工具是干扰；放学出校门就还，安全问题不该由上课时间买单。
options.t_en: I would go ahead with all-day storage. The attention research is unusually consistent — a phone in class is a distraction, not a tool; phones return at the school gate, and after-school safety should not be billed to class time.

options.t: 我会反对统一保管，改为开设自主管理课程。收走的是手机，没收掉的是练习自控的最后机会，总有一天他们要在没人收手机的地方生活。
options.t_en: I would oppose uniform storage and offer self-management courses instead. What gets confiscated with the phone is the last chance to practice self-control; one day they will live somewhere nobody collects phones.

options.t: 我会折中：上课时间锁柜，课间与午休开放使用。注意力保护了，联系权留了，两派要的其实都是边界，不是全部。
options.t_en: I would compromise: phones locked during class, open during breaks and lunch. Attention gets protected and contact stays possible; both sides wanted boundaries, not everything.

options.t: 我会把规则交给各班家长会自定。同一所学校里有的孩子通勤一小时需要手机，有的步行五分钟，统一规则注定对一半人错。
options.t_en: I would let each class’s parents’ meeting decide. In one school, some children commute an hour and need the phone while some walk five minutes; a uniform rule is guaranteed wrong for half of them.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 你所在城市小学有 9% 学生的家庭语言不是本地官方语言。市教育局讨论是否开设移民母语选修课：教育学界称母语能力与第二语言学习正相关，财政测算年增支八百万。
scene_en: In your city, 9% of primary students speak a home language other than the official one. The education bureau debates optional heritage-language classes: education research links mother-tongue proficiency to second-language learning, while the finance office counts an extra 8 million a year.

options.t: 我会开设选修课。母语不是障碍是脚手架，第一语言学得扎实的孩子第二语言才学得快，八百万买的是语言学里最便宜的杠杆。
options.t_en: I would offer the classes. The mother tongue is not a barrier but scaffolding; a child grounded in the first language acquires the second faster, and 8 million is the cheapest lever linguistics has to offer.

options.t: 我会把资源集中到官方语言强化，母语交给家庭。学校要保证的是每个孩子离开校门时能在这座城市谋生，八百万花在刀刃上就是语言强化班。
options.t_en: I would concentrate resources on intensive official-language instruction and leave heritage languages to families. What the school owes every child is the ability to earn a living in this city at graduation; the 8 million belongs in the intensive classes.

options.t: 我会用双语公共标识和政务翻译替代课堂。语言存续的主场在街道和市场，不在每周两节的选修课；让公共空间承认这些语言，成本只有课堂的十分之一。
options.t_en: I would use bilingual public signage and government-translation services instead of classrooms. Languages live on streets and in markets, not in two elective periods a week; letting public space recognize them costs a tenth of the classes.

options.t: 我会不设公共投入，由社区自办周末语言班，教育局提供免费场地。社区教自己的语言比教育局教得更用心，政府该做的是不收房租。
options.t_en: I would put in no public funding and let communities run weekend language classes, with the bureau providing free venues. A community teaches its own language with more devotion than any bureau; the state’s job is waiving the rent.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 外卖平台拟为二十万骑手强制加装 AI 行车记录仪：疲劳与分心驾驶实时提醒，试点城市事故率降 17%。骑手社群的反应是：摄像头对着人脸，休息时也不关。
scene_en: A delivery platform plans mandatory AI dashcams for 200,000 riders: real-time fatigue and distraction alerts cut accidents 17% in pilot cities. The rider community’s response: the camera points at their faces, and it does not switch off during breaks.

options.t: 我会支持全面安装。事故率降 17% 是救回来的骑车人，疲劳提醒和闹钟一样，越不喜欢它的时刻越是需要它。
options.t_en: I would support full installation. A 17% drop in accidents is riders who made it home; a fatigue alert is like an alarm clock — the moment you resent it most is when you need it most.

options.t: 我会立法禁止对驾驶者本人的人脸持续采集。降事故可以靠方向盘传感器和车速数据，不需要一份能被回放的脸部视频档案。
options.t_en: I would legislate against continuous facial capture of the rider. Accident prevention can run on handlebar sensors and speed data; it does not need a replayable archive of faces.

options.t: 我会批准，但限定只记录驾驶行为数据、不拍人脸，数据由独立第三方保存，平台无权直接调取。安全要，但安全不该附带一份随时可查的私生活。
options.t_en: I would approve with limits: driving-behavior data only, no face capture, storage held by an independent third party the platform cannot query directly. Safety yes — but not safety bundled with a searchable record of private life.

options.t: 我会让工会和平台集体谈判决定装不装、怎么装。二十万骑手的工作条件该由二十万骑手的代表签字，而不是由监管替他们慷慨。
options.t_en: I would leave it to collective bargaining between the riders’ union and the platform. Working conditions for 200,000 riders should be signed by their representatives, not generously decided on their behalf by a regulator.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 你国抑郁障碍就诊率 9.5%，心理咨询市场均价 400 元/次，医保目录未纳入。卫健委测算全面纳入年增支约 60 亿，同时担心供给端跟不上导致质量滑坡。
scene_en: In your country only 9.5% of people with depressive disorders seek treatment, private counseling averages 400 per session, and none of it is covered by national insurance. The health commission estimates full coverage at 6 billion a year and worries supply cannot keep pace without quality collapsing.

options.t: 我会全面纳入医保。400 块一次的心理咨询是一道筛子，筛掉的恰恰是最没钱也最需要的人；就诊率 9.5% 不是不想去，是去不起。
options.t_en: I would cover it fully. A 400-per-session fee is a sieve that keeps out exactly those with the least money and the most need; a 9.5% treatment rate is not reluctance, it is unaffordability.

options.t: 我会保持市场自费。治疗关系的高度依赖从业者质量，补贴涌入会把供给端变成批发证书；让价格筛选出的市场先长大。
options.t_en: I would keep it market-funded. The therapy relationship depends on practitioner quality, and a flood of reimbursement turns the supply side into a diploma mill; let the price-sorted market mature first.

options.t: 我会有限纳入：重性抑郁与双向障碍报销，限每年二十次。把最重的病人先接进保障网，等供给端长起来再扩围。
options.t_en: I would cover it partially: major depression and bipolar disorder, capped at twenty sessions a year. Bring the most severe patients inside the safety net first; widen it as the supply side grows.

options.t: 我会大规模培训非临床辅导员，成本是临床心理师的十分之一，医保只报销辅导员服务。多数求助者需要的是被倾听，不是诊断。
options.t_en: I would train lay counselors at a tenth of the cost of clinicians and reimburse only their services. Most people seeking help need to be heard, not diagnosed.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 你所在的省级游泳联赛收到一名跨性别女性运动员的注册申请，成绩处于女子组中游。联赛章程未作规定，各俱乐部教练分裂成三派，联赛委员会必须在赛季前定规则。
scene_en: Your provincial swimming league has received a registration from a transgender woman whose times sit mid-pack in the women’s field. The rulebook is silent; coaches are split three ways, and the committee must set a rule before the season.

options.t: 我会按出生登记性别分组。女子组存在的起点是生理差异，章程沉默不等于边界不存在，先把原有的线画清楚。
options.t_en: I would keep categories by sex registered at birth. The women’s field exists because of physical difference; a silent rulebook does not mean the boundary is not there, so draw the existing line clearly first.

options.t: 我会按可测量的生理指标（如睾酮水平与成年身高）设资格线，而不是按身份文件。让规则跟着证据走，两边都不必靠猜。
options.t_en: I would set eligibility by measurable physical criteria — testosterone levels and adult height, say — not identity documents. Let the rule follow evidence, so neither side has to guess.

options.t: 我会把决定权交给各单项俱乐部联盟自定。游泳和棋类的身体相关性差着量级，一条规则管所有项目，注定对一半项目不公平。
options.t_en: I would devolve the decision to each sport’s club federation. Swimming and chess differ by orders of magnitude in physical relevance; one rule for every sport is guaranteed unfair to half of them.

options.t: 我会增设公开组，现有组别不动。让所有运动员都有赛道可比，把这场争论从互斥改成并列。
options.t_en: I would add an open category and leave existing ones untouched. Give every athlete a lane to race in, and turn the argument from either-or into side-by-side.

options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。
options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.

scene: 你国的生成式 AI 公司被两万名作者和插画师起诉：模型在未授权情况下用了他们的作品训练。法院请立法机关表态，四条路径都在桌上。
scene_en: Generative-AI companies in your country are being sued by 20,000 authors and illustrators: their work trained the models without license. The courts have asked the legislature to weigh in, and four paths are on the table.

options.t: 我会要求事前授权并支付版税。训练集是几百万人的劳动垒起来的，模型值几十亿而作者收不到一分钱，这不是创新，是搬运。
options.t_en: I would require prior licensing with royalties. The training corpus is stacked from millions of people’s labor; a model worth billions paying its sources nothing is not innovation, it is moving goods.

options.t: 我会确认合理使用豁免。学习的概念不该对机器和人类执行双重标准，作者学大师的作品不付版税，机器学公开作品也不该付。
options.t_en: I would confirm fair-use exemption. Learning should not run on a double standard for machines and people; a human studies the masters without royalties, and a machine studying public work should not pay either.

options.t: 我会强制披露训练数据来源清单，权属争议个案诉讼。阳光先照进来，该赔谁、赔多少，让每一条数据在法庭上自己排队。
options.t_en: I would mandate disclosure of training-data sources and settle ownership case by case. Let the light in first; who gets paid and how much, each datum can queue up in court on its own.

options.t: 我会立法支持作者集体与平台谈判许可费率。两万个单独的作者斗不过一家模型公司，两万个作者加起来是一张谈判桌。
options.t_en: I would legislate support for collective bargaining between authors’ bodies and platforms over license rates. Twenty thousand individual authors cannot outspend one model company; twenty thousand authors together are a table.

options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。
options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.

scene: 你国看守所在押人员中 41% 是未判决的审前羁押，其中六成因交不出保释金，平均关押 187 天后获释且最终多数轻判或无罪。司法改革方案四个方向。
scene_en: In your country, 41% of detention-center inmates are awaiting trial, six in ten held only because they could not post bail, averaging 187 days before release, with most eventually lightly sentenced or acquitted. Four reform directions are on the table.

options.t: 我会用风险评估工具替代现金保释。187 天的关押是对未定罪者事实上的服刑，钱不该是自由的汇率。
options.t_en: I would replace cash bail with risk-assessment tools. Those 187 days are de facto sentences served by the unconvicted, and money should not be the exchange rate for freedom.

options.t: 我会推定释放，辅以电子脚环与到案义务。羁押的目的从来只有到庭，脚环能保证到庭，高墙保证不了无罪。
options.t_en: I would adopt presumptive release with electronic monitoring and appearance obligations. Pretrial detention exists only to ensure attendance; an ankle tag guarantees attendance, and a wall guarantees nothing about innocence.

options.t: 我会保留保释但按收入定价。保释金翻十倍对富人是零点一个点，对穷人是自由，按收入定比例才是把同一条门槛还给所有人。
options.t_en: I would keep bail but scale it to income. Ten times the bail is a rounding error to the rich and freedom to the poor; pricing it as a share of income hands everyone the same threshold.

options.t: 我会扩建快速审判通道，把审前流程压到六十天内。不用在保释和羁押之间选，只要审判快到不构成惩罚，问题就消失了。
options.t_en: I would build fast-track courts to compress pretrial process to sixty days. Skip the choice between bail and detention: make trial fast enough that detention stops functioning as punishment, and the problem dissolves.

options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。
options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.

scene: 你市一座 1680 年建成的教堂被列入建筑遗产名录，屋顶漏雨两年，教区自筹只够三成修缮费。市议会讨论公共资金介入，政教分离条款写得明白。
scene_en: A church built in 1680 in your city is on the heritage list; its roof has leaked for two years and the parish has raised only a third of the repair cost. The city council debates public funding, with the disestablishment clause written in plain text.

options.t: 我会拨款修缮。1680 年的屋顶属于这座城市，不属于任何一个教派，出钱的是建筑遗产，住进去的才是信仰。
options.t_en: I would fund the repair. A 1680 roof belongs to the city, not to any denomination; the money pays for heritage, and only the congregation lives in the faith.

options.t: 我会拒绝拨款。政教分离写得明白，出三成修缮费的教区找得出另外七成；公共资金一旦开了这个口子，清真寺和庙宇的申请书明天就到。
options.t_en: I would refuse funding. Disestablishment is written in plain text; a parish that raised a third can raise the rest, and once the public purse opens, the mosque’s and the temple’s applications arrive tomorrow.

options.t: 我会设立面向所有信仰建筑的遗产基金，教堂按评审排位申请。让规则平等地覆盖钟楼、穹顶和飞檐，而不是为一个案例临时立法。
options.t_en: I would create a heritage fund open to buildings of every faith, with churches applying by review ranking. Let the rules cover steeples, domes and eaves equally, rather than legislating for one case at a time.

options.t: 我会推动教区把建筑出售或长租给文化遗产基金会，改作音乐厅使用，外观与修缮义务随契约走。信仰留得住，屋顶有人修，两头都不欠。
options.t_en: I would broker a sale or long lease to a heritage trust with the building converted to a concert hall, facade and repair obligations written into the contract. The faith keeps its congregation, the roof gets a patron, and neither owes the other.

options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。
options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.

scene: 你市 4.2 万套住宅转为全年短租，同期长租空置率降到 0.8%，租金三年涨 34%。市议会讨论限制方案，旅游业协会提交了短租带动的就业与消费数据。
scene_en: In your city, 42,000 homes have converted to year-round short-term rentals while the long-term vacancy rate fell to 0.8% and rents rose 34% in three years. The council is weighing limits, and the tourism association has submitted data on short-rental employment and spending.

options.t: 我会限制短租天数上限，比如每年九十天，超出的强制转回长租。房子的第一功能是住人，游客经济不该由长租客的 34% 来付款。
options.t_en: I would cap short-term rental nights — say ninety a year — forcing the excess back to long-term leases. Housing’s first function is housing people, and the tourist economy should not be paid for by tenants’ 34%.

options.t: 我会用差别化房产税替代禁令：短租房产税率调到与租金收益挂钩。让价格信号决定一套房是租给游客还是租给住户，政府管税率，不管房门。
options.t_en: I would replace bans with differentiated property tax tied to rental yields. Let the price signal decide whether a home goes to tourists or residents; the state sets the rate, not the door.

options.t: 我会完全放开。0.8% 的空置率说明长租供给真缺，但缺的原因是建得少不是租得多，把游客房逼回市场解决不了土地审批。
options.t_en: I would leave it fully open. A 0.8% vacancy rate shows real long-term scarcity, but scarcity comes from underbuilding, not over-renting; pushing tourist homes back onto the market does not fix land permits.

options.t: 我会由市属平台统一经营短租牌照，收益投入保障房建设。游客经济要继续，但它产生的租金收益该回流到缺房的那一头。
options.t_en: I would have a municipal platform run short-rental licensing, with proceeds invested in social housing. Keep the tourist economy, but route its rental income back to the side that lacks homes.

options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。
options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.

scene: 你国食品系统贡献了 26% 的温室气体排放。消费品委员会讨论是否强制碳标签：零售商称货架放不下，农业团体称测算方法未统一，消费者组织的调查显示 61% 的人看不懂碳足迹数字。
scene_en: Food systems account for 26% of your country's greenhouse emissions. The consumer-goods commission debates mandatory carbon labels: retailers say shelf space is tight, farm groups say measurement methods are unsettled, and a consumer survey shows 61% cannot interpret a carbon-footprint figure.

options.t: 我会强制碳标签，统一测算方法由国家标准局定。26% 的排放不该继续隐形，看不懂可以教，看不见永远学不会。
options.t_en: I would mandate carbon labels, with a single methodology set by the national standards body. A 26% share of emissions should not stay invisible; illiteracy can be taught away, invisibility never.

options.t: 我会走自愿标签加认证溢价。让愿意支付的消费者用货架投票，先跑起来的品牌会带动行业跟上，比一刀切的合规成本更平滑。
options.t_en: I would go with voluntary labels and certified premiums. Let willing consumers vote on the shelf, with early movers pulling the industry along — smoother than a compliance cliff for everyone at once.

options.t: 我会推扫码溯源替代货架标签，包装上只留一个二维码。测量方法的争议放进持续更新的数据库，货架放不下的信息放进手机。
options.t_en: I would replace shelf labels with scan-to-source codes, leaving a single QR on packaging. The methodology disputes live in a database that updates constantly, and what the shelf cannot hold, the phone can.

options.t: 我会跳过标签，直接补贴低碳农户与农法。消费者在收银台前平均决策七秒，靠七秒改变 26% 的排放是浪漫，补贴改变的是耕作方式本身。
options.t_en: I would skip labels and subsidize low-carbon farms and practices directly. Shoppers decide in about seven seconds at the register; changing 26% of emissions in seven seconds is a romance, while subsidies change the farming itself.

options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。
options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.

scene: 你国公共广播机构的收视份额降到 14%，财政每年补贴 9 亿。议会辩论：一份提案削减三成预算，一份提案把经费改为固定税收分成并隔离年度政治审批。
scene_en: Your public broadcaster’s audience share has fallen to 14% on a 900-million annual subsidy. Parliament debates one bill cutting the budget by a third and another converting funding to a fixed tax share, insulated from yearly political approval.

options.t: 我会增加预算并隔离政治审批。商业媒体不做的那 86% 的报道——偏远县、少数语言、灾难演练——靠的就是这笔钱，收视份额从来不是它的 KPI。
options.t_en: I would raise the budget and insulate it from political approval. The 86% of coverage commercial media will not do — remote counties, minority languages, disaster drills — is what this money buys, and audience share was never its KPI.

options.t: 我会削减预算。14% 的份额用 9 亿的补贴买，每个观众小时的成本是商业台的三倍，公共资金该花在市场不提供的地方，而不是大而全。
options.t_en: I would cut the budget. Fourteen percent of audience for 900 million means each viewing hour costs triple the commercial rate; public money belongs where the market provides nothing, not in being everything.

options.t: 我会通过固定税收分成方案。年度审批就是年度人质，编辑独立性不该每隔十二个月重新乞讨一次。
options.t_en: I would pass the fixed tax-share plan. An annual budget hearing is an annual hostage; editorial independence should not re-beg every twelve months.

options.t: 我会推动转向会员制众筹，财政只保底基础新闻业务。让愿意付费的观众成为股东，比让纳税人供养一份 14% 的人都不看的报纸更诚实。
options.t_en: I would move it to a membership model with state funding only for basic news. Making paying viewers the shareholders is more honest than taxpayers subsidizing a paper 14% of people never watch.

options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。
options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.

scene: 你市引入电子自动执法后，闯红灯率降 44%，但罚单申诉积压八万件，市民普遍反映「机器不开口，申诉如登天」。交通局讨论是否维持全自动开罚。
scene_en: Since your city introduced automated enforcement, red-light running fell 44%, but ticket appeals have backed up 80,000 deep, and residents say the machine never listens and appeals take forever. The transport bureau is debating whether to keep fully automatic ticketing.

options.t: 我会维持全自动开罚，同步上线线上申诉快审通道。降 44% 的闯红灯是真的少死人，申诉排队是效率问题，闯红灯是安全问题，别把两者搅在一起。
options.t_en: I would keep fully automatic ticketing and launch a fast online appeal channel. A 44% drop in red-light running is lives saved; the appeal backlog is an efficiency problem and red-light running a safety one — do not blur the two.

options.t: 我会退回人工执法加现场裁量。同一秒压线有赶救护车的母亲也有赶红灯的轿车，机器只认识线，不认识理由。
options.t_en: I would return to human enforcement with on-the-spot discretion. In the same second, one car crosses on a yellow with a mother in labor and another on a dare; the machine reads the line, never the reason.

options.t: 我会保留电子取证，但任何罚款生效前必须有一名警员复核。机器可以看见违法，让机器单独决定处罚，是把裁量外包给算法。
options.t_en: I would keep electronic evidence but require one officer to confirm before any fine takes effect. The camera may see the violation; letting it decide the penalty alone outsources discretion to an algorithm.

options.t: 我会维持自动执法，并立法把罚款净收入独立注入道路安全基金，杜绝执法创收的嫌疑。系统惹人恨的一半原因不是罚得对不对，是罚来的钱去哪了。
options.t_en: I would keep automated enforcement and legislate that net fine revenue flows into a dedicated road-safety fund, removing the revenue motive. Half of what people hate is not whether the fine was right, but where the money went.

options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。
options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.

scene: 邻国爆发内战，联合国渠道的救援物资仅能覆盖需求的 30%。你国议会辩论援助方案：纯人道通道、军援交战一方、仅经联合国多边渠道，或完全不介入。
scene_en: A neighboring country has collapsed into civil war, and UN-channel aid covers only 30% of needs. Your parliament debates: a purely humanitarian corridor, military aid to one side, multilateral aid through the UN only, or no involvement.

options.t: 我会以人道援助为主，明确不供武器。缺的是面粉和抗生素，画上国旗的援助能让物资过境，画上武器的援助只会让战争多打一年。
options.t_en: I would lead with humanitarian aid and explicitly supply no weapons. What is missing is flour and antibiotics; aid marked with a national flag gets convoys through, aid marked with weapons just buys the war another year.

options.t: 我会军援其中一方。没有安全就没有救援，物资车队在停火线两侧被抢了三批，武装一方才有秩序，有秩序才有援助能落地。
options.t_en: I would arm one side. There is no aid without security; three convoys have already been looted along the ceasefire lines, and order — which aid needs to land — comes only from a stronger party.

options.t: 我会只经联合国多边渠道出资。双边援助无论面粉还是步枪，都会被视为选边；让多边机制记账和执行，钱到了，立场没到。
options.t_en: I would fund only through UN multilateral channels. Bilateral aid — flour or rifles — reads as taking sides; let the multilateral machine do the accounting and delivery, so the money arrives without the alignment.

options.t: 我会不介入。内战的输赢不取决于边境这边的议会投票，而援助物资经手的每一层都有抽成；先把自己的边境和难民登记处准备好。
options.t_en: I would stay out. The war’s outcome will not turn on a vote in our parliament, and every layer handling aid takes its cut; prepare our own border and refugee registration instead.

options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。
options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.

scene: 你国失业金替代率为 45%，领取期十二个月。劳动部数据显示：强制参加培训的领取者再就业率高出 9 个百分点，但其中三成完成的是与原职业无关的短期课程。改革方案四个。
scene_en: Your unemployment benefit replaces 45% of wages for up to twelve months. Labor-department data show mandatory training raises re-employment by nine points, but a third of completions are short courses unrelated to the claimant's former occupation. Four reform options are on the table.

options.t: 我会维持并扩大培训捆绑。九个百分点的再就业率就是九万个重回职场的人，课程是否对口可以优化，捆绑本身不能松。
options.t_en: I would keep and expand the training requirement. Nine points of re-employment is ninety thousand people back at work; course matching can be tuned, but the linkage itself should not loosen.

options.t: 我会取消捆绑，无条件发放。失业的第一个人月该用来找工作而不是坐教室，用断粮威胁人去上不适配的课程，是拿保障当教鞭。
options.t_en: I would scrap the requirement and pay unconditionally. The first month of unemployment should go to job hunting, not a classroom; threatening benefits to fill courses is turning a safety net into a whip.

options.t: 我会改成完成培训有奖金，不参加不扣发。把惩戒换成激励，自选课程的人留下来了，搭便车的人也挑不出制度的毛病。
options.t_en: I would switch to a completion bonus without cutting benefits for non-attendance. Swap the stick for a carrot: the self-selected stay in their seats, and free riders have no rule to hide behind either.

options.t: 我会把培训预算改成再就业服务券，由失业者自购职业介绍与技能服务。政府选课的命中率三成不够看，把钱和选择权一起交回找工作的人。
options.t_en: I would convert the training budget into re-employment vouchers for job-seekers to spend on placement and skills services. A one-in-three hit rate for government-chosen courses is not a record to defend; hand back both the money and the choice.

options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene: 玛雅和丹尼尔恋爱两年后准备结婚。玛雅的父母与她工作的医院同城，平时帮她照应年幼的弟弟；丹尼尔的父母经营着三小时车程外的农场，希望节假日期间全家都回农场团聚。农场附近的房租便宜得多，但玛雅的通勤时间会翻倍，也会失去身边的亲友支持网络。两人坐在餐桌前，笔记本电脑上开着两份租房信息：无论选哪个地址，都会影响以后的节日安排、将来可能的育儿分工，以及与哪边父母走动更多。
scene_en: After two years together, Maya and Daniel are getting married. Maya's parents live in the same city as her hospital job and help look after her younger brother; Daniel's parents run a farm three hours away and expect the whole family to gather there every festival. Rent is much cheaper near the farm, but Maya's commute would double and she would lose her nearby support network. The couple sits at the kitchen table with two rental listings open on the laptop, knowing that whichever address they choose will shape holiday plans, future childcare, and which set of parents they see more often.

options.t_en: We'll rent near my hospital. I'm on call at night and my mother already helps with my brother; having family support within walking distance matters more to me than the cheaper rent out there.
options.t: 我们会在医院附近租房。我要上夜班，母亲平时也在帮着照应弟弟，家人支持就在步行范围内这件事，对我来说比农场那边便宜的房租更重要。

options.t_en: I'd choose the place near Daniel's parents. Housing costs would drop a lot, festivals would be simpler to organize, and his family has repeatedly asked for help during harvest season, which is easier to give if we live closer.
options.t: 我会选丹尼尔父母附近的住处。住房开销会降不少，节日聚会也更好安排，而且他家农忙时一直希望有人搭把手，住得近才方便帮忙。

options.t_en: I want us to live on our own somewhere in between, equidistant from both families. I love our parents, but I don't want either household's routines to become the template for our new home; we can visit on a schedule we set ourselves.
options.t: 我希望我们俩住在折中的地方，与两边父母距离相当。我爱父母，但我不希望任何一家的生活节奏变成我们新家庭的模板，探望可以按我们自己定的时间表来。

options.t_en: Let's rent the cheap place near the farm for the first year and see how it actually feels, instead of deciding from the kitchen table. Commuting, holidays and finances all read differently on paper than in practice.
options.t: 我们先去农场附近租便宜的那处住一年，看看实际感受再定，而不是只坐在餐桌前空想。通勤、节假日和开销这些事，纸面上的账和过起来的体验往往不一样。

options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.
options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。

scene: 河岸片区流浪犬数量成倍增长，两起咬人事件发生后，区议会召开紧急会议。环卫部门提出外包扑杀方案，一周内即可启动；动物福利组织则给出了由本地收容所执行的捕捉-绝育-免疫-放归方案，单只犬的前期投入更高，但能在数年时间里减少新生幼犬数量。居民意见分裂：一些家长希望街道尽快清空流浪犬，另一些居民每天喂食，把狗视为社区的一部分。
scene_en: Stray dogs have multiplied in a riverside district, and after two bite incidents the district council is holding an emergency session. The sanitation department proposes a contracted culling program that can start within a week. Animal welfare groups counter with a catch-neuter-vaccinate-return scheme run through local shelters, which costs more per dog upfront but reduces litters over years. Residents are split: some parents want the streets cleared fast, others feed the dogs daily and see them as neighborhood fixtures.

options.t_en: I'd back the culling contract. Two children have already been treated for bites, and a visible reduction within weeks is what residents are asking the council to deliver right now.
options.t: 我会支持扑杀合同。已经有两名儿童因咬伤就医，居民现在要求议会在几周内看到街面状况的可见改善，这是眼下最直接的回应方式。

options.t_en: I'd fund the neuter-and-return program even if results take two years. Culling every season is a treadmill; reducing the birth rate at the source is what actually ends the cycle, and vaccinating the dogs we keep also protects people.
options.t: 我会为绝育放归方案拨款，哪怕见效要两年。扑杀一季接一季做下去没有尽头，从源头压低出生率才能真正终结这个循环，而且给留存犬只免疫本身也是在保护居民。

options.t_en: Neither program should be my tax money first. I'd push for mandatory pet registration and real fines for abandonment, because the strays exist because owners dumped them; fixing the cause costs the treasury less than managing the symptom.
options.t: 我会先推动强制宠物登记和对遗弃行为的实质罚款，而不是让财政先为方案买单。流浪犬之所以存在，是因为有人遗弃了它们，解决原因比处理后果花钱更少。

options.t_en: I'd organize volunteers and donations instead of waiting for the council. Our feeding group already knows every dog by name; with a small budget and a partner clinic we can sterilize most of them ourselves over the summer.
options.t: 我会组织志愿者和捐款，而不是等议会拨款。我们的喂食小组已经叫得出每只狗的名字，只要一点预算加一家合作诊所，一个夏天就能给大多数狗完成绝育。

options.t_en: I don't feel personally involved in this issue; any of these outcomes would be fine with me.
options.t: 这事我没啥代入感，哪种结果我都能接受。

scene: 年度艺术节因市政预算科目被削减而面临停办。一家地产开发商随即提出全额资助，条件是品牌出现在所有物料上，且公司指派一名经理进入委托作品的评审小组。一些艺术家认为这笔钱能让四十个项目继续运转；另一些艺术家则认为评审席位的让渡，意味着商业方可以影响公共艺术创作方向。艺术节总监有一周时间做决定。
scene_en: The city's annual arts festival is about to be cancelled after its municipal budget line was cut. A property developer steps in, offering to cover the entire cost on one condition: its brand appears on all materials and a company-appointed manager sits on the selection panel for commissioned works. Some artists say the money keeps forty programs alive; others argue the panel seat lets a commercial actor shape what public art gets made. The festival director has one week to decide.

options.t_en: I'd take the deal and negotiate the scope of the manager's role. Forty programs continuing matters more to the city's cultural life than a logo on the posters, and I'd insist the artists' vote stays the majority on the panel.
options.t: 我会接受资助，同时谈判限定那位经理的职权范围。四十个项目延续下去对城市文化生活更重要，一张海报上的标志改变不了这一点，但我会坚持评审团里艺术家票数占多数。

options.t_en: I'd rather raise a small dedicated cultural levy than hand a selection seat to a sponsor. Public art funded by the public should answer to the public, and a stable line in the budget protects future festivals too.
options.t: 我宁可推动设立一笔小额文化专项费，也不把评审席位让给赞助方。由公众出钱的艺术应该向公众负责，预算里的稳定科目也能保护今后每一届艺术节。

options.t_en: I'd try crowdfunding and membership fees first. If the festival can't convince a few thousand residents to chip in small amounts, that's information worth having before anyone hands over decision power.
options.t: 我会先尝试众筹和会员费。如果艺术节连几千位居民的少量支持都争取不到，那这个信息本身就有价值，比先交出决策权再发现问题要好。

options.t_en: I'd run a smaller festival on whatever remains and refuse both strings attached. A weekend of open studios and street performances costs little, needs nobody's permission, and keeps the program independent.
options.t: 我会用剩下的经费办一个规模更小的艺术节，两种附加条件都不接受。一个周末的工作室开放日和街头演出花不了多少钱，不需要任何人批准，节目也保持独立。

options.t_en: I can't really take a side here — I don't know enough about this to judge.
options.t: 这题我站不了边，了解得不够，判断不了。

scene: 区游泳俱乐部面临一个预算抉择。俱乐部一名十五岁选手入选了国家青训计划，每年的教练和差旅费需要一万二；同样一笔钱够俱乐部两个赛季的启蒙班运行，而启蒙班目前服务两百名儿童且仍在排队。董事会周四开会表决，选手家庭表示如果俱乐部承诺承担其余部分，他们可以部分自筹训练费用。
scene_en: A district swimming club has one budget decision to make. Its fifteen-year-old swimmer has qualified for national development training that needs twelve thousand a year in coaching and travel. The same amount would fund the club's beginner classes, which serve two hundred children, for a full season — classes that currently have a waiting list. The board meets on Thursday, and the swimmer's family has said they could partially fund her training if the club commits to the rest.

options.t_en: I'd commit the money to her training. District clubs exist partly to open doors for the rare kid who can go all the way, and passing on a national selection once may mean never getting another.
options.t: 我会把这笔钱投到她的训练上。区级俱乐部存在的意义之一，就是为极少数能走到底的孩子开门，错过一次国家队选拔，可能就再没有第二次机会。

options.t_en: I'd keep the money in the beginner classes. Two hundred children learning to swim safely benefits the whole district every week, while one athlete's trajectory is uncertain and depends on factors no club budget can control.
options.t: 我会把钱留给启蒙班。两百个孩子每周学会安全游泳，惠及的是整个社区，而一名选手的前景并不确定，取决于俱乐部预算无法控制的诸多因素。

options.t_en: I'd broker a shared arrangement: her family, two local businesses and the club each cover a portion, and the beginner fund loses nothing. It takes more organizing, but it tests whether local sponsorship can carry elite dreams without draining mass programs.
options.t: 我会促成各方分摊：她的家庭、两家本地商户和俱乐部各出一部分，启蒙班经费分文不动。组织起来更费事，但这能检验本地赞助能否托起竞技梦想而不挤占普及项目。

options.t_en: I'd introduce tiered fees: families who can pay a little more subsidize both the beginner classes and a training stipend, with fee waivers anyone can request quietly. Money should follow need and talent, not whoever applied first.
options.t: 我会推行阶梯收费：有能力多缴的家庭，缴费同时补贴启蒙班和训练津贴，任何家庭都可以低调申请减免。钱应该跟着需求和天赋走，而不是跟着谁先来报名走。

options.t_en: This feels like a false choice to me; if it actually came up, I'd handle it some other way entirely.
options.t: 我觉得这题是个伪选择，真到那一步我会用别的方式处理。

scene: 你八十二岁的祖母独自住在住了四十年的老房子里。去年春天摔了一跤之后，她已经两次忘记关灶火，医生提到她的记忆力在早期衰退。家族群正在讨论四条路：她搬进你家的空房间；她申请公立养老院床位但排队很长；家里装上传感器并雇白天陪护，让她继续住在原处；或者她搬去外地的姑姑家，但会远离熟悉的医生和老朋友。
scene_en: Your grandmother, 82, lives alone in the flat she has kept for forty years. Since a fall last spring she has left the stove on twice, and her doctor mentions early memory decline. The family chat group is debating four paths: she moves into your spare room; she applies for a place in a public care home with a long waiting list; the family installs sensors and hires daytime help so she stays home; or she moves in with your aunt in another city, far from her doctors and friends.

options.t_en: She should come live with us. She raised me in that flat, but a person who forgets the stove shouldn't be alone at night, and moving in with family keeps her surrounded by people who know her habits.
options.t: 她应该搬来和我们住。那套老房子固然是她一手置办的，但会忘记关灶火的人不该独自过夜，和家人同住能让她身边始终有人了解她的习惯。

options.t_en: I'd apply for the public care home now, while we wait we keep visiting daily. Professional round-the-clock staff can handle what our family cannot — night supervision, medication, emergency response — and she deserves trained care, not stretched amateurs.
options.t: 我会现在就申请公立养老院，等床位期间我们每天探望。全天候专业护理能承担家庭承担不了的部分——夜间看护、用药管理、应急处理，她应当得到受过训练的照护，而不是勉强的外行帮忙。

options.t_en: I'd fit the flat with motion sensors, an automatic stove shutoff, and daytime home help. Home is where her memories and routines are; the right equipment plus a few hours of paid care each day can bridge what's actually failing.
options.t: 我会给老房子装上活动传感器、灶台自动断气和白天上门陪护。家是她记忆和习惯所在，合适的设备加上每天几小时的付费照护，恰好能补上目前缺的那一环。

options.t_en: The aunt's offer deserves a real conversation with grandma herself, not just the four of us. Whichever arrangement we pick, the person living it should be the one who chose it, even if the practical ranking looks obvious from outside.
options.t: 姑姑的提议值得和祖母本人认真谈一次，而不只是我们四个人决定。无论最后选哪种安排，真正生活在其中的应该是做出选择的那个人，哪怕从实际情况看某种安排更省事。

options.t_en: I'm genuinely indifferent — this barely affects my life either way.
options.t: 我确实无所谓，这事对生活影响不大。

scene: 先买后付类应用已渗透本地商铺，区消费者事务办公室报告称，十八至二十四岁年轻人同时背三笔以上分期付款的比例大幅上升。公开听证会上，监管方列出几个方向：对逾期费设置上限，并要求结账页面用通俗语言展示全成本明细；建立共享信贷登记系统，让放贷机构能看到借款人的既有分期；或者依靠学校金融素养课程，让市场竞争去约束这些应用。
scene_en: Buy-now-pay-later apps have spread through local shops, and the district's consumer affairs office reports a sharp rise in eighteen-to-twenty-four-year-olds juggling three or more installment plans. At a public hearing, regulators float options: cap late fees and require a plain-language total-cost box on every checkout screen; mandate a shared credit registry so lenders can see existing plans; or rely on school-based financial literacy and let competition discipline the apps.

options.t_en: I'd mandate the total-cost box and cap the late fees. A checkout screen engineered for one-tap speed shouldn't also be where a nineteen-year-old discovers the real price; making the full cost impossible to hide changes behavior without banning anything.
options.t: 我会强制要求全成本明细并设逾期费上限。一个为「一键下单」而设计的结账页面，不应该同时成为十九岁年轻人发现真实价格的地方；让全成本无法被隐藏，不需要禁用任何东西就能改变行为。

options.t_en: I'd build the shared registry first. Fee caps treat symptoms; the core problem is that each app sees only its own customer, so a borrower can stack six plans invisibly. Lenders who can see total exposure price risk honestly, which is how markets are supposed to work.
options.t: 我会先建共享登记系统。费用上限治的是表面症状，核心问题是每个应用只看得见自己的客户，借款人可以无声地叠加六笔分期。放贷方看得见总敞口才会如实定价风险，这本来就是市场应有的运作方式。

options.t_en: I'd put the money into school and onboarding financial literacy instead of new rules. Most of these borrowers signed their first plan at seventeen; a generation that reads a repayment schedule before tapping confirm protects itself better than any regulator working after the fact.
options.t: 我会把资源投到学校和首次使用的金融素养教育上，而不是新增管制。这些借款人大多十七岁就签了第一笔分期；一代人在按下确认前就懂得读还款计划表，比监管者事后补救更能保护他们自己。

options.t_en: I'd do both the registry and the caps, and add a cooling-off window for plans above a threshold. Evidence from other markets shows single measures get engineered around; stacking a few modest rules closes the routes between them.
options.t: 我会同时上登记系统和费用上限，并给超过一定金额的分期加一个冷静期。其他市场的经验表明，单一措施总会被设计出绕行方案，几条温和规则叠加起来才能堵住相互之间的空隙。

options.t_en: I keep going back and forth on this; neither direction feels quite right to me.
options.t: 这题我反复摇摆，哪个方向都觉得不太对。

scene: 区域电网需要新建一条高压线路，把风电走廊接入海岸端。最便宜的路径穿过农田和两个村庄边缘；地下电缆方案成本增至三倍，工期还要多两年。廉价路径沿线的村民已组织起来反对，理由是土地价值和景观影响；电网工程师则警告，风电场每多并网延迟一年，区域就要多烧一年进口燃料。规划专员必须给出路线建议。
scene_en: The regional grid needs a new high-voltage line to connect a wind corridor to the coast. The cheapest route crosses farmland and the edge of two villages; burying the line triples the cost and adds two years. Villagers along the cheap route have organized against it, citing land value and visual impact, while grid engineers warn that every year of delay the wind farms stay offline, the region burns more imported fuel. A planning officer must recommend a route.

options.t_en: I'd recommend the cheap overhead route with full landowner compensation. The fuel the region burns while the line waits is a cost paid by everyone, and money spent moving towers around is money not spent on the wind farms themselves.
options.t: 我会建议走廉价的架空线路，并给土地所有者足额补偿。线路每拖延一年，整个区域都在为多烧的燃料买单，把钱花在挪塔位上，就意味着风电场本身少了一笔投入。

options.t_en: I'd pay the underground premium on the contested segments. Two villages shouldn't carry a visual and property burden the whole region benefits from, and burying the line where people actually live is the cheaper outcome once compensation fights and appeals are counted.
options.t: 在争议路段我会支付地下化的溢价。两个村庄不应独自承担全区域受益项目带来的景观和地价负担，把赔偿诉讼和申诉成本算进去，在人烟所在之处入地反而是更省的结局。

options.t_en: I'd reroute along the existing transport corridor even if the line runs longer. Reusing land that is already industrial keeps new farmland and villages untouched, and the extra length is paid back in fewer conflicts over the project's lifetime.
options.t: 我会让线路沿既有交通走廊绕行，哪怕总长度更长。复用已经是工业用途的土地，就不会新增农田和村庄的负担，多出的线路成本会在项目全周期里以更少的冲突收回。

options.t_en: I'd hold the decision until an independent panel hears the villages. A route drawn without the people who live under it invites years of appeal; one afternoon of testimony may reveal a compromise the office maps never showed.
options.t: 我会把决定推迟到独立小组听取村庄意见之后。一条不经过沿线居民同意就画定的路线，招来的是经年累月的申诉；一个下午的当面陈述，可能揭示出任何一张办公地图都没显示的折中方案。

options.t_en: It would depend on details this scenario doesn't give, so I can't commit to any of these.
options.t: 这取决于情景里没交代的细节，我没法锁定任何一项。

scene: 一座河畔小镇十年内被淹了三次，最近一次洪水漫过了百年一遇地图上标注为安全的街道。政府向居民提供选择：按灾前市场价接受回购、搬到高处重建生活，或留在原地，小镇用国家基建拨款重建并加高堤坝。洪泛区内的保险费已经翻倍，一些年长居民说，他们将失去的不只是房子，而是小镇本身。
scene_en: A river town has flooded three times in ten years, and the last flood reached streets the hundred-year maps said were safe. The government offers residents a choice: take a buyout at pre-flood market value and relocate to higher ground, or stay while the town rebuilds and raises the levee using a national infrastructure grant. Insurance premiums in the flood zone have already doubled, and some older residents say the town itself, not just the houses, is what they would be losing.

options.t_en: I'd take the buyout. Three floods in ten years is a pattern, not bad luck, and starting over somewhere the river doesn't reach is worth more than another decade of sandbags and doubled premiums.
options.t: 我会接受回购。十年三淹是趋势而不是运气差，在一个河水漫不到的地方重新开始，比再来十年的沙袋和翻倍的保险费更值得。

options.t_en: I'd stay and back the levee project. The town's school, clinic and shops are what make life here work, and they can't be moved by any buyout; if the national grant can protect them, letting the community scatter would cost the region more than concrete.
options.t: 我会留下并支持堤坝工程。镇上的学校、诊所和商铺是这里生活的根基，回购方案带不走它们；如果国家拨款能保护这些，让社区就此散掉，代价会高过一道混凝土堤坝。

options.t_en: I'd stay but rebuild my own house elevated on stilts with my own money, and let neighbors decide for themselves. No single plan fits every household — the retiree with a paid-off mortgage and the young family with a new one weigh the same flood differently.
options.t: 我会留下，但自掏腰包把自家房子架高重建，邻居们怎么选随他们。没有哪套方案适合每个家庭——还清房贷的退休者和背着新房贷的年轻家庭，面对同一场洪水的权衡并不相同。

options.t_en: I'd push for a staged community relocation: the town moves together to one new site with a shared school and clinic. Individual buyouts quietly dissolve a community, but a planned move keeps the networks that make the town a town.
options.t: 我会推动整社区分阶段搬迁：全镇一起搬到一处新址，学校和诊所一并重建。零散的回购会无声地瓦解一个社区，而有计划的搬迁能把让小镇之所以成为小镇的那张关系网保留下来。

options.t_en: It's really none of my business — I'd let the people involved sort it out themselves.
options.t: 这说不上和我有关，让当事各方自己去定就好。

scene: 国家监管机构提出：平台必须把十六岁以下用户的默认信息流改为时间序排列并取消无限下滑，更改默认设置需要在应用内发起、并经家长验证。平台工程师认为，由互动数据驱动的推荐流是服务得以免费的理由；儿童心理学家引用了睡眠与注意力方面的研究数据；青少年权益组织则反驳说，十六岁的人理应和成年人使用同一个互联网，而家长验证环节收集的家庭数据，恰恰是规则声称要保护的对象。
scene_en: A national regulator proposes that platforms must default all users under sixteen to a chronological feed without infinite scroll, and that changing the default requires an in-app request verified by a parent. Platform engineers argue engagement-driven feeds are what keep their services free; child psychologists cite sleep and attention data; youth advocates counter that sixteen-year-olds deserve the same internet as adults, and that parent-verification collects exactly the kind of family data the rules claim to protect.

options.t_en: I'd support the default limits. Defaults shape behavior more than any advice, and a sixteen-year-old scrolling until 2 a.m. is not a failure of parenting — it's a product working as designed. Making the calm feed the default fixes it at the source.
options.t: 我会支持默认限制。默认设置对行为的影响超过任何说教，一个刷到凌晨两点的十六岁少年不是家长管教失败，而是产品设计达到了它的目标。把平静的信息流设为默认，就是从源头解决。

options.t_en: I'd leave defaults to families. Parents can already set device limits, and a blanket rule treats every household the same regardless of how different their children are; one family's needed safeguard is another's unwanted surveillance of a responsible teenager.
options.t: 我会把默认设置留给家庭。家长本来就能设定设备时限，一刀切的规则把情况千差万别的家庭同等对待；对一户人家是必要的保护，对另一户就是对自己自律孩子的多余监视。

options.t_en: I'd require transparency instead of defaults: platforms must publish engagement-engineering audits and give independent researchers data access. Well-designed research lets society see whether the harm is real before it prescribes how every teenager's screen must look.
options.t: 我会要求透明度而不是改默认值：平台必须发布「互动设计工程」审计，并向独立研究者开放数据。先让扎实的研究弄清伤害是否属实，再去规定每个青少年的屏幕长什么样。

options.t_en: I'd back the rule but drop the parent-verification layer. A calm default protects the kids whose parents can't or won't intervene, and skipping the verification step avoids building a new database of family relationships in the process.
options.t: 我会支持这条规则，但去掉家长验证环节。平静的默认设置恰恰保护的是那些家长无力或不愿干预的孩子，省掉验证步骤也避免了在过程中新建一个家庭关系数据库。

options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.
options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。

scene: 在一个约有五分之一居民自幼讲地区少数民族语言的港口城市，议会正在讨论两项提案：全城道路与公共标识双语化，以及在诊所和公共办事机构设立有经费支持的口译服务。支持者说，当公共空间从不出现一种语言时，它就会在无声中消亡；反对者则问，为什么全体纳税人要为大多数人读不懂的标识买单。桌上有一个折中方案：仅在人口普查显示该语言集中的四个区，为两项服务拨款。
scene_en: In a port city where roughly a fifth of residents grew up speaking a regional minority language, the council is debating two proposals: bilingual road signs and public signage across the city, and funded interpreter services in clinics and public offices. Supporters say language dies quietly when public space never shows it; opponents ask why all taxpayers should fund signs most can't read. A compromise on the table: fund both only in the four districts where census data shows the language is concentrated.

options.t_en: I'd fund both city-wide. A language survives where it's visible and usable in daily life, not only in four districts; half-measures turn a living language into a museum piece, and the cost of signage is small next to what's being preserved.
options.t: 我会在全城范围资助这两项。一门语言要在日常生活里被看见、被使用才能存续，而不是只活在四个区里；半套措施会把活生生的语言变成博物馆展品，标识的花费与所要保存的东西相比微不足道。

options.t_en: I'd keep public signage in one common language for everyone, and put the budget into voluntary evening classes instead. Shared public space should be readable by all comers, and language belongs in homes and schools people choose to attend.
options.t: 我会保持公共标识使用所有人共通的语言，把预算投给自愿报名的夜校课程。公共空间应当让任何来客都能读懂，语言传承属于家庭和人们自愿选择的课堂。

options.t_en: I'd adopt the four-district compromise. Census concentration is exactly where interpreter services see real demand, and starting there proves the model's cost and usefulness before scaling it; if uptake is low, the city hasn't spent city-wide money learning that.
options.t: 我会采纳四区折中方案。人口普查的集中区正是口译服务有真实需求的地方，从那里起步能先验证这套模式的成本与效用再谈推广；如果使用率低，城市也不必花全城的钱才得出这个结论。

options.t_en: I'd fund the interpreters but not the signs. Reading a road sign is learnable; navigating a cancer diagnosis in a language you only half speak is not. Public money is most defensible where it removes a barrier to essential services.
options.t: 我会资助口译服务，但不动路牌。路牌上的字可以学，但癌症诊断书无法靠半吊子的语言水平去理解。公共资金最站得住脚的用途，是移除通往基本服务的障碍。

options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.
options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。

scene_en: A city block association wants to renovate a shared courtyard into a paid community garden with an annual membership fee, to cover upkeep and a part-time gardener. Longtime renters say the fee quietly excludes them from a space they already cross every day; the homeowners funding the repairs say free access means nobody respects the planters, as three years of volunteer upkeep ended in trampled beds and dumped trash. The city council has been asked to decide whether to subsidize the fee for low-income residents or reject the fee model entirely.
scene: 一个街区协会想把公共庭院改造成收费社区花园，用年费支付维护费用和一名兼职园丁。长期租户说这笔年费会无声地把他们挡在一个每天都要穿行的空间之外；出资修缮的业主则说免费开放意味着没人爱惜花坛，过去三年的志愿维护最终以花坛被踩踏、垃圾成堆告终。市议会收到请愿，需要决定是为低收入居民补贴年费，还是彻底否决收费模式。

options.t_en: I would back the fee but have the council cover it for anyone below the local median income. Shared spaces survive when someone is clearly responsible for them, and a paid gardener is that responsibility made concrete; a subsidy keeps the boundary without fencing people out.
options.t: 我会支持收费，但由市议会为收入低于当地中位数的居民买单。公共空间能维持下去靠的是有人明确负责，付费园丁就是把这份责任落到实处；补贴既保留了边界，又不会把人关在门外。

options.t_en: I would reject the fee entirely. A courtyard people cross daily already belongs to the street's rhythm, and charging for it turns neighbors into customers; if upkeep failed under volunteering, the fix is recruiting more volunteers and better bins, not a paywall on shared ground.
options.t: 我会彻底否决收费。每天有人穿行的庭院本来就属于这条街的生活节奏，对它收费等于把邻居变成顾客；志愿维护失灵，该做的是招募更多志愿者、增设垃圾桶，而不是给公共地面设付费门槛。

options.t_en: I would split the courtyard: a fenced members' section with the gardener, and an open section for anyone passing through. Neither side gets the whole argument, but both keep something real, and we can review the split after two growing seasons.
options.t: 我会把庭院分成两块：一块是有围栏、配园丁的会员区，另一块对任何路过的人开放。哪一边都拿不到全部理由，但都保住了实际的东西，两个种植季之后再回头评估这个分法。

options.t_en: I would put it to a binding vote of everyone on the block, renters included, with the fee schedule drafted openly first. Whoever uses the courtyard should set its rules, and a decision made by the loudest twelve households at a Tuesday meeting will fester for years.
options.t: 我会把它交给全街区居民，包括租户，进行有约束力的投票，年费方案先公开征求意见。庭院的使用者才应该定规则，而由周二晚会上嗓门最大的十二户做出的决定，会让矛盾发酵好几年。
我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。
options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.

scene_en: A public library discovers that a local influencer has been filming confrontational street-interview videos inside its reading rooms, ambushing patrons on camera without consent; clips of startled students have drawn millions of views. The library board must write its first filming policy. One proposal bans all commercial filming inside; another requires on-camera consent from anyone identifiable; a third allows filming anywhere in the building as long as it does not obstruct the space, arguing public institutions should be open to the public eye.
scene: 一家公共图书馆发现有本地网红在其阅览室内拍摄对抗式街头采访视频，未经同意就把镜头对准读者；受惊学生的片段已获得数百万播放。图书馆董事会必须起草第一部拍摄政策。一个方案禁止馆内一切商业拍摄；另一个要求对任何可被识别出的人取得镜头同意；第三个则允许在馆内任何地方拍摄，只要不妨碍空间运转，理由是公共机构本就应该坦然面对公众视线。

options.t_en: I would require consent from anyone identifiable and let filming continue otherwise. The harm in these clips is not the camera but the ambush; a five-second agreement protects patrons while keeping the library open to documentarians, journalists, and the merely curious.
options.t: 我会要求对任何可被识别的人取得同意，其余拍摄照常进行。这些片段里的伤害不在镜头本身，而在偷袭；五秒钟的同意既保护读者，又让纪录片作者、记者和单纯好奇的人继续可以拍摄。

options.t_en: I would ban commercial filming outright. Reading rooms exist for people who come to think, not to become someone's content, and a consent form signed under a rolling camera is not consent anyone can refuse gracefully; the ban is simpler to enforce and easier to understand.
options.t: 我会直接禁止商业拍摄。阅览室是为来思考的人存在的，不是为成为别人的素材；在镜头逼近下签的同意书，不是谁都能体面拒绝的同意。禁令执行起来更简单，也更容易让人理解。

options.t_en: I would keep the building open to filming and post clear signage instead. Public institutions are paid for by the public, and if the pressure of being seen is uncomfortable, that pressure also keeps such places honest; a policy of light, not doors, fits what a library is for.
options.t: 我会保持馆内对拍摄开放，改为设置醒目的标识。公共机构由公众供养，被注视的压力虽然不舒服，但这种压力也督促这类地方保持诚实；对图书馆来说，用灯光而不是门禁来应对更合适。

options.t_en: I would restrict filming to a designated zone near the entrance. Patrons keep their quiet corners and creators keep a workable venue, and the rule draws one bright line a night guard can actually hold instead of a judgment call every librarian resents making.
options.t: 我会把拍摄限制在入口附近的指定区域。读者保住安静角落，创作者保住可用场地，这条规则画出的是保安真正守得住的一条明线，而不是让每个馆员都不情愿地临场裁断。

options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.
options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。

scene_en: A regional health authority must cut waiting lists for knee replacements, where patients now wait an average of fourteen months. Managers propose three options: contract private clinics to absorb overflow at a fixed price per surgery; add evening and weekend shifts at the public hospital with overtime pay; or reorganize into a single referral pool ranked strictly by clinical urgency, which would push some routine cases behind new cancer screenings. Surgeons are split, and patient groups have petitions for each option.
scene: 某地区卫生部门必须削减膝关节置换手术的等候名单，患者目前平均要等十四个月。管理层提出三个方案：按每台手术固定价格把溢出量外包给私立诊所；在公立医院增设加班费支撑的晚间和周末班次；或重组为按临床紧急程度严格排序的统一转诊池——这会让部分常规病例排到新增癌症筛查之后。外科医生意见分裂，患者团体为每个方案都征集了请愿。

options.t_en: I would contract the private clinics. Fourteen months of pain and lost mobility is a cost that never appears on any budget sheet, and paying a fixed price per surgery buys it back immediately; the public system stays the core, with the private wing as a valve, not a replacement.
options.t: 我会把手术外包给私立诊所。十四个月的疼痛和行动能力流失，是任何预算表上都不会出现的成本，按台付费能立刻把它买回来；公立系统仍是主体，私立只是泄压阀，不是替代品。

options.t_en: I would fund the evening and weekend shifts. Contracting out trains tomorrow's surgeons somewhere else and siphons staff from the very wards that are short-handed; paying overtime keeps the capacity, the skills, and the institution itself inside the public system where people can hold it accountable.
options.t: 我会为晚间和周末班次拨款。外包会把明天的外科医生培养在别处，还从本就缺人的病房抽走人手；付加班费能把产能、技术和机构本身留在公共系统之内，让公众看得见、管得着。

options.t_en: I would build the urgency-ranked pool, even though some routine cases wait longer. Equal wait times for unequal needs are their own injustice, and a strict clinical ranking makes the tradeoff visible and appealable instead of buried in whoever shouts loudest at a clinic desk.
options.t: 我会建立按紧急程度排序的统一池，即使部分常规病例要等更久。需求不等却等待相等，本身就是一种不公；严格的临床排序让取舍看得见、可申诉，而不是埋没在诊台前谁嗓门大谁先看。

options.t_en: I would do both contracting and overtime for a trial year, with published monthly wait-time data for each route. Two modest bets beat one large one when patients are waiting, and transparent numbers let everyone see which valve actually drains the list before the budget is locked in.
options.t: 我会同时试点外包和加班一年，每月公开两条路径的等候数据。在患者等待的情况下，两笔小额下注胜过一笔大注；透明的数字让大家看清哪条泄压阀真正排空了名单，再决定预算去留。

options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.
options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。

scene_en: A national sports federation is revising its transgender participation policy for amateur and youth leagues. Endurance-event coaches cite performance data from elite competition; inclusion advocates point out that amateur races are about finishing, not podiums; some female competitors have withdrawn, saying their concerns are dismissed before they are heard. The federation must choose between category rules based on sex at birth, rules based on current hormone levels, or an open category alongside existing ones with no eligibility rules.
scene: 某全国体育联合会正在修订业余与青少年联赛的跨性别参赛政策。耐力项目教练引用精英赛事的成绩数据；包容倡导者指出业余比赛的意义是完赛而非领奖台；一些女选手已宣布退赛，说她们的担忧还没被倾听就被驳回了。联合会必须在三类方案中选择：按出生性别划分组别；按当前激素水平划分；或在现有组别之外增设无资格限制的公开组。

options.t_en: I would keep categories by sex at birth for ranked competition, while adding a fully open category anyone may enter. Records and podiums keep a consistent frame, and nobody is shut out of racing; the open category absorbs what the ranked categories cannot, without rewriting either.
options.t: 我会在有排名的比赛中保留按出生性别划分的组别，同时增设人人可参加的公开组。纪录和领奖台保持一致的参照框架，也没有人被挡在赛道之外；公开组吸收排名组无法容纳的部分，两边都不必改写。

options.t_en: I would set eligibility by current hormone levels, applied uniformly by an independent medical panel. It follows the same logic as anti-doping rules, uses present physiology rather than identity or birth records, and gives every athlete one clear, appealable standard instead of a patchwork by region.
options.t: 我会按当前激素水平设定资格，由独立医学小组统一执行。这与反兴奋剂规则逻辑相同，依据的是当下生理状态而非身份或出生记录，给每位运动员一条清晰、可申诉的标准，而不是各地拼接的碎片规则。

options.t_en: I would make all amateur and youth events open by default and keep categories only for elite ranked competition. A ten-kilometer charity run is not the Olympics, and building verification bureaucracy for a finisher's medal spends trust that youth leagues cannot afford to lose.
options.t: 我会让所有业余和青少年赛事默认开放，只给精英排名赛保留组别。十公里慈善跑不是奥运会，为一枚完赛奖牌建立核查官僚体系，消耗的是青少年联赛输不起的信任。

options.t_en: I would slow down and fund a two-year pilot with published participation and placement data before fixing rules. Both sides are arguing from conviction where numbers are thin, and a policy built on measured outcomes rather than whichever faction lobbied hardest will survive the next controversy.
options.t: 我会放慢节奏，先资助一个两年试点并公开参与人数与名次数据，再定规则。双方都在数据稀薄之处凭信念争论；建立在实测结果而非游说声量之上的政策，才能扛过下一场争议。

options.t_en: Honestly, none of these speaks for me on this one — I'd rather just skip it.
options.t: 说实话这几个说法都不代表我，这题我宁愿跳过。

scene_en: A city housing authority wants to deploy an AI triage system that reads maintenance requests and ranks repair crews by predicted urgency, promising to cut response times by a third. Tenant advocates note the model's training data comes from a decade of dispatch logs in which wealthier districts called more often and got faster service, and the vendor refuses to disclose weights as trade secrets. The council must vote on adoption, adoption with a published audit requirement, or rejection in favor of human dispatchers with new staff.
scene: 某市住房部门想部署一套 AI 分诊系统，读取维修申请并按预测的紧急程度调度维修班组，号称能把响应时间缩短三分之一。租户权益组织指出，模型的训练数据来自十年间的调度日志，其中富裕城区报修更频繁、获得服务更快，而供应商以商业机密为由拒绝公开权重。议会须就以下方案表决：直接采用；附带公开审计要求后采用；或否决并扩招人工调度员。

options.t_en: I would adopt it only with a mandatory published audit: annual bias testing on response times by district, and the model replaced if gaps widen. Speed saves tenants from mold and cold, and an audit clause turns the trade-secret excuse into something the vendor either accepts or walks away from.
options.t: 我只有在附带强制公开审计时才会采用：每年按城区检测响应时间偏差，差距扩大就更换模型。速度能让租户早点摆脱霉斑和寒冷，审计条款则让「商业机密」这个借口变成供应商要么接受、要么退出的条件。

options.t_en: I would reject it and hire dispatchers instead. A model trained on a decade of unequal service learns the inequality, and a dispatcher who sees a crying tenant on the phone reads things no log captures; the cheaper path here costs an accountability that a city cannot buy back later.
options.t: 我会否决它，改为招聘调度员。用十年不平等服务的数据训练出的模型学到的正是不平等，而电话里听到租户哽咽的调度员，能读出日志记不下的事；这条看似便宜的路，卖掉的是城市日后买不回的问责。

options.t_en: I would adopt it after requiring the vendor to open the weights to the authority's own engineers under NDA, with results published quarterly. The auditors see everything that matters, the secret stays commercially protected, and tenants get both the speed and the scrutiny in writing.
options.t: 我会要求供应商在保密协议下向本部门工程师开放权重，然后采用，并按季度公开结果。审计者看得到一切要害，商业机密仍受保护，租户则同时拿到速度和书面形式的监督。

options.t_en: I would run it in three districts for a year against human-dispatched control areas, with both datasets public. Deployment is a one-way door once crews learn the new rhythm, and twelve months of side-by-side evidence is a fair price before betting every tenant's repair queue on it.
options.t: 我会先在三个城区试运行一年，与人工调度对照区并行，两套数据都公开。一旦维修班组适应了新节奏，部署就是单向门；在把所有租户的维修队列押上去之前，十二个月的对照证据是个公道的代价。

options.t_en: I don't hold a fixed view on this; my answer would probably change from one day to the next.
options.t: 我对这事没有固定立场，换个日子答案可能就不一样。

scene_en: A public university dormitory asks how to accommodate students of different faiths who request exam scheduling changes for religious observance. Some faculty warn that a dozen different calendars would make standardized exam windows unmanageable; religious student groups answer that missing a high-stakes exam for a holy day is a burden no secular student carries; the registrar proposes a single published list of recognized observances with automatic rescheduling, plus a case-by-case appeal for anything unlisted.
scene: 一所公立大学宿舍区收到请愿：不同信仰的学生因宗教节庆申请考试改期。部分教师警告，十几种不同历法会让标准化考试窗口无法管理；宗教学生团体回应，因圣日错过一场高利害考试，是无此负担的世俗学生无法体会的处境；教务长提出方案——公布一份已认可的节庆清单，清单内自动改期，清单外逐案申诉。

options.t_en: I would adopt the published list with automatic rescheduling. A clear rule applied to everyone beats a maze of personal exceptions, students of every faith and none can plan around the same calendar, and the appeal path catches what the list misses without turning every exam into a negotiation.
options.t: 我会采纳那份公开清单加自动改期。一条对所有人一视同仁的明规则，胜过个人特例的迷宫；无论有无信仰的学生都能对着同一份日历做规划，申诉通道兜住清单漏掉的部分，又不必把每场考试都变成一场谈判。

options.t_en: I would go further and let each student reschedule one exam per term for any sincerely held observance, listed or not. A university asking eighteen-year-olds to choose between their conscience and their transcript should expect them to hide the observance, and a simple one-exam rule costs the timetable far less than it costs trust.
options.t: 我会更进一步：允许每名学生每学期因任何真诚持守的节庆改期一场考试，无论是否在清单上。一所逼十八岁学生在良知和成绩单之间做选择的大学，只会得到隐藏信仰的学生；一场考试的额度，对课表的代价远小于对信任的代价。

options.t_en: I would keep fixed exam windows for everyone. A shared civic timetable that treats all students alike is how a plural campus stays workable, and once scheduling bends to each calendar, the students juggling part-time jobs will reasonably ask why their constraints rank below religious ones.
options.t: 我会为所有人保留固定的考试窗口。一份对所有学生相同的公共课表，是多元校园得以运转的基础；一旦课表向各种历法弯折，打工的学生自然会问，为什么他们的困难排在宗教困难之后。

options.t_en: I would expand the recognition list annually with input from student religious councils, and fund a quiet exam hall on major holy days instead of rescheduling individuals. Students keep community on the day itself, faculties keep one window, and the campus absorbs the observance rather than litigating it case by case.
options.t: 我会每年根据学生宗教议会意见扩充认可清单，并在重要圣日设置安静的考场，而不是为个人改期。学生在节日当天保有社群，教师保有统一窗口，校园以整体安排容纳节庆，而不是逐案争论。

options.t_en: I'd abstain if I could — the way this is framed forces a stance I don't actually hold.
options.t: 可以弃权的话我就弃权，这题的问法有点替我表态的意思。

scene_en: After a spike in retail theft, a city council debates its response. Shopkeepers report losses and rising insurance premiums; legal-aid lawyers report that most repeat offenders are struggling with addiction, and that pretrial detention of shoplifters has left children in unsupervised homes. Proposals on the table: a dedicated retail-theft court offering treatment instead of jail for first and second offenses, higher minimum fines with immediate citation, or expanded plainclothes patrols in commercial corridors.
scene: 零售盗窃案激增后，市议会讨论应对。店主报告损失与上涨的保费；法律援助律师报告，多数惯犯正受成瘾困扰，而商店窃贼的审前羁押已让一批孩子处于无人照看的状态。桌上的提案有：设立专门的零售盗窃法庭，对初犯和二次犯提供治疗替代监禁；提高最低罚款并当场开单；或在商业街区增加便衣巡逻。

options.t_en: I would fund the specialty court. Addiction-driven theft does not stop at the jail gate, and detention that empties a child's home creates costs the city pays elsewhere; a treatment track with real consequences for noncompliance aims at the repeat cycle instead of the individual episode.
options.t: 我会为专门法庭拨款。成瘾驱动的盗窃不会止步于监狱大门，而羁押让一个家失去大人、由此产生的成本，最终都会由城市在别处支付；带真实违约后果的治疗轨道，瞄准的是重复循环本身，而不是单次案件。

options.t_en: I would raise the immediate fines and cite on the spot. Consequence that arrives the same week shapes behavior better than a court date eighteen months out, shopkeepers see enforcement they can believe in, and the revenue can partly fund the treatment programs the same council keeps deferring.
options.t: 我会提高即时罚款并当场开单。当周就到账的后果，比十八个月后的开庭日更能影响行为；店主看到的是可感的执法，罚款收入还能部分反哺同一届议会一直拖着不批的治疗项目。

options.t_en: I would expand plainclothes patrols first and reassess in a year. Whatever the courts do later, the theft is happening now on the shop floor, visible presence deters the opportunistic majority who respond to risk, and it buys time to build the treatment infrastructure properly instead of launching it half-staffed.
options.t: 我会先扩充便衣巡逻，一年后再评估。无论法院之后怎么做，盗窃就发生在店面上；可见的在场能震慑占多数、对风险敏感的机会型盗窃者，也为把治疗体系建像样争取时间，而不是在人员不足时仓促上线。
